| | This case is still going on in North Carolina, Team,**** and we have to keep spreading the word because the mainstream media continues to ignore election theft in plain sight. **The North Carolina state Supreme Court stepped in to stop the certification of the election for a justice on their court** , which is a huge breach of power and a clearly partisan action in a state where judges are affiliated with political parties. **For background:** On Election Day, incumbent Justice Allison Riggs (D) was reelected by a slim margin of a few hundred votes. Her disgruntled opponent, GOP Judge Jefferson Griffin, sued for and received two separate recounts -- _both of which increased Riggs' lead._ Now, a coalition of more than 200 North Carolina jurists, attorneys, state government officials, bar leaders and legal educators signed on to a letter this month to Judge Griffin to end his effort to overturn the results of the 2024 election. “ _The arguments you have advanced ask our judicial system to change the rules in place for the 2024 election after it has run its course. Indeed, if you succeed, tens of thousands of voters will lose their voice after they voted,_ ” the letter states. “ _For the sake of our judicial system, we ask you to terminate your litigation now_.” [**We must keep the pressure up to stop this post-election interference with legitimate votes. Please pitch in $25 or whatever you can right now to help us spread the word and make these ballots count in North Carolina and stop suppression across the country >>**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104446471/535386880/1723810624?am=25.00&contactdata=MjxUCYjjR0ABB6sVOCb5JeRMlAiI60XeVomGd4hlbQa6kVIZ/OJcw4FJoKKhWLhphXkgrUamS1lZrU6zHZflDtVloDEMS2ca1fLoRQYCPxs=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5MjE1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJjZWZmNDE1LTBjMDktZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=d2tKmsyPetLsNad5G8Ai6kmnqzpi_rKrc305t_5oA90=&emci=be628e10-bc08-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=2ceff415-0c09-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=33603084)

Justices Anita Earls (D) and Richard Dietz (R) dissented while Justice Riggs properly recused herself, so the judicial stay on election certification was put in place by a 4-2, mainly party-line vote. The bottom line is that **the partisan NC Supreme Court is stepping into an election for one of their own members to try and reverse the results** of the vote because their party didn't win. Opponents of voting rights are blatantly trying to steal this election in plain sight. By waiting until after Election Day and the recounts, it's clear that the challenger's campaign only sued to get these votes tossed out because he lost. The scarier part is that -- if this challenge is successful and these votes get thrown out \-- opponents of voting rights will absolutely try and do this in every other election around the country. | | | | | This case is still going on in North Carolina, Team,** and we have to keep spreading the word because the mainstream media continues to ignore election theft in plain sight. The North Carolina state Supreme Court stepped in to stop the certification of the election for a justice on their court , which is a huge breach of power and a clearly partisan action in a state where judges are affiliated with political parties. For background: On Election Day, incumbent Justice Allison Riggs (D) was reelected by a slim margin of a few hundred votes. Her disgruntled opponent, GOP Judge Jefferson Griffin, sued for and received two separate recounts -- both of which increased Riggs' lead. Now, a coalition of more than 200 North Carolina jurists, attorneys, state government officials, bar leaders and legal educators signed on to a letter this month to Judge Griffin to end his effort to overturn the results of the 2024 election. “ The arguments you have advanced ask our judicial system to change the rules in place for the 2024 election after it has run its course. Indeed, if you succeed, tens of thousands of voters will lose their voice after they voted, ” the letter states. “ For the sake of our judicial system, we ask you to terminate your litigation now.” If you've saved your payment information with FastAction, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | It's been months since Judge Griffin sued to remove 60,000 voters' ballots from the count , even though they've been validated in the recounts. The state Board of Elections dismissed his request , but his partisan, would-be colleagues -- the NC Supreme Court has a 5-2 Republican majority \-- stepped in to adjudicate the election and possibly kick off one of their own. Justices Anita Earls (D) and Richard Dietz (R) dissented while Justice Riggs properly recused herself, so the judicial stay on election certification was put in place by a 4-2, mainly party-line vote. The bottom line is that the partisan NC Supreme Court is stepping into an election for one of their own members to try and reverse the results** of the vote because their party didn't win. Dear Peter, Tomorrow one of the two Oregon Conservation Network’s (OCN) Major Threats will have a floor vote: [**SB 777**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104447479/535406588/1140938071?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJkYTBlNDUzLTExMDktZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=QNKON0htlSXWo4VkyfClxCnqWZ1fzaRaxqP2aODOupU=&emci=6f0e7f80-f508-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=2da0e453-1109-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=2107230) -5. We’ve seen this bill before in previous sessions, and it’s time to stop it once again. SB 777-5, known as the Wolf Depredation Compensation Program Bill, would multiply up to 5x the fair market value paid for livestock confirmed killed or injured by wolves. [**Do you have a moment now to tell your Senator to vote NO on SB 777 -5?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104447480/535406589/-321347424?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJkYTBlNDUzLTExMDktZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=QNKON0htlSXWo4VkyfClxCnqWZ1fzaRaxqP2aODOupU=&emci=6f0e7f80-f508-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=2da0e453-1109-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=2107230)

This bill is a danger to Oregon’s wolves, as the 5x multiplier could rapidly drain the program’s funds set aside for both compensating confirmed wolf kills at fair market value and supplying non-lethal coexistence tools. While the bill increases the minimum spent on non-lethal tools to 50%, last year nearly 80% of the requests were for proven non-lethal conflict reduction tools such as fencing and range riding, this bill could actually decrease the investment in reducing wolf livestock conflict. Moreover, over $1,3 million dollars of the anti-poaching budget and the proposed new FTE wolf coexistence biologist were cut from the ODFW budget. It does not make sense to fail to invest in conflict reduction and anti-poaching while applying a multiplier to the flawed wolf compensation program. We can’t afford to jeopardize the program and endanger the recovery of Oregon’s wolves, which is exactly what would happen if SB 777-5 passes. If SB 777 -5 were to pass, Oregon would have one of the [largest multipliers in the nation](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104447482/535406591/-906140493?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJkYTBlNDUzLTExMDktZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=QNKON0htlSXWo4VkyfClxCnqWZ1fzaRaxqP2aODOupU=&emci=6f0e7f80-f508-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=2da0e453-1109-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=2107230) for compensation for livestock killed by wolves. Let’s make sure that Oregon isn’t an outlier in the nation for wolf compensation, especially when the need for such a great multiplier is unclear. In the program’s current structure, 100% of the requests for confirmed and probable depredations have been paid at fair market value. Although this bill would require such a high multiplier for livestock compensation, SB 777-5 does not address program inefficiency or improve ways to account for increased management burdens and prompt wolf recovery, nor does the bill itself include the necessary funds for providing a multiplier. It’s clear that SB 777 -5 is not a solution to improving the Wolf Depredation Compensation Program. Let’s invest directly into wolf recovery by supporting the Oregon Department of Fish and Wildlife’s wolf program - the entire budget of which is less than what SB 777 -5 would cost. There are solutions and improvements that can be made only if we stop this bill and re-engage in conversation with all parties to explore all possible solutions. [**Will you help us stop this bill today and make room for improvements to this program tomorrow?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104447483/535406592/-321347424?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJkYTBlNDUzLTExMDktZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=QNKON0htlSXWo4VkyfClxCnqWZ1fzaRaxqP2aODOupU=&emci=6f0e7f80-f508-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=2da0e453-1109-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=2107230)

SB 777-5, known as the Wolf Depredation Compensation Program Bill, would multiply up to 5x the fair market value paid for livestock confirmed killed or injured by wolves. This bill is a danger to Oregon’s wolves, as the 5x multiplier could rapidly drain the program’s funds set aside for both compensating confirmed wolf kills at fair market value and supplying non-lethal coexistence tools. While the bill increases the minimum spent on non-lethal tools to 50%, last year nearly 80% of the requests were for proven non-lethal conflict reduction tools such as fencing and range riding, this bill could actually decrease the investment in reducing wolf livestock conflict. Moreover, over $1,3 million dollars of the anti-poaching budget and the proposed new FTE wolf coexistence biologist were cut from the ODFW budget. It does not make sense to fail to invest in conflict reduction and anti-poaching while applying a multiplier to the flawed wolf compensation program. We can’t afford to jeopardize the program and endanger the recovery of Oregon’s wolves, which is exactly what would happen if SB 777-5 passes. If SB 777 -5 were to pass, Oregon would have one of the for compensation for livestock killed by wolves. Let’s make sure that Oregon isn’t an outlier in the nation for wolf compensation, especially when the need for such a great multiplier is unclear. In the program’s current structure, 100% of the requests for confirmed and probable depredations have been paid at fair market value. Although this bill would require such a high multiplier for livestock compensation, SB 777-5 does not address program inefficiency or improve ways to account for increased management burdens and prompt wolf recovery, nor does the bill itself include the necessary funds for providing a multiplier. It’s clear that SB 777 -5 is not a solution to improving the Wolf Depredation Compensation Program. Let’s invest directly into wolf recovery by supporting the Oregon Department of Fish and Wildlife’s wolf program - the entire budget of which is less than what SB 777 -5 would cost. There are solutions and improvements that can be made only if we stop this bill and re-engage in conversation with all parties to explore all possible solutions. There will be a vote on the Senator floor for SB 777 -5 tomorrow. Our wolves need you. | | Thank you for your support, Eliza Walton (she/they) OLCV Coalition Director | | | | | ---|---|--- Oregon League of Conservation Voters 1110 SE Alder Suite 220 Portland, OR 97214 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please .

name: Andrew Yang
subject: Abundance
body:
Imagine a world where people work 3 days a week. Energy is clean and food is plentiful because of advances in agriculture and technology. | |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=5b70051419&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=9b62a3a32c&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
| Why can’t we have nice things? Why are we heading more toward Mad Max than, say, Star Trek or the Jetsons? This might be the most important question of our time. There have been a number of books asking versions of this question recently. From Jen Pahlka to Yoni Appelbaum and Marc Dunkelman, a number of people are tackling why we haven’t been making big strides in areas like housing or climate change or delivery of government services. I might add, why is poverty seemingly intractable despite our GDP setting record highs and AI arriving in order to do more and more work on our behalf? Now, the biggest effort yet to explain our halting progress has arrived in the form of “Abundance” by Ezra Klein of the New York Times and Derek Thompson of the Atlantic. Derek joins me on the [podcast](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=58b7bef5da&e=0f227c2ae3) this week to discuss. “Abundance” opens with a vision of the future. ‘The world has changed. Not just the virtual world, that dance of pixels on our screen. The physical world too: its houses, its infrastructure, its medicines, its hard tech.’ Ezra and Derek imagine a world where people work perhaps 3 days a week because AI is doing a lot of the busywork. Energy is clean and food is plentiful because of advances in agriculture and technology. “We could be making many more scientific advances than we are at present,” Derek observes. “But our researchers are spending up to 40% of their time filling out grant applications rather than actually doing research.” Derek and Ezra have painstakingly gone through the red tape and bureaucracy attendant with scientific research, housing, infrastructure and other areas of opportunity. Their mission is to have liberals focus on results more than rules and innovation more than inaction; indeed, clearing out some of the constraints will be necessary on many fronts. I love that Derek and Ezra, two of the most prominent thinkers of our time, are setting themselves to a big-picture growth and problem-solving agenda. They are actively trying to transform our politics. “Trump is embodying the politics of scarcity,” Derek says. “The abundance agenda can be the antidote and define the next era of American liberalism, a liberalism that builds.” We have definitely been constrained for too long by this tit-for-tat red vs. blue dynamic that is not addressing the true challenges of our time. ‘We are attached to a story of American decline that is centered around ideological disagreement,” is how they put it. Perhaps a vision of abundance can set us free. A lot of people 5 years ago asked me, “Could we really give people universal basic income? Do we have those kinds of resources?” I would respond, “Do you remember anyone asking whether we could afford it when we bailed out Wall Street for $2 trillion? We are the richest, most advanced society in the history of the world; we can afford to address gross poverty, especially because we would get back the investment in people many times over.” In many ways, that was an argument of abundance vs. scarcity. I started Forward largely to free us from this dysfunctional ideological clash and path to nowhere. As Derek and Ezra write, “Whether government is bigger or smaller is the wrong question. What it needs to be is better. It needs to justify itself not through the rules it follows but through the outcomes it delivers.” If we can make outcomes the measuring stick, big things will be possible. There is now a different political conversation getting started, and I’m eager to help it gain power and energy. Let’s do what we can to share it. For the Abundance book, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=21a825113a&e=0f227c2ae3). For my interview of Derek Thompson of the Atlantic, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=2d8ef6f348&e=0f227c2ae3). To join Forward to actually fuel the politics of possibility, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=15939eaaa8&e=0f227c2ae3). The future won’t build itself.
---
| **
Andrew Yang**

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: I know the urgent and daily stresses of working class people because I have lived them.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Did you know that over half of all Members of Congress are millionaires? Meanwhile, the median household income is only $70,784. 👈🏽 **This is wild.**
Many of our lawmakers have no lived experience of working paycheck to paycheck or trying to pay rent working a low-wage job.
To me, policy is personal. When I worked as a bartender, I relied on tips to pay the bills. I know the urgent and daily stresses of working class people because I have lived them. And I intimately understand how important measures like raising the minimum wage, universal health care, universal child care, and free college can be for families living in financial uncertainty.
That’s why I’m in Congress: **to represent working families like mine.**
I am honored to be here, and I can’t do this work without you — the grassroots supporters who have had my back every step of the way. I can’t self-fund my campaign by writing a big check, and I don’t do any donor call-time or exclusive fundraising events.
[We rely completely on small-dollar donors, so if you are able, can you chip in $5 today to our campaign for progress?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250324-3.w35Njy&refcode=em20250324-8427-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8427%2E2526796%2EI318tA)

Yours in service,
Alexandria

It's been one year since the Center for Reproductive Rights, together with the Native Hawaiian Legal Corporation and Perkins Coie, filed a lawsuit to combat restrictions on Native Hawaiian midwifery and [**defend the reproductive autonomy of all pregnant people in Hawai'i.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104448433/535428830/1522809640?sourceid=1150550&utm_campaign=24emfr022412aax&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=hawaii&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1Yjg0MzZiOS0yZTA5LWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qYeKD_lupBSgqoK_ux14vzbVseKHLD9zoMDPT1mdiXw=&emci=fe600e06-2d04-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=5b8436b9-2e09-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=954237)

A 2019 law, intended to address some of Hawai'i’s maternal health challenges, imposed restrictive licensure requirements on midwives. But when the exemption allowing midwives to continue practicing as they had for decades expired in 2023, the true impact became clear:
* **Legal confusion** —vague definitions of midwifery created uncertainty for family members and birth workers like doulas and lactation counselors.
* **A worsening provider shortage** —cutting off access to care in rural and remote communities.
* **Barriers to traditional care** —threatening the network of apprenticeship-trained midwives.
* **Continuing a legacy of colonial suppression** —undermining Native Hawaiian traditional practices.

For **Ki'i Kaho'ohanohano** , the lead plaintiff in our case and a dedicated midwife for over 20 years, the impact was devastating. Since the exemption expired, she had been **forced to turn away families seeking her care _every single week._**

[**_“With this new law, history is repeating itself._**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104448434/535428831/1522809640?sourceid=1150550&utm_campaign=24emfr022412aax&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=hawaii&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1Yjg0MzZiOS0yZTA5LWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qYeKD_lupBSgqoK_ux14vzbVseKHLD9zoMDPT1mdiXw=&emci=fe600e06-2d04-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=5b8436b9-2e09-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=954237) _We are again on the brink of losing our people’s knowledge of sacred birthing traditions.”_
— Ki'i Kaho'ohanohano

Thanks to a court order we secured this summer, Ki‘i was able to resume her practice and support her community. But the order is only temporary and limited. **We’re fighting in court and the legislature to make these protections permanent—and expand them—to restore pregnant peoples’ access to skilled midwives who both protect their health and meet their cultural needs.**

Cutting off communities from trusted care providers and diminishing the value of Native Hawaiian midwifery is not the way to address Hawai‘i's maternal health challenges. The solution to maternal health inequities is MORE choice and MORE reproductive autonomy—not less.

[**Read more about this important case and what comes next HERE.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104448435/535428832/1522809640?sourceid=1150550&utm_campaign=24emfr022412aax&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=hawaii&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1Yjg0MzZiOS0yZTA5LWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qYeKD_lupBSgqoK_ux14vzbVseKHLD9zoMDPT1mdiXw=&emci=fe600e06-2d04-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=5b8436b9-2e09-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=954237)

Onward,

Hillary Schneller
Senior Staff Attorney

subject: Now Available: “Ancient Christianity”on DVD
body:
These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

This sponsored message from Updates for Great Americans is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zk0gmntg5gj6e8ltm9nmalsnlhdc8l0k26jnvse0_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3ie6o71c1h2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zfjh5afhf88849m1h7aj2i7uv71fqkn8he2ap110_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3ie6o71c1h2bs)," now available on DVD.

In this course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways the new faith transformed the Roman world.

Would you help support this course so we can make it available to millions of Americans for free? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you a copy of our beautiful DVD Box Set for any donations of $100 or more.
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zr3brq1orcgob53lmdpjc88u5c0n4qke74g5u6q8_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3ie6o71c1h2bs)

Thank you for your support in reaching millions of Americans with the story of the courage and faith of the first Christians.

Friend,

For decades, Scholastic has been a giant that dominated the school book fair market.

Now, Scholastic has decided to push ideological messaging about gender confusion, explicit sexual content, and politically divisive themes instead of simply fostering a love of reading.

That's where SkyTree Book Fairs comes in.

**We 're the David to Scholastic's Goliath** -- a challenger with a simple mission: provide kids with wholesome, age-appropriate books that are free from confusing content or radical political agendas.

However, standing up to a giant isn't easy...

body:
The Democratic Party is not the party of the people.

| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zub2g41admiah2fkdg4u3sn4hub5hiu7lfq5i77g_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3ie6o71cth2bs)
---
As a black woman who has risen to become the first woman Lt. Governor of Virginia, I've faced my fair share of attacks from the liberal media. But there's one lie they love to tell more than any other: _**That I 'm a "Black mouth" for "White supremacist practices."**_

But let me tell you, friend, being a Black woman is already hard enough, and being a Black Republican woman is even more challenging. None of what I do is a cakewalk, and just because I decided to become a Republican because I saw through the Left's lies does not mean I'm any less black, and I will never let their misconceptions define me or what I stand for.

**So, let me set the record straight: friend:** My husband is black. My children and grandchildren are black. I am black. But to the Left, my skin color means I'm supposed to be a Democrat. When I speak out in support of conservative policies, they question my motives. __They just can't wrap their heads around the fact that I dare to think differently!__

**But, friend, here's the truth:** Being black does _**NOT**_ mean you're required to be a Democrat. I _used_ to be a Democrat. I believed they were the party of the people. I thought they cared about the struggles of everyday Americans, about the single mother working two jobs to make ends meet, about the small business owner fighting to keep their dream alive. But I was wrong, friend.

The Democratic Party is not the party of the people. Instead, they're more concerned with _lining the pockets of their wealthy donors_ , _consolidating their power_ , and _silencing anyone who dares to disagree with them_.

---
I know this because I've lived it. I've seen it from the inside, friend. I ripped the strings of control right out of their hands and told them I was not their puppet, and they're __**STILL**__ trying to smear my name since 1988 - _nearly**FOUR DECADES LATER**!_

I decided to leave them because I knew that the Republican Party is the only party that truly cares about _freedom_ , _prosperity_ , and _giving**every** American the chance to succeed_, no matter their _background_ or _circumstances_. This is the party that gave my family a chance. That allowed me to get where I am today. If my family were to flee Jamaica and come to our country in this day and age, I don't know that we would stand a chance because of what the Democrats have done to our great country.

That's why I'm a conservative. And that's why I'm fighting to win this seat and not let my hand-picked, far Left opponent, Abigail Spanberger, win.
---

They'd rather call me names, attack me on MSNBC, and vilify me in the press - all because I decided not to be their puppet! They've even called m**e a 'Black mouth' for 'White supremacist practices.'** And do you know what I have to say about that? __Let them keep doing it!__ These attacks only embolden me to keep fighting. And I'm not alone. _**[_**With supporters like you on my side, I know we can win in November.**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zuoll51mbmv8gtvql4r5cmt6vcpuk2a86uao04p8_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3ie6o71cth2bs)**_

subject: Now Available: “Ancient Christianity”on DVD
body:
These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

This sponsored message from First Look is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zmbj5em97kc42gk3v1q7168g80b1q8o8bpaduckg_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3ie1or0cdh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z2407ie1hf6cn635hvgjdvnbbp99f92fbhjsirj0_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3ie1or0cdh2bs)," now available on DVD.

In this course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways the new faith transformed the Roman world.

Would you help support this course so we can make it available to millions of Americans for free? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you a copy of our beautiful DVD Box Set for any donations of $100 or more.
[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zu29que1qevblpqrrnsn2b5hmhcnruqfvgf32qdg_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c3ie1or0cdh2bs)

subject: There’s David vs. Goliath in schools
body:
We're the David to Scholastic's Goliath

|
---
| | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zs3bbssjfr7dm9li1b48noaa3jh8s4dg4g2un5u8_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjg60ob6c5h2bs "SkyTree Book Fairs")
Friend,

For decades, Scholastic has been a giant that dominated the school book fair market.

Now, Scholastic has decided to push ideological messaging about gender confusion, explicit sexual content, and politically divisive themes instead of simply fostering a love of reading.

That's where SkyTree Book Fairs comes in.

**We 're the David to Scholastic's Goliath** -- a challenger with a simple mission: provide kids with wholesome, age-appropriate books that are free from confusing content or radical political agendas.

However, standing up to a giant isn't easy...

As the President and CEO of SkyTree Book Fairs, I am on a mission to reach 150,000 students this year with our SkyTree Book Fair experience. To do that, I need to raise $50,000 this month.

[Every time a parent, teacher, or librarian chooses SkyTree instead of Scholastic, it's a stone hurled at Goliath's forehead. Donate now to help SkyTree take on the giant!](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zcom4an68hn0djvjdi0fbqj6s67tst0hsbfdb1qo_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjg60ob6c5h2bs)
[Donate](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z262afad91bb69730jpuq0ujtea0muh1hiplam28_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjg60ob6c5h2bs)
Just like in the biblical story, victory doesn't come from size but from standing on principle.

SkyTree's guiding philosophy is that every child -- regardless of circumstance or socioeconomic status -- deserves access to quality literature that lets kids be kids. We carefully screen every title in our collection to ensure they contain no sexually explicit content or storylines that promote gender confusion.

Giving parents a principled alternative to Scholastic is the best way to put wholesome books into the hands of children and defeat the giant.

Your gift today helps us:

📖 Review 150 new books for wholesome, inspiring content

📚 Keep book prices as low as possible through whole-number pricing
🏫 Get SkyTree book fairs into 400 schools this year

| | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zj0jvlp03o5bc7tl76kb2q6j18ruu0mi79ngh2mo_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjg60ob6c5h2bs)," now available on DVD.

In this course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways the new faith transformed the Roman world.

Would you help support this course so we can make it available to millions of Americans for free? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you a copy of our beautiful DVD Box Set for any donations of $100 or more.

Thank you for your support in reaching millions of Americans with the story of the courage and faith of the first Christians.

But you and I know your ideas aren't old-fashioned or mean at all. They are the same biblical values that made America the greatest country on earth. **That 's why I'm reaching out to you. Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. ** **[**Today, I'm inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children's television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=3097419dd68e4568856c5dc74fa6406f&_e=EoQAXAx9o7bOma6psPABeNCCb4G7fqgRxlcYngs8ZCYev56rnCvP0KhN2867KGJKSQF1PUCwGpvLxKRek5iwJ8AkfHLlFi_B0wspdET0eMr47_osX2b-hj3swiRSZkS8uoPKJGyJuaQdq_vSw2HJP3aZtMG8DxViwtRk9SZo_AgIg1Y_HSyWz3UWuSj-1hzSIPatQBTu3moRQyvpPy1aVUWhpO-Keadi55lRXKSNNso-fi60sbeyhI8ZOxvuPzBXTEBS_8n7ulbDdzW7r1_C7qdPm57HMLRxjtJCkSjN3ntZE4WWs5RI-ClsUifTuE_Azf6OTlg4s6HRmvIzARVccPr05RrMTxF1HiHx-GyODyhdUNQcyWS0bpefCH66EGcEffIL4dB0kL-OxwGAIsvpfX-zZZSU-1AmtJDSyfItkP8%3D)** And it's only possible with the help of motivated Christians who want to see a Christian resurgence in America like you. Introducing: _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_. This ground-breaking live-action television show captivates children... ...but more importantly, it builds their character at the same time. Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth. Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart. Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. **[**Because I can't beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a Founding Supporter.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=3097419dd68e4568856c5dc74fa6406f&_e=EoQAXAx9o7bOma6psPABeNCCb4G7fqgRxlcYngs8ZCYev56rnCvP0KhN2867KGJKSQF1PUCwGpvLxKRek5iwJ8AkfHLlFi_B0wspdET0eMr47_osX2b-hj3swiRSZkS8uoPKJGyJuaQdq_vSw2HJP3aZtMG8DxViwtRk9SZo_AgIg1Y_HSyWz3UWuSj-1hzSIPatQBTu3moRQyvpPy1aVUWhpO-Keadi55lRXKSNNso-fi60sbeyhI8ZOxvuPzBXwefN4RqDYadtAocdPs4MBI7uep90AigjHa9fGla35S07JnlG0AE0kEPrao3z0aV9rbNRfroUEuDC6UXzuXX5lFlZI_8f0oDTXpC7FnAG75-TPesgEcAua5UDROELYhRbiyXV9Zifcbz6sB2TUlAvYCTGdZzhQ30YquT-0xv5EaI%3D)** Season One of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ has ten lesson-filled episodes planned. And each episode costs around $70,000 to produce. I know that's a lot of money but it's actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously we won't work through Hollywood. Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children. We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That's why I'm asking you to contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $70,000 per episode.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=3097419dd68e4568856c5dc74fa6406f&_e=EoQAXAx9o7bOma6psPABeNCCb4G7fqgRxlcYngs8ZCYev56rnCvP0KhN2867KGJKSQF1PUCwGpvLxKRek5iwJ8AkfHLlFi_B0wspdET0eMr47_osX2b-hj3swiRSZkS8uoPKJGyJuaQdq_vSw2HJP3aZtMG8DxViwtRk9SZo_AgIg1Y_HSyWz3UWuSj-1hzSIPatQBTu3moRQyvpPy1aVUWhpO-Keadi55lRXKSNNso-fi60sbeyhI8ZOxvuPzBXDVn13eMCt0KevXaRilv98fnTVaptVXy--eo7fM3oLyjQTKIfAf49eCjRrhHzWiplEsaCdqn6y6sJd3L5JtnW9npm-FLp0WLfFEOOVikOXeWMuNhBpX7X3jzF5u4Z6_0AAPf5GwqsAYnud8C5dDnzMtHb_zqlEbHqWajUi0MDiPU%3D) ** Whether you can send $35, $50,000, or anything in between, or anything higher or lower -- please know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated. ## Journalist Added to Secret U.S. Officials Chat
The White House confirmed Monday that a [journalist was inadvertently added to a texting group](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOqzAQRb_GdBPZYzuQwsVr6PLaLdEA4-BdYyPsJOLvV-zW213pSkdH5-M-3CnEkB7_aWVXfR5QogWpAe0wU4jHYJrZeWZk3bBTrcHu1iprmsV1RtHovZ2JvJWtuslOdm2nbr61WivfBHfSpEarpLTYXUbydEWjRz0qzXoURvIcat4vnzmkurCPR37xfpny2kS31LoVof8J7AX26dhyqeclsD_BAnupz20E9s8Cid9FYF_357pBohpyogiFp-ce6gGVaYWVS6EHz7BFSgV83uHglROUuocvLlAzUI2Uapjg1w1CgmkJ7AX2ze7m7R1iDOXaCiMfK4X4Y1v_qvdy-B0AAP__b6tyeA) chat involving senior national security officials discussing imminent U.S. military strikes against Houthi rebels in Yemen. Jeffrey Goldberg, editor-in-chief of _The Atlantic_ , received an invitation to the encrypted chat on the Signal platform and followed detailed discussions about strike targets and timing before the March 15 military operation. In the chat, Vice President JD Vance reportedly [expressed private reservations](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOozAQBp_GdKD1rg2kcBHpRJdrr0Rre018MiEKFiRvf8r1f_3pG43mz22-cS75sfzmVVxN24yAtgVq0c6Rc_nMpokuiaBQI04PBsfLoK1p7k6nsffgfbrooMdIVni0nizzCL2V0GT3pQGh1QAWx85z4h4NefKahLwyIDHX7dX93fKj3iWVz3bIqwvb2hR3r_W5K7oqnBRO53l23ofvpnB6yLkrnEo-ROEUlgHey7vQsVZF03Pbq6JfvO9SFVq6Bkvc91G3LCa1hji2Hq20QIMJiBA0eIX0_TUvF59nLiXv_aAMLCvn8l-o_hTocPgvAAD__2seZIY) about the strike, noting potential economic risks and questioning its strategic importance. The National Security Council [acknowledged the chat's authenticity](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kE1rhDAUAH9NvEXiS9TtIYdC8baltx4lHy_6SjSSZFf892V773lgGOb7Pt8NRdqXT7OhriHNIKDnQnLoZ28oXrNqvA6IgLJB3Y0Kbm9j16tm1ehRjG60zg2jleDhJk2wNtggvVcQGtIvm5DQd0L0cGutCWYAJa20nURpmRLoqabc_iTa64ohXumJuXVpa6Jeaz0Kk-8MJgaTsW7Hs7RLemEG01eKVMkVBlPNj-3gKQRyZGLhxjnyuFcT48XLajJ6fuGGOz9N5kc0e-FLTo-DwVRqyheTE3kmPzoQnRiEkk3W_jgpRirDyJRYNkPxr6v-9-mp4TcAAP__M3xsSw) and is reviewing how the journalist was included.
## Stocks Rise on Trump Tariff Narrowing
The major U.S. [stock indexes jumped Monday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0j7GOtCAUhZ8GOgxcYPQvKP7Gbrbd0oBcRnZQjN7V-PYbt9_m5CQn-U6-z-fw9Lnk5fXhZ3SU6gASrJBagB2iz-UaDI8uIQJqjk61Brp_rbKGT66V_oEqJrQ6JqtSkIg26DF1nY1dm3h2N01qsEpKC10TfPIPMDrooDTqwIzEmKluzVfNC02YylUP3Jqxzry4iWjdmf7PoGfQn-fZjEsY75FBf6MZ9FLf_Y6d6vgWs9_eSIJq9Jco-UDxvUZPuItmornwzcX1zKXk_dEyI1-zz-X3jv7SPxz8BAAA__8sv1vm), driven by optimism that President Trump's upcoming reciprocal tariffs, set for April 2, would be narrower than announced. Trump hinted at leniency over the weekend, suggesting he might impose tariffs lower than those charged by other countries, easing concerns about a trade war's impact on inflation and growth. Subsequently, the Dow jumped nearly 600 points, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq climbed 1.8% and 2.3%, respectively. The 10-year Treasury yield rose to 4.33%, and Bitcoin jumped 3% to nearly $88,000. Trump also announced a [new 25% tariff on imports from any country](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1uhDAQhJ_GdCCza_4KF2ncXdqUaH2s7zYyGIHvEHn6iPTpvmI0M_q-buONJMry-KSZbQ5pBA1NqbGEZpxI4jmaYrKBGRgLtnVnoB-6ujHF0xLVviX0QxhaaIl0fw_eN54nYkKmQuzVphGaWusG-spToBYMevQ1MnplNE-S01Z9J1nyk0M805u36p7mItpnzuuu8EOBU-CO46heO-U00XkFFLg9p-1U4BY-dgVuTVGy3C-8hhU4jRcbBS5vr3ktM20SQpkklg_ayzcv_PPiSApcDy02BgetOwWu2Oy0HhKj7G2njH7MJPHvVv5P09vCbwAAAP__bShokw) buying Venezuelan oil, alongside expanded tariffs on Venezuela itself.
## List: World's Largest Defense Budgets
The [U.S. maintained its dominance](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LFugzAQxvGngc3InG0gg4cu2dK1I7Ljs7nKwQhfQHn7Ktm7f_p90v_nNt8cZVrTt3ug5VhmkGCEVALMHBzl16zbYCMioGrR9qOG6TL2RreLvTitwyVOU68H3Us_apDjEL0Ej2hAtmTfmlRgeikNTJ130Q2glVe-V6h8oyUG4rJ3v4VWXjDmVzlw7-7l0Wa7MG-1UV8NXBu4nufZHVSfLt_dRuwyVX4PG7hmtyesLAJGXCsK_wwJuQpaBS8ozrLn8EFUKiVlnA9KKzJju9uwnZQz1WFstEwPR_nzzv_VOCz8BQAA__81D2Nb) in global defense spending in 2024, allocating nearly $1 trillion--more than the next 12 countries combined, according to the International Institute for Strategic Studies. China followed with a $235 billion budget, while Russia ranked third at $146 billion. However, due to lower domestic costs, their actual military capabilities could be greater than these figures suggest. NATO allies in Europe and Canada averaged 2% of GDP on defense, compared to the U.S.' 3.4%. [See a graphic here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LFugzAQxvGngc3InG0gg4cu2dK1I7Ljs7nKwQhfQHn7Ktm7f_p90v_nNt8cZVrTt3ug5VhmkGCEVALMHBzl16zbYCMioGrR9qOG6TL2RreLvTitwyVOU68H3Us_apDjEL0Ej2hAtmTfmlRgeikNTJ130Q2glVe-V6h8oyUG4rJ3v4VWXjDmVzlw7-7l0Wa7MG-1UV8NXBu4nufZHVSfLt_dRuwyVX4PG7hmtyesLAJGXCsK_wwJuQpaBS8ozrLn8EFUKiVlnA9KKzJju9uwnZQz1WFstEwPR_nzzv_VOCz8BQAA__81D2Nb). | | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5c8aef022ff146108f3b6cfc0b8802d8&_e=_jIxqJmBiLrFwTxUKt4QZZ_7IsEhTVtxthoVe5V5EoZZFARFL-5CM6Phq87l_qZwOYH07A1-VMYADM8LnHkAjPnvVkcQ8U7EcrKNco30efxf3IEL5eoBHzp6wf5z6cGzYwWoC6vG1Db3jGgW5Avu1egXLk7Sssso_JhX3QWjLz2t82dTBmHj88mLrfNRKJjgjmYxH3VdRiTubHEElDZoAluKFV8LwbkwTQsEsM_Tevk6xcC-p6EcZyF7xMZ_yLEmKgSCng-XP4jWQPvSolq8iNwYHzeNm3WCAvJGiWn-65vxfGFuuP5SyqQ6IsnFgeGbyvjak68ZdhYQ6F_8FXORuMjl01yXH0_SD3PAK9rmWDy8nX3n16n5lZQvUECj7NtqclE9At_iK2gFrbYhHs5hNCM-nKIxTAMSuiWRHfNFwi2OIizChYGXgYKTYuUTxO9n)," now available on DVD.

In this course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways the new faith transformed the Roman world.

body:
The ancient Greeks unknowingly set the bar for environmentally friendly dining: The first napkins were edible pieces of soft dough, which were often fed to the dogs after a meal.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68e9oyls1c5un9lxnphfcecildew8g1q1k0e1tqxsnwgvivsw532h9p8bxbcqp2qfadgeu68hzpcqreh2ug1exafsg8pnd6noqkek7c1zre8yykll3svuwe8nd5264njnmmngm93he0k7edj6&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stofa6&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

# [The first napkins were made of soft dough.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stofa6&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Science & Industry](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stofa6&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stofa6&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| T he ancient Greeks unknowingly set the bar for environmentally friendly dining: The first napkins were [edible](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stofa6&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) pieces of soft dough, which were often fed to the dogs after a meal. Centuries before the widespread use of paper napkins, soft pieces of dough were cut into small pieces, rolled, and then kneaded at the table before being used to wipe people’s fingers and hands after eating. This dough was called _apomagdalia,_ which refers to the doughy bread inside the crusts, also known as [“the crumb.”](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stofa6&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) Eventually, the practice [evolved](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stofa6&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), and diners used sliced pieces of bread to clean their hands... ## Etiquette expert Emily Post sanctioned the use of paper napkins in 1948.
In [1948](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stofa6&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), a New York department store asked author and socialite Emily Post whether paper or cloth napkins were better for entertaining. Her answer? “Fresh paper napkins, of course!” Post published her first book, _Etiquette in Society, in Business, in Politics, and at Home,_ in 1922, and went on to become an authority on good manners and behavior until her death in 1960. So, when she declared that paper napkins were cleaner and fresher than their fabric counterparts, her large audience listened. At the time, the changing social and economic landscape lessened the likelihood of families having a full-time staff available to launder cloth napkins after every meal — which, as far as Post was concerned, was a necessity, as she deemed “soiled” napkins “unthinkable.”

In , a New York department store asked author and socialite Emily Post whether paper or cloth napkins were better for entertaining. | MassGOP Applauds ICE Operation Led by Border Czar Tom Homan, Calls Out Governor Healey's Sanctuary Policies
---
---
| Boston, MA- The Massachusetts Republican Party (MassGOP) today applauded the recent law enforcement operation led by U.S. Border Czar Thomas Homan, which resulted in the arrests of 205 illegal immigrants with significant criminal convictions or charges. The operation, coordinated with ICE and other federal agencies, focused on apprehending individuals involved in violent crime, including drug trafficking, child sexual abuse, and even murder.
MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale issued the following statement in response to the operation:
"This is a textbook example of why it is crucial to keep our communities safe by holding criminals accountable, no matter their immigration status. The efforts of Border Czar Tom Homan, ICE Director and Massachusetts native, Todd Lyons, ICE, and our federal law enforcement partners are commendable. They have removed dangerous criminals from our streets, making Massachusetts a safer place for families. However, Governor Healey and Mayor Wu's steadfast support for sanctuary policies is placing politics above public safety. Their refusal to cooperate with federal authorities is a direct threat to the safety of our residents, allowing violent offenders to walk free instead of being held accountable."
"Massachusetts needs leaders who prioritize public safety and work with federal agencies to protect our communities, not ideologues who allow criminals to remain in the Commonwealth. While Governor Healey and Mayor Wu continue to ignore the danger posed by sanctuary policies, the MassGOP remains committed to ensuring that public safety comes first and that law enforcement has the tools and support it needs to do its job," Carnevale continued.
The operation, which targeted criminal offenders involved with transnational gangs like MS-13 and 18th Street, led to the arrest of foreign fugitives wanted for serious crimes, including homicide. Federal authorities also seized large amounts of illegal drugs, including fentanyl, methamphetamines, and cocaine, further illustrating the risk posed by sanctuary city policies that fail to work with ICE and other federal agencies.
"Governor Healey and Mayor Wu should be ashamed of their unwavering support for sanctuary policies that endanger the lives of Massachusetts residents. Public safety is not a political issue--it's a matter of common sense. It's time to put the safety of our communities above partisan politics," Carnevale concluded.
The MassGOP remains committed to advocating for policies that support law enforcement, prioritize public safety, and ensure that violent criminals are held accountable--regardless of their immigration status.

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 3/25/2025
body:
Profit or patients? The 340B fight that could close Colorado hospitals
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/s3n1ccd639b)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/sbob7e516df)**
| | Hi friends,
There's a lot going on down at the Capitol this week. We'll have some stories coming out today so make sure you're following along on [social media](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/s2s04f96fce) so you don't miss a thing. Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** Budget gridlock has forced lawmakers to [delay the state budget](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/s5k295ceb6e) by a week as they scramble to close a $1.2 billion gap. Meanwhile, a bipartisan bill to protect the [340B drug discount program](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/s2gd022b073) is gaining traction, aiming to keep rural hospitals afloat amid pharmaceutical pressure. Other heated debates include a bill targeting [illegal activity on social media](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/s5t814ba3b5) and a budget footnote tightening control over [future wolf reintroductions](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/s1lfe67c911).
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** President Trump called for the [removal of his portrait](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/sbob359a9c9) in the Colorado Capitol, calling it “distorted” and blaming Gov. Jared Polis. Meanwhile, Democrats were forced to pull false Medicaid billboards after an [NRCC legal threat]().
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Columbia University agreed to sweeping reforms after the Trump administration threatened to pull [$400 million in federal funding](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/s2l0a2d9dea) over unchecked antisemitism. Meanwhile, Trump also announced a 25% tariff on all countries [buying oil from Venezuela](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/scm33f7f887), citing national security and gang violence concerns.
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, March 25, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Profit or patients? The 340B fight that could close Colorado hospitals](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/seo2e4d7351)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/s5pc558b05a)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/sek611fe761)
If Senate Bill 25-071 fails, Julie Lonborg says her neighbor could end up driving from Lone Tree to Thornton just to pick up a single prescription. That’s not some theoretical what-if. It’s a glimpse into what hospital leaders say is already unfolding in Colorado, especially for patients in rural communities who depend on access to affordable medication through the federal 340B drug discount program.
SB25-071, known as the Colorado 340B Contract Pharmacy Protection Act, aims to stop pharmaceutical manufacturers from placing limits on where and how hospitals dispense discounted drugs to vulnerable patients.
Supporters say it’s the only thing standing between local hospitals and a set of restrictions from out-of-state drug companies that could strip millions of dollars from already struggling health care providers.

**[Colorado lawmakers delay budget introduction as they agonize over final cuts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/scm078507f7)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/sfs1a80a66f)
* Colorado lawmakers have delayed the state budget’s introduction by a week as the Joint Budget Committee struggles to close a $1.2 billion gap, debating cuts to education, social services, and state employee benefits.
* A key point of contention is the voter-approved free school lunch program, with lawmakers opting for a temporary funding compromise that may limit coverage depending on future tax measures.
* The committee chose a more optimistic revenue forecast to avoid deeper cuts now, sparking criticism from Republicans concerned about recession risks.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/s4ha1a7538e)**
|
---
**[Colorado Joint Budget Committee addresses wolf reintroduction concerns with budget footnotes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/sbqb83d50a8)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/sei16975b80)
* Colorado lawmakers added a budget footnote restricting future wolf releases until all state-funded prevention measures are fully implemented, responding to concerns from agricultural groups.
* The footnote reflects growing pressure on Colorado Parks and Wildlife to address livestock depredations and improve collaboration with ranchers through non-lethal control, rapid response teams, and clearer definitions.
* A second footnote mandates a detailed report on wolf-related livestock losses by November 2025, aiming to increase transparency and accountability in the reintroduction program.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/sdp28dd7f84)**
|
---
**[Colorado legislature to discuss bill that could remove social media users acting illegally](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/s0tcb525020)** [DENVER7](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-KXmw/scja122efe5)
* Colorado lawmakers are debating SB25-086, a bill that would require social media companies to remove users posting illegal content—like drug or gun sales—within 72 hours.

As we fight to contest the airspace and keep our ads up we are having to pull crucial resources from our field program when we should be rushing more paid canvassers into the field. We've had to spend an average of $55 for every vote we've received \- in campaign jargon this is our cost per vote (CPV). Given that the outcome here may be determined by a few hundred or even a few dozen votes, we ideally need a minimum of 4,584 new votes to win. At $55/vote this comes out to $252k. == | | | | | == | | | | | == | | | | == | | | | We can't be the dog who catches the bus. We've done the hard work of making a historic breakthrough - now we need to capitalize on it if we hope to make this the miracle in FL-06. body:
My message as we enter the final stretch

| | | | [](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/adbJ/?__vbtrk=MjgxNDU1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjgxNDU1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Friend, we are in the final stretch so I’ll get straight to the point.
In **just a few more days** we will know who will win the biggest Special Election of 2025. Election Day for**Florida’s 6th Congressional District** is on **April 1st** and Democrats have already poured in millions to chip away at the GOP House Majority.
They are hoping that Republicans drop the ball in the Sunshine State and**right now the polls are neck-and-neck** because of the war chest being spent against me.
With a razor thin majority in the House everything is on the line. Everything that we fought for in last year’s election may go up in smoke if President Trump doesn’t have allies in Congress to help deliver the America First vision that we voted for.
**We need to stop just watching President Trump and start fighting for his agenda.**
When I get to Congress that is exactly what I’ll do but I need your help to get there. I need reinforcements to get over the finish line and I am humbly asking for your support.
**_[Please rush an emergency donation of $50, $25, or even just $10 to help us close the fundraising gap and ensure victory](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/adbJ/?__vbtrk=MjgxNDU1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjgxNDU1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_.**

[SECURE VICTORY IN FLORIDA](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/adbJ/?__vbtrk=MjgxNDU1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjgxNDU1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
I am truly grateful for everyone who stands with me at this moment.
The support of patriots like you made the difference for President Trump last year and will be the difference between victory and defeat in my race. Let’s finish the fight and get to work saving America.

_Your fellow patriot_ _,_

**Randy Fine** FL-6 Republican Nominee

# The Time to be Heard is Now!
---
| |
---
| The 89th Legislative Session is trudging forward, with bills being heard in committees in both chambers, and bills already passing in the Senate. So many of the bills we support have been referred to their appropriate committees, but **the wait for hearings on these bills, particularly in the House Committee on Public Health, is proving to be extensive. ** In fact, **_sixt_ _een_ strong bills** are sitting in this committee awaiting the chance to be heard in a public meeting. You can **help move these bills forward** so that they have the opportunity to move through the long legislative process before the session ends. Contact Representative Gary Vandeaver, the Chairman of the House Committee on Public Health, and ask him to **promptly schedule hearings** on our _priority_ bills: **Phone:** 512-463-0692**
Email:** gary.vandeaver@house.texas.gov **SAMPLE MESSAGE:** Dear Chairman Vandeaver,
To protect the medical liberty of Texans, I ask that you please set hearings for the following bills: **Print-at-home exemptions -**
HB 730 (Swanson)
HB 1082 (Curry)
HB 1586 (Hull) **Protecting healthcare workers from mandates -**
HB 1468 (Leo Wilson) **Protecting patients from discrimination based on vaccination status -**
HB 1356 (Schatzline)
HB 3440 (Swanson) **Prohibiting Student Exclusions -**
HB 3440 (Olcott) **Protecting Informed Consent -**
HB 3472 (Olcott) **Designating June 3 as Vaccine Injury Awareness Day -**
HCR 105 (Toth)
Thank you,
[Your Name]

# [Elon Musk is a eugenicist](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=158813101&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTU4ODEzMTAxLCJpYXQiOjE3NDI5MDU0MTMsImV4cCI6MTc0NTQ5NzQxMywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI0NDAzOTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.p8hhrpD2pgpQaNDb_ilnyiPigaJzuXDuoVub4hCJ2ck)

I'm incensed by what's happening in Washington, D.C., but I generally avoid writing too much about it because there are already a million takes on the topic, and I don't think people need yet another voice on this. I try not to be alarmist.
But since Elon Musk is the co-President1 of the United States now, his views are more salient than any of us would like them to be.
Having watched Musk, and having studied eugenics pretty extensively in the past,2 I've concluded that **Elon Musk is a eugenicist**. This is as alarming as any other trend I'm seeing today.
[Subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/2a5cd96a-d05a-4ffb-a0c6-342de957dc7c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## What is [eugenics](https://substack.com/redirect/652d7e3f-9f80-4f90-a5cd-155de0b36444?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?
Eugenics is a pseudo-scientific movement that tries to increase the frequency of so-called "good" or "favorable" genes and decrease the frequency of so-called "bad" or "unfavorable" genes.
#### On its face, that doesn't sound so unreasonable. What makes it bad?
Eugenics uses the cudgel of science to allow people in power to strip agency and personhood from people they see as different or lesser.
* The crux of the issue: there is no objective definition of good genes. Someone, usually in a position of power, gets to decide what the "good" genes are. What that often means is that **people who aren 't in their group--often defined along racial or ethnic lines--have "bad" genes**.
* Eugenics has been used to justify all sorts of atrocities. The Nazis not only used it as evidence of Aryan superiority but as [justification for the forced sterilization and murder](https://substack.com/redirect/bc389c91-0922-423f-8f45-ac0c9a6b5c53?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of people with so-called "undesirable" traits--everything from epilepsy to blindness to homosexuality.3
* Tragically, this wasn't limited to Nazi Germany. California alone [forcibly sterilized 20,000 people](https://substack.com/redirect/7dbc9f6a-fd7d-40d8-9b3f-c5d3eb14bb3e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--people who were disproportionately [Black](https://substack.com/redirect/00da1766-07d5-4626-a2a3-526bb2c95e77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Mexican-American](https://substack.com/redirect/54ba7091-312c-4957-8fa1-cd836fbde6b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [Native American](https://substack.com/redirect/4ed09955-3633-44a2-853d-b9d090a0805f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--without their consent and in many cases without their knowledge.4 This happened [across the United States](https://substack.com/redirect/0792698b-3012-4273-a16a-fd028b2fcccb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).5
* Between the '30s and the '70s, "approximately [one-third of Puerto Rico's female population of childbearing age](https://substack.com/redirect/fb7d518f-f4db-4754-809e-3ce1079d62f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) had undergone the [sterilization] operation, the highest rate in the world."6

Because of its indelible connection to the Nazis, the movement largely fell out of favor after World War II.
#### What makes a eugenicist?
Here's the [Wikipedia definition](https://substack.com/redirect/652d7e3f-9f80-4f90-a5cd-155de0b36444?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): "Historically, eugenicists have attempted to alter the frequency of various human phenotypes by inhibiting the fertility of people and groups they considered inferior, or promoting that of those considered superior."
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=158813101&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTU4ODEzMTAxLCJpYXQiOjE3NDI5MDU0MTMsImV4cCI6MTc0NTQ5NzQxMywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI0NDAzOTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.p8hhrpD2pgpQaNDb_ilnyiPigaJzuXDuoVub4hCJ2ck)
## Elon Musk is, in that textbook sense, a classic eugenicist
Using that definition, a eugenicist has three characteristics:
1. **A desire to alter the frequency of various human phenotypes** in order to improve the genetic quality of the human population.
2. A belief in accomplishing that goal by **promoting the genetics of those considered superior**.
3. A belief in accomplishing that goal by **inhibiting the genetics of those considered inferior**.

**Musk demonstrates all three**. For a person in his position of power, this is enormously alarming.
#### 1\. "**A desire to alter the frequency of various human phenotypes "**
Back in 2015, Musk [said he wasn't interested](https://substack.com/redirect/22f8bcce-d253-431f-a92a-56a75fe04ff0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in "genetic reprogramming." Why? "You know, I call it the Hitler Problem. Hitler was all about creating the Übermensch and genetic purity, and it's like--how do you avoid the Hitler Problem? I don't know."
These days, Musk--[salute and all](https://substack.com/redirect/aaaccf42-bdb6-4a6b-ba0a-46c7c96fb1f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)7--seems a lot less concerned with the Hitler problem, and his desire to "alter the frequency of various human phenotypes" goes beyond his [flippant jokes about Hitler and Nazism](https://substack.com/redirect/1c48c22b-e5ef-4098-8ab5-2492264c1161?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* [Here's a Musk quote](https://substack.com/redirect/33b882d1-efc0-4736-880a-3d6d0e43185a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from _Elon Musk: Tesla, SpaceX, and the Quest for a Fantastic Future_ : "There's this point that Mike Judge makes in _[Idiocracy](https://substack.com/redirect/f178fd9e-dbc7-46b1-816f-114cc31a2d4a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ , which is like smart people, you know, should at least sustain their numbers. Like, if it's a negative Darwinian vector, then obviously that's not a good thing."8
* He retweeted a lengthy post about Patrick Collison's excitement about [using tools like CRISPR for literal genetic editing](https://substack.com/redirect/3c08e4a3-2953-4d92-8172-15128440ad2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--a total 180 from Musk's position 10 years prior.
* Most directly: he talks about the need to [supplement human intelligence with robotics](https://substack.com/redirect/9bad9600-e2cd-4d20-9f06-3e562faa2ec0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Does Musk have a desire to alter the frequency of various human phenotypes? Yes--though given advances in technology, this goes far beyond anything that even the early eugenicists could have conceived of.9
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5zYW11ZWxzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9hY2NvdW50IiwicCI6MTU4ODEzMTAxLCJzIjoyNDQwMzk4LCJmIjp0cnVlLCJ1Ijo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNzQyOTA1NDEzLCJleHAiOjE3NDU0OTc0MTMsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0wIiwic3ViIjoibGluay1yZWRpcmVjdCJ9.nTn3tnXB982soRP5Yn-wh4qmIeaaGzylhm-MFT4GWYs?)
#### 2\. "**Promoting the genetics of those considered superior "**
This is the clearest of the three. Musk is repeatedly on the record talking about how smart people and [rich people](https://substack.com/redirect/7bdc1026-90ee-4066-98c1-4b26f21baab9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--[namely, himself](https://substack.com/redirect/d522aaa3-d5c6-4b40-98ef-3daa03dd9859?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--should be having more children.
* Here's a description of [why Musk wanted to have children with one of his subordinates](https://substack.com/redirect/b087ee2b-464e-4be2-8c40-2b6f8f3080be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): "Shivon Zilis...was persuaded by Musk to consider him as the donor, a proposal that aligned with Musk's advocacy for procreation among the intellectually inclined. 'He really wants smart people to have kids, so he encouraged me to,' Zilis said."
* Given how many children Musk has--[more than a baker's dozen and counting](https://substack.com/redirect/2a90c25a-d609-4d24-a8bb-505a5e3d4c64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with at least three women and probably more10--it's hard to be a good parent even under normal circumstances, and his circumstances are hardly normal.11 The subtext is that he doesn't need to parent; with his genes, the children will be just fine.

Does Musk want to promote the genetics of those he considers superior? I think it's safe to take Shivon Zilis' words and Musk's actions at face value here: yes, he does. This one is an open and shut case.
#### 3\. "**Inhibiting the genetics of those considered inferior "**
The vast majority of Americans [agree that racism is bad](https://substack.com/redirect/01100eae-aa65-41ba-9531-13239ec5f286?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).12 I bring this up because even for Musk, coming out publicly in favor of "inhibiting the genetics of those he considers inferior" would be too plainly racist, at least for now.
But the mosaic of information that we have about Musk--statements he's made, comments he's endorsed, views he's espoused--suggest to me two things:
1. I have little doubt that, if the door were cracked open even slightly on this issue, he'd have no hesitation supporting this.
2. Even more concerningly, I worry that his views, and the people he surrounds himself with, will shift the [Overton window](https://substack.com/redirect/5d562f09-f70c-45b7-b0ae-2a963cadceea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and make these sorts of views dangerously mainstream.

The way that Musk talks about people he sees as inferior paints an incredibly sinister picture.
##### Dismissiveness of people he sees as unintelligent
Musk is consistent in his [use of "retard" and "retarded"](https://substack.com/redirect/5b438f84-5dba-4051-9e26-08f798613930?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as insults.13 That has a material impact; [use of those words triples on Twitter](https://substack.com/redirect/14e9f5e1-970a-41a5-a693-edd4a9c02a54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after Musk uses them. More to the point, to [quote an op-ed in ](https://substack.com/redirect/26d2b42d-2271-4594-9720-df1707aaa33b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[The Guardian](https://substack.com/redirect/26d2b42d-2271-4594-9720-df1707aaa33b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ , using those words is "an attack on someone's personhood."
We can write off comments about [IQ tests before posting online](https://substack.com/redirect/1b8dce75-e25f-47d3-8ed9-b80294b9bcde?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as flippant trolling. But [his consistent use of that slur](https://substack.com/redirect/c3bab589-fedf-4639-aebe-a0524a7a7c63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) speaks to something much deeper--especially in this context, when people with intellectual disabilities were so often the victims of early eugenics. Their personhood is [unimportant to him](https://substack.com/redirect/40e8c02e-7cc3-4a4f-8cd5-7e5f933ce36d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
##### Musk's views on race, especially Black people
Speaking of IQ, [Musk liked a tweet that claimed](https://substack.com/redirect/81cf7e96-c5a7-435a-9d6d-525aa448b2b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Black students at [HBCUs](https://substack.com/redirect/9ceadba6-ea56-4fdf-bf60-07cb6fb30906?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) have lower IQs. He [claimed that prioritizing diversity over safety](https://substack.com/redirect/46794f57-5c2a-42c0-a690-3d70a65577d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is the only reason that United Airlines has any Black pilots.
He is consistently skeptical of Black people in positions of power,14 and Tesla has been sued [multiple](https://substack.com/redirect/384dfa89-6334-4fbf-b5ff-3d9d946ff495?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [times](https://substack.com/redirect/611c26d2-dae9-4259-8503-22ee2ec6c7cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for discrimination against Black employees.
One of the first things Musk did in his capacity with [DOGE was to shut down USAID](https://substack.com/redirect/9fd6d49e-17fc-4993-ae6e-85a7c254889b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--a program that [provided food, medical assistance, and humanitarian aid across Africa](https://substack.com/redirect/caf1aa3c-e71c-404c-879d-73ab2da44c62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). [USAID saved millions of lives](https://substack.com/redirect/cccf8f9e-b7c9-4557-ad66-0e277f3e8a2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
All of this paints the picture of a man who thinks little of Black people, creates a hostile work environment for them, and cares little for the suffering of Africans.15
##### Race and immigration
There is one exception to that: [Musk cares deeply about the plight of Africans when they're White](https://substack.com/redirect/d9dc0be2-3a83-4797-beec-4147887f9806?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
At the same time that he's shutting down USAID, Musk has consistently been up in arms [about how White South Africans are being treated](https://substack.com/redirect/c72425da-323b-4979-a067-0d11960ccf6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) despite having much [higher levels of wealth and land ownership](https://substack.com/redirect/d9dc0be2-3a83-4797-beec-4147887f9806?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than Black South Africans, and despite being [much less likely to be victims of murder](https://substack.com/redirect/9356ade0-37ff-40d9-86d8-3f02540aca90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and other violent crime.
The Trump Administration, at the same time that they're [shutting down refugee resettlement just about everywhere](https://substack.com/redirect/2d501c31-ea5d-41bb-9d08-82b51576cf47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), is moving full steam ahead on a [refugee resettlement program for White South Africans](https://substack.com/redirect/c6266ce2-68cb-484b-837d-883dc42921f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
It's all hauntingly reminiscent of [what happened a century ago](https://substack.com/redirect/a4ba4d9c-a439-47b7-b0ca-9e38ac26e019?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): "With the Immigration Act of 1924, eugenicists succeeded in implementing federal restrictions on immigration from 'undesirable' countries."
##### Musk literally hires employees who publicly promote eugenics
[Marko Elez](https://substack.com/redirect/5cb32a3e-8d8f-4707-a67f-07476608b5b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--a DOGE staffer who has explicitly called for eugenics--resigned when [tweets espousing those views became public](https://substack.com/redirect/e3fa3c7f-72ba-45bb-8aed-626b1aad173d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). I wish that were the end of the story.
No, Musk [re-hired Elez shortly thereafter](https://substack.com/redirect/20f2908c-c5bf-4c89-96d2-4a89f130999a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Being a eugenicist is hardly disqualifying in Musk's federal government; perhaps it's a prerequisite.
##### The sum total of everything is frightening
Does Musk want to inhibit the genetics of those he considers inferior?
Well, he hasn't said so explicitly. But a) he surrounds himself with people who do say so explicitly, b) he shares views with some of the most nefarious early eugenicists, c) he openly mocks people he thinks are dumb and disabled, d) he's endorsed views that espouse the [dangers of Jews](https://substack.com/redirect/de030a45-bf9e-4436-b870-6cbc7f44808a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and the racial inferiority of Blacks, and e) the actions he's taking will lead to the deaths of many Black Africans--whose welfare he seems unconcerned with, unlike White Africans.
My conclusion, based on all of this, is an alarming but emphatic yes. I'll let you draw your own conclusions.
## The eugenicists are in power
The irony of Musk's eugenics is that some of his traits--his [battle with depression](https://substack.com/redirect/777f7e97-e506-4ad0-8925-7078304f62c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [his autism](https://substack.com/redirect/69bd802e-7f12-4982-a449-07352dc578bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), for instance--would have been categorized as weak or feeble genes by a different era of eugenicists.
But of course, this gets at the core of eugenics: the people in power get to decide what the good genes are. For Musk, and for all eugenicists, anyone who isn't like him is inherently inferior.
It'd be easy to write this off as troll behavior. It's not. There are things that Musk does as a troll, but he approaches all of this with seriousness. Donald Trump, by the way, [espouses a lot of these same views](https://substack.com/redirect/bcb51848-393b-4592-8d99-bce29e8abf28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).16
Eugenics was, in an earlier era, a harbinger of much more danger to come for people locked out of power. I hope that Musk's support for eugenics doesn't lead to its renewed relevance--and I certainly hope that it's not the harbinger of something worse.
