1
My joke footnote is that I was surprised to learn that the U.S. has something in common with they've-got-two-heads-of-state countries like [Andorra](https://substack.com/redirect/14db24c8-8ed8-4e5d-a43a-70b3f1905ea4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [San Marino](https://substack.com/redirect/f05c262e-8e87-4777-b76d-5fd6807d6bbd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). My serious footnote is that it's extremely undemocratic and bad.
2
My high school was founded by one of the most prominent eugenicists in America, [Ezra Gosney](https://substack.com/redirect/f9a28f31-db4b-449d-a7c5-838b28171bb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In a famous letter to Gosney, [Charles Goethe](https://substack.com/redirect/3cdecc43-2120-4853-bcba-40e864f2915a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (another prominent eugenicist) wrote after his trip to Germany in 1934: "You will be interested to know that your work has played a powerful part in shaping the opinions of the group of intellectuals who are behind Hitler in this epoch-making program."
(People going on trips to Germany in 1934 were generally not up to much good.)
When I was in high school, there was still a building at the school named after him--something a group of us fought to change. There was remarkable opposition to that effort, though the school ultimately relented. As a consequence of this effort, I ended up deep in the weeds on the history of eugenics.
3
"400,000 people were sterilized against their will, while up to 300,000 were murdered under the _Aktion T4_ euthanasia program," [according to Wikipedia](https://substack.com/redirect/bc389c91-0922-423f-8f45-ac0c9a6b5c53?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). For a host of reasons, this is likely an undercount--not least of which is that a lot of this same "science" that was used to justify Aryan superiority was also used as an underpinning of the Holocaust.
4
This was enabled by _[Buck v. Bell](https://substack.com/redirect/667bb1e5-6f00-47f7-a81e-7d9292cc540b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) , _an 8-1 Supreme Court decision in 1927 that ruled that [forced sterilization of people with "imbecility"](https://substack.com/redirect/1637fdf4-e005-4033-93a6-86b131fcedfa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was legal. In a long history of shameful Supreme Court rulings, this is one of their most shameful.
5
Americans were, in many ways, the model for the Nazis--Goethe mentioned this [in his letter to Gosney](https://substack.com/redirect/ca755184-d650-4ef8-ae41-42f31d517575?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that I talked about in the second footnote. There's literally a section, on the [Wikipedia page for Eugenics in the United States](https://substack.com/redirect/8532bf13-9a70-4825-adda-b095190d2c44?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), titled "Influence on Nazi Germany." It's one of our darkest chapters.
6
Many, though not all, [were performed without consent](https://substack.com/redirect/4567d304-278c-4a3d-90f8-4334f6b5a23d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It's tough to get totally accurate data here, in part because many people who got these procedures with "consent" did so with false, misleading, or otherwise coercive information from doctors.
7
To be honest, I don't have a strong perspective on whether this was a "real" Nazi salute or just an awkward hand gesture. The debate loses sight of the much broader problem when it comes to Musk and Nazis. His support for the far-right [Alternative fur Deutschland](https://substack.com/redirect/376688e6-a116-4ca7-979f-7db17a1a55c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [his dismissiveness of "Never Again"](https://substack.com/redirect/b73b772c-ecd9-4e1d-bbe2-bd44b6891212?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are much more alarming to me, and where we really should be focusing our attention.
8
I'll note three things here:
* Later in the quote, Musk says, "I'm not saying like only smart people should have kids. I'm just saying that smart people should have kids as well." I read that less as an endorsement of "everyone should have kids" and more as a rhetorical device. The way I read this, really, is: "I'm not saying _all_ dumb people [defined by me, Elon Musk] should stop having kids, but I am saying that too many dumb people [defined by me, Elon Musk] are having kids."
* The fact that he invokes Darwinism here is itself telling, since [Social Darwinism](https://substack.com/redirect/0ee56349-9e70-4b24-a36e-404a323cc398?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was very much the first cousin of eugenics. Its core tenet, in short, is that differences between nations and races are a function only of "survival of the fittest," and therefore the more prosperous races are inherently superior.
* What he's saying is in line with what the [Human Betterment Foundation](https://substack.com/redirect/3bb47a83-2047-445f-9942-2fdfc7f902ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a prominent pro-eugenics organization [run by none other than Ezra Gosney](https://substack.com/redirect/aa1d5782-a46e-49c6-b7d3-bc0c98f554d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [wrote in 1938](https://substack.com/redirect/40dfd2a2-9317-42c1-a5e9-38f913a9007c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): "Births among families habitually living on public charity are often 50% higher than births among self-supporting families. The families that contribute children to the state homes for the feebleminded in California, are multiplying about twice as rapidly as the rest of the population."

9
It's been [well reported that Musk uses IVF](https://substack.com/redirect/7f14f3bd-7423-441b-a42b-f3d955c0199a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to conceive most of his children. One of his children recently [accused him of using IVF to select for boys](https://substack.com/redirect/6f1b0876-341c-4f78-a3ec-92ce696e9810?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--and it is true that Musk has far more sons than daughters. However:
* [Vivian Wilson](https://substack.com/redirect/915e44d8-4aa6-4aa5-a878-b28fc4822298?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), who was assigned male at birth and now identifies as female, _[very](https://substack.com/redirect/45dc8a85-11cd-4a6f-a34b-4474b51ec54f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ publicly feuds with her father](https://substack.com/redirect/45dc8a85-11cd-4a6f-a34b-4474b51ec54f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). (Musk, for good measure, [said that Vivian was "dead"](https://substack.com/redirect/8faf2ccd-59d0-4dae-9df5-7476105e1a12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because she transitioned.) Vivian may be right--candidly, I'm inclined to think she is--but because of her antipathy for her father, she's not a reliable narrator, and so I'm not using it as evidence to support the point around altering the frequency of human phenotypes. (Many countries, but not the United States, [have laws that prohibit sex selection as part of the IVF process](https://substack.com/redirect/b6d8cf5f-fe10-422a-8bb1-6d0daa108651?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).)
* Yes, Musk has more sons than daughters, but not in a way that's totally out of the question for just random chance. Furthermore, for reasons we don't fully understand, [male billionaires are ](https://substack.com/redirect/7e8f15e9-886e-4937-a932-ff9ec0632b28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[far](https://substack.com/redirect/7e8f15e9-886e-4937-a932-ff9ec0632b28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ more likely to have sons than the general population](https://substack.com/redirect/7e8f15e9-886e-4937-a932-ff9ec0632b28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It's about 50/50 for the general population, but male billionaires have a 65% chance of having a son with any given child, according to a 2009 study.

10
One of the stranger legacies of eugenics is that it gave rise to [couples counseling and marriage counseling](https://substack.com/redirect/5b10b944-2249-430b-9c89-bc84121b2204?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The movement began in Germany in the 1920s and was promoted in the U.S. by [Paul Popenoe](https://substack.com/redirect/3364d92b-9267-487b-a8a7-1893a0cc9ddd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), one of America's most prominent eugenicists. The thought was that it was important to keep couples of "good stock" together, basically.
This is all one big lead-in to the joke that Musk would maybe benefit from some couples counseling.
11
I suspect there are not many parents who tend to more children, more moms, more companies, and more U.S. Presidents than Musk.
12
What the poll technically says: "A strong majority (91%) of Americans believe everyone, regardless of race or ethnicity, deserves an equal opportunity to succeed." (Obviously, the question of _how_ we do that is much more controversial.) I think if you asked the question, "is racism bad?", you'd get even more people saying yes. But this is the closest data that I could find.
13
I debated whether to use the euphemism "the r-word" but decided against it, because I don't know if everyone knows what that refers to. I avoided using the words themselves again when the context became clear.
14
Evidence from [Musk's father Errol to substantiate that Elon wasn't racist](https://substack.com/redirect/7e936a48-d303-4655-b817-2472afa8cc7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) included the following: "We had several black servants who were their friends." Which, if they're trying to argue that they're not racist, doesn't really help their cause.
15
All of us are more than the product of where and when we grew up. But the fact that Musk grew up in apartheid South Africa--one of the most deeply bigoted, institutionally racist countries of the 20th century--does feel salient.
16
What's particularly idiotic about Trump's so-called racehorse theory, among a million other things, is that breeding horse races _hasn 't_ led to faster thoroughbreds. Of dirt track horse racing records that [Equibase](https://substack.com/redirect/93364284-d9d9-4007-a0f1-7a95877d6152?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) tracks, [exactly one out of 28 has been set in the last 10 years](https://substack.com/redirect/a7af5c91-0e96-4d3f-bcd0-c39d2fce36f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). (For good measure, the one record that was set--31⁄2 furlongs, at a [track in Alberta that's since closed](https://substack.com/redirect/03e270c0-3bbe-4bdf-bbf4-d0f7cbc9c449?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--is an unusually short distance that's hardly ever run. And even that was set nine years and 11 months ago. No records have been set since then.)
Compare that to the Olympics, where new records are set all the time, and where there isn't prescriptive breeding. Obviously genetics matter a ton, but it turns out that training, attitude, willpower, and luck (and technology) also make huge differences. [To quote ](https://substack.com/redirect/a5612aa4-e8ff-4129-9a51-cb0d4a8d2d0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[Gattaca](https://substack.com/redirect/a5612aa4-e8ff-4129-9a51-cb0d4a8d2d0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ : "After all, there is no gene for fate."

clean_body: His views on genetics, race, and our future are reminiscent of one of the worst social movements of the 20th century. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more His views on genetics, race, and our future are alarmingly reminiscent of one of the worst social movements of the 20th century. | | | Mar 25 | | | | | | | | | | | | I'm incensed by what's happening in Washington, D.C., but I generally avoid writing too much about it because there are already a million takes on the topic, and I don't think people need yet another voice on this. I try not to be alarmist. But since Elon Musk is the co-President1 of the United States now, his views are more salient than any of us would like them to be. Having watched Musk, and having studied eugenics pretty extensively in the past,2 I've concluded that Elon Musk is a eugenicist. This is as alarming as any other trend I'm seeing today. What is ? Eugenics is a pseudo-scientific movement that tries to increase the frequency of so-called "good" or "favorable" genes and decrease the frequency of so-called "bad" or "unfavorable" genes. On its face, that doesn't sound so unreasonable. What makes it bad? Eugenics uses the cudgel of science to allow people in power to strip agency and personhood from people they see as different or lesser. The crux of the issue: there is no objective definition of good genes. Someone, usually in a position of power, gets to decide what the "good" genes are. What that often means is that people who aren 't in their group--often defined along racial or ethnic lines--have "bad" genes. Eugenics has been used to justify all sorts of atrocities. The Nazis not only used it as evidence of Aryan superiority but as of people with so-called "undesirable" traits--everything from epilepsy to blindness to homosexuality.3 Tragically, this wasn't limited to Nazi Germany. California alone who were disproportionately , , and their consent and in many cases without their knowledge.4 This happened Between the '30s and the '70s, "approximately had undergone the [sterilization] operation, the highest rate in the world."6 Because of its indelible connection to the Nazis, the movement largely fell out of favor after World War II. What makes a eugenicist? Here's the : "Historically, eugenicists have attempted to alter the frequency of various human phenotypes by inhibiting the fertility of people and groups they considered inferior, or promoting that of those considered superior." Elon Musk is, in that textbook sense, a classic eugenicist Using that definition, a eugenicist has three characteristics: 1. A desire to alter the frequency of various human phenotypes in order to improve the genetic quality of the human population. 2. A belief in accomplishing that goal by promoting the genetics of those considered superior. 3. A belief in accomplishing that goal by inhibiting the genetics of those considered inferior. Musk demonstrates all three. For a person in his position of power, this is enormously alarming. 1\. "A desire to alter the frequency of various human phenotypes " Back in 2015, Musk in "genetic reprogramming." Why? "You know, I call it the Hitler Problem. Hitler was all about creating the Übermensch and genetic purity, and it's like--how do you avoid the Hitler Problem? I don't know." These days, Musk-- a lot less concerned with the Hitler problem, and his desire to "alter the frequency of various human phenotypes" goes beyond his . from Elon Musk: Tesla, SpaceX, and the Quest for a Fantastic Future : "There's this point that Mike Judge makes in , which is like smart people, you know, should at least sustain their numbers. Like, if it's a negative Darwinian vector, then obviously that's not a good thing."8 He retweeted a lengthy post about Patrick Collison's excitement about total 180 from Musk's position 10 years prior. Most directly: he talks about the need to . Does Musk have a desire to alter the frequency of various human phenotypes? Yes--though given advances in technology, this goes far beyond anything that even the early eugenicists could have conceived of.9 ? 2\. "Promoting the genetics of those considered superior " This is the clearest of the three. Musk is repeatedly on the record talking about how smart people and be having more children. Here's a description of : "Shivon Zilis...was persuaded by Musk to consider him as the donor, a proposal that aligned with Musk's advocacy for procreation among the intellectually inclined. 'He really wants smart people to have kids, so he encouraged me to,' Zilis said." Given how many children Musk has-- with at least three women and probably more10--it's hard to be a good parent even under normal circumstances, and his circumstances are hardly normal.11 The subtext is that he doesn't need to parent; with his genes, the children will be just fine. Does Musk want to promote the genetics of those he considers superior? I think it's safe to take Shivon Zilis' words and Musk's actions at face value here: yes, he does. This one is an open and shut case. 3\. "Inhibiting the genetics of those considered inferior " The vast majority of Americans I bring this up because even for Musk, coming out publicly in favor of "inhibiting the genetics of those he considers inferior" would be too plainly racist, at least for now. But the mosaic of information that we have about Musk--statements he's made, comments he's endorsed, views he's espoused--suggest to me two things: 1. I have little doubt that, if the door were cracked open even slightly on this issue, he'd have no hesitation supporting this. 2. Even more concerningly, I worry that his views, and the people he surrounds himself with, will shift the and make these sorts of views dangerously mainstream. The way that Musk talks about people he sees as inferior paints an incredibly sinister picture. Dismissiveness of people he sees as unintelligent Musk is consistent in his as insults.13 That has a material impact; after Musk uses them. More to the point, to , using those words is "an attack on someone's personhood." We can write off comments about as flippant trolling. But speaks to something much deeper--especially in this context, when people with intellectual disabilities were so often the victims of early eugenics. Their personhood is . Musk's views on race, especially Black people Speaking of IQ, Black students at have lower IQs. He is the only reason that United Airlines has any Black pilots. He is consistently skeptical of Black people in positions of power,14 and Tesla has been sued for discrimination against Black employees. One of the first things Musk did in his capacity with program that . . All of this paints the picture of a man who thinks little of Black people, creates a hostile work environment for them, and cares little for the suffering of Africans.15 Race and immigration There is one exception to that: . At the same time that he's shutting down USAID, Musk has consistently been up in arms despite having much than Black South Africans, and despite being and other violent crime. The Trump Administration, at the same time that they're , is moving full steam ahead on a . It's all hauntingly reminiscent of : "With the Immigration Act of 1924, eugenicists succeeded in implementing federal restrictions on immigration from 'undesirable' countries." Musk literally hires employees who publicly promote eugenics DOGE staffer who has explicitly called for eugenics--resigned when . I wish that were the end of the story. No, Musk . Being a eugenicist is hardly disqualifying in Musk's federal government; perhaps it's a prerequisite. The sum total of everything is frightening Does Musk want to inhibit the genetics of those he considers inferior? Well, he hasn't said so explicitly. But a) he surrounds himself with people who do say so explicitly, b) he shares views with some of the most nefarious early eugenicists, c) he openly mocks people he thinks are dumb and disabled, d) he's endorsed views that espouse the and the racial inferiority of Blacks, and e) the actions he's taking will lead to the deaths of many Black Africans--whose welfare he seems unconcerned with, unlike White Africans. My conclusion, based on all of this, is an alarming but emphatic yes. I'll let you draw your own conclusions. The eugenicists are in power The irony of Musk's eugenics is that some of his traits--his and , for instance--would have been categorized as weak or feeble genes by a different era of eugenicists. But of course, this gets at the core of eugenics: the people in power get to decide what the good genes are. For Musk, and for all eugenicists, anyone who isn't like him is inherently inferior. It'd be easy to write this off as troll behavior. It's not. There are things that Musk does as a troll, but he approaches all of this with seriousness. Donald Trump, by the way, Eugenics was, in an earlier era, a harbinger of much more danger to come for people locked out of power. I hope that Musk's support for eugenics doesn't lead to its renewed relevance--and I certainly hope that it's not the harbinger of something worse. ? Feel free to share this post with someone who will find this interesting. (If you're reading this email because someone sent it to you, .) For press inquiries, please contact press@ben-samuels.com. 1 My joke footnote is that I was surprised to learn that the U.S. has something in common with they've-got-two-heads-of-state countries like and . My serious footnote is that it's extremely undemocratic and bad. 2 My high school was founded by one of the most prominent eugenicists in America, . In a famous letter to Gosney, (another prominent eugenicist) wrote after his trip to Germany in 1934: "You will be interested to know that your work has played a powerful part in shaping the opinions of the group of intellectuals who are behind Hitler in this epoch-making program." (People going on trips to Germany in 1934 were generally not up to much good.) When I was in high school, there was still a building at the school named after him--something a group of us fought to change. There was remarkable opposition to that effort, though the school ultimately relented. As a consequence of this effort, I ended up deep in the weeds on the history of eugenics. 3 "400,000 people were sterilized against their will, while up to 300,000 were murdered under the Aktion T4 euthanasia program," . For a host of reasons, this is likely an undercount--not least of which is that a lot of this same "science" that was used to justify Aryan superiority was also used as an underpinning of the Holocaust. 4 This was enabled by , an 8-1 Supreme Court decision in 1927 that ruled that was legal. In a long history of shameful Supreme Court rulings, this is one of their most shameful. 5 Americans were, in many ways, the model for the Nazis--Goethe mentioned this that I talked about in the second footnote. There's literally a section, on the , titled "Influence on Nazi Germany." It's one of our darkest chapters. 6 Many, though not all, . It's tough to get totally accurate data here, in part because many people who got these procedures with "consent" did so with false, misleading, or otherwise coercive information from doctors. 7 To be honest, I don't have a strong perspective on whether this was a "real" Nazi salute or just an awkward hand gesture. The debate loses sight of the much broader problem when it comes to Musk and Nazis. His support for the far-right and are much more alarming to me, and where we really should be focusing our attention. 8 I'll note three things here: Later in the quote, Musk says, "I'm not saying like only smart people should have kids. I'm just saying that smart people should have kids as well." I read that less as an endorsement of "everyone should have kids" and more as a rhetorical device. The way I read this, really, is: "I'm not saying all dumb people [defined by me, Elon Musk] should stop having kids, but I am saying that too many dumb people [defined by me, Elon Musk] are having kids." The fact that he invokes Darwinism here is itself telling, since was very much the first cousin of eugenics. Its core tenet, in short, is that differences between nations and races are a function only of "survival of the fittest," and therefore the more prosperous races are inherently superior. What he's saying is in line with what the , a prominent pro-eugenics organization , : "Births among families habitually living on public charity are often 50% higher than births among self-supporting families. The families that contribute children to the state homes for the feebleminded in California, are multiplying about twice as rapidly as the rest of the population." 9 It's been to conceive most of his children. One of his children recently it is true that Musk has far more sons than daughters. However: , who was assigned male at birth and now identifies as female, . (Musk, for good measure, because she transitioned.) Vivian may be right--candidly, I'm inclined to think she is--but because of her antipathy for her father, she's not a reliable narrator, and so I'm not using it as evidence to support the point around altering the frequency of human phenotypes. (Many countries, but not the United States, .) Yes, Musk has more sons than daughters, but not in a way that's totally out of the question for just random chance. Furthermore, for reasons we don't fully understand, . It's about 50/50 for the general population, but male billionaires have a 65% chance of having a son with any given child, according to a 2009 study. 10 One of the stranger legacies of eugenics is that it gave rise to . The movement began in Germany in the 1920s and was promoted in the U.S. by , one of America's most prominent eugenicists. The thought was that it was important to keep couples of "good stock" together, basically. This is all one big lead-in to the joke that Musk would maybe benefit from some couples counseling. 11 I suspect there are not many parents who tend to more children, more moms, more companies, and more U.S. Presidents than Musk. 12 What the poll technically says: "A strong majority (91%) of Americans believe everyone, regardless of race or ethnicity, deserves an equal opportunity to succeed." (Obviously, the question of how we do that is much more controversial.) I think if you asked the question, "is racism bad?", you'd get even more people saying yes. But this is the closest data that I could find. 13 I debated whether to use the euphemism "the r-word" but decided against it, because I don't know if everyone knows what that refers to. I avoided using the words themselves again when the context became clear. 14 Evidence from included the following: "We had several black servants who were their friends." Which, if they're trying to argue that they're not racist, doesn't really help their cause. 15 All of us are more than the product of where and when we grew up. But the fact that Musk grew up in apartheid South Africa--one of the most deeply bigoted, institutionally racist countries of the 20th century--does feel salient. 16 What's particularly idiotic about Trump's so-called racehorse theory, among a million other things, is that breeding horse races hasn 't led to faster thoroughbreds. Of dirt track horse racing records that tracks, . (For good measure, the one record that was set--31⁄2 furlongs, at a an unusually short distance that's hardly ever run. And even that was set nine years and 11 months ago. No records have been set since then.) Compare that to the Olympics, where new records are set all the time, and where there isn't prescriptive breeding. Obviously genetics matter a ton, but it turns out that training, attitude, willpower, and luck (and technology) also make huge differences. : "After all, there is no gene for fate." | | | | | | | (C) 2025 Ben Samuels 548 Market Street PMB 72296, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?

| Peter,
**Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire proudly supported House Bill 10 (HB 10), the Parental Bill of Rights, which recently passed the New Hampshire House with a strong vote of 212-161.**

This bill is now on its way to the Senate, where we expect it to pass easily before landing on the Governor’s desk for approval.

HB 10 ensures that parents remain the primary decision-makers for their children, guaranteeing their right to be fully informed and involved in critical areas such as educational decisions, medical choices, and the overall well-being of their kids.

**This legislation reaffirms a fundamental truth** : parents, NOT schools or the government, hold the ultimate responsibility for their children’s upbringing.

We are optimistic that this bill will soon become law, strengthening the role of families across our state.

Unfortunately, not all proposed legislation supports families in the same way...

**We urge you to take a stand against House Bill 553, a proposal that threatens to undermine good parenting rather than protect it.**
---

---
| **HB 553 would broaden the definition of child abuse by replacing “safety” with vague terms like “** _**physical, emotional, or psychological welfare**_**.”**

This shift could invite excessive government intrusion into family life, turning the Division for Children, Youth and Families into the “well-being police.”

Richard Wexler, executive director of the National Coalition for Child Protection Reform, warns that the bill “ _**provides not one iota of additional help**_ ” to families and instead**risks punishing parents for normal, everyday decisions.**

You can read more about the dangers of HB 553 by [clicking here.](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=2e1279b0d5&e=8c8e704ee6)
_**THE HOUSE VOTES ON THIS BILL TOMORROW!**_

Please take a moment to contact your lawmakers and voice your opposition to HB 553.

Let them know that New Hampshire families deserve support, not surveillance.

**You can find your representative’s contact information and send a message directly** [by clicking here.](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=52bc5f4cd6&e=8c8e704ee6)

Together, we can protect our rights and ensure that parents remain in control of their children’s futures.

The Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE), launched in January 2025 under President Trump's administration and led by the no-nonsense Elon Musk, has been a breath of fresh air for liberty-loving taxpayers. Armed with a mandate to root out waste and shrink the bloated federal beast, DOGE has already uncovered some jaw-dropping examples of government agencies treating your hard-earned dollars like Monopoly money. From underground paper-pushers to handouts for foreign cotton cronies, here's a rundown of the most outrageous ways bureaucrats have been caught squandering our cash--straight from DOGE's hit list.
**A Limestone Mine Retirement Racket**
Picture this: 700+ federal drones shuffling papers 230 feet underground in a Pennsylvania limestone mine, processing retirements with quill-and-ink efficiency. DOGE blew the lid off this relic of big-government insanity, where taxpayers foot the bill for a pre-digital bureaucracy that churns through 10,000 applications a month. Musk called it what it is: a shameful waste of resources. Why are we funding a cave-dwelling jobs program when a $10 app could do it better? This is the kind of inefficiency libertarians have been railing against for decades.
**$59 Million for Illegal Immigrant Luxury Stays**
FEMA's supposed to help Americans in crisis, not play hotelier to border-jumpers. Yet DOGE caught them dropping $59 million in one week to put illegal immigrants up in swanky NYC hotels--while citizens hit by disasters wait for scraps. Musk flagged this as a direct violation of Trump's executive orders, and he's right: it's a slap in the face to every taxpayer who believes in borders and accountability. Why are we coddling lawbreakers with luxury digs when FEMA can't even keep its own house in order?
**$20 Million for an Iraqi 'Sesame Street' Boondoggle**
Leave it to the nanny state to think puppet shows can fix the world. Senator Joni Ernst, a DOGE cheerleader, spotlighted USAID's $20 million splurge on an Iraqi Sesame Street. Seriously? This isn't about education--it's about bureaucrats wasting your money on feel-good nonsense halfway across the globe. Libertarians say it loud and clear: our tax dollars shouldn't be funding Big Bird's international vacation. DOGE's right to axe this kind of reckless spending.
**Pentagon 's $1,300 Coffee Cups and 8,000% Soap Scams**
The Department of Defense's $850 billion budget is a black hole of waste, and DOGE proved it. The Air Force shelled out $1,300 per coffee cup--$32,000 for 25 of them--while Boeing jacked up soap dispenser prices by 8,000%. This isn't just inefficiency; it's cronyism run amok. The military-industrial complex has been fleecing taxpayers for years, and DOGE's audit hammer is finally smashing through the grift. Conservatives and libertarians alike cheer: cut the fat, not the muscle.
**$397,000 for San Fran 's Woke Farmer Fantasy**
The USDA thought it was a great idea to blow $397,000 "educating queer, trans, and BIPOC urban farmers" about "food justice" in the Bay Area. DOGE shut it down faster than you can say "socialist fever dream." This is peak government overreach: taking your money to fund niche identity projects that have zero to do with feeding America. Libertarians don't care who's farming--just grow the damn food and keep the feds out of it. Musk's team nailed this one.
**$3 Million for Uzbekistan 's Cotton Club**
The Department of Labor somehow justified spending $3 million on "transparency" in Uzbekistan's cotton industry. DOGE slashed it, along with $30 million in other foreign handouts, and good riddance. Why are American workers taxed to prop up Central Asian textile barons? This is the globalist nonsense conservatives and libertarians despise--our government should focus on us, not some dictator's cotton fields. DOGE's putting America first, and it's about time.
**$8 Million Politico Panic --Bureaucratic Hysteria**
DOGE claimed it saved $8 million by canceling federal subscriptions to Politico and AP, painting it as a blow against the "deep state media." Turns out these were just standard tools for policy wonks, not some grand conspiracy. The savings were overhyped, but the symbolism? Priceless. Conservatives love sticking it to the elitist press, and libertarians cheer any cut to government bloat--even if it's a bit of a stretch. DOGE's flair for drama here is pure red meat for the base.
**The Bottom Line: Freedom Over Fiasco**
DOGE's crusade against waste is a libertarian-conservative dream come true. From caves to coffee cups, these examples scream for a smaller, smarter government that respects your wallet. Sure, critics whine that Musk's slash-and-burn risks cutting too deep, but the real scandal is how long this profligacy went unchecked. The feds have no business playing global philanthropist or woke sugar daddy--not with our money.
As of March 25, 2025, DOGE's just warming up. Every dollar saved is a dollar back in your pocket--or at least not burned on some bureaucrat's pet project. What's the next outrageous waste you want DOGE to torch? Sound off below--let's keep the pressure on!

clean_body: The Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE), launched in January 2025 under President Trump's administration and led by the no-nonsense Elon Musk, has been a breath of fresh air for liberty-loving taxpayers. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more ? from the desk ofDana Criswell | | | Mar 25 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- The Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE), launched in January 2025 under President Trump's administration and led by the no-nonsense Elon Musk, has been a breath of fresh air for liberty-loving taxpayers. Armed with a mandate to root out waste and shrink the bloated federal beast, DOGE has already uncovered some jaw-dropping examples of government agencies treating your hard-earned dollars like Monopoly money. From underground paper-pushers to handouts for foreign cotton cronies, here's a rundown of the most outrageous ways bureaucrats have been caught squandering our cash--straight from DOGE's hit list. A Limestone Mine Retirement Racket Picture this: 700+ federal drones shuffling papers 230 feet underground in a Pennsylvania limestone mine, processing retirements with quill-and-ink efficiency. DOGE blew the lid off this relic of big-government insanity, where taxpayers foot the bill for a pre-digital bureaucracy that churns through 10,000 applications a month. Musk called it what it is: a shameful waste of resources. Why are we funding a cave-dwelling jobs program when a $10 app could do it better? This is the kind of inefficiency libertarians have been railing against for decades. $59 Million for Illegal Immigrant Luxury Stays FEMA's supposed to help Americans in crisis, not play hotelier to border-jumpers. Yet DOGE caught them dropping $59 million in one week to put illegal immigrants up in swanky NYC hotels--while citizens hit by disasters wait for scraps. Musk flagged this as a direct violation of Trump's executive orders, and he's right: it's a slap in the face to every taxpayer who believes in borders and accountability. Why are we coddling lawbreakers with luxury digs when FEMA can't even keep its own house in order? $20 Million for an Iraqi 'Sesame Street' Boondoggle Leave it to the nanny state to think puppet shows can fix the world. Senator Joni Ernst, a DOGE cheerleader, spotlighted USAID's $20 million splurge on an Iraqi Sesame Street. Seriously? This isn't about education--it's about bureaucrats wasting your money on feel-good nonsense halfway across the globe. Libertarians say it loud and clear: our tax dollars shouldn't be funding Big Bird's international vacation. DOGE's right to axe this kind of reckless spending. Pentagon 's $1,300 Coffee Cups and 8,000% Soap Scams The Department of Defense's $850 billion budget is a black hole of waste, and DOGE proved it. The Air Force shelled out $1,300 per coffee cup--$32,000 for 25 of them--while Boeing jacked up soap dispenser prices by 8,000%. This isn't just inefficiency; it's cronyism run amok. The military-industrial complex has been fleecing taxpayers for years, and DOGE's audit hammer is finally smashing through the grift. Conservatives and libertarians alike cheer: cut the fat, not the muscle. $397,000 for San Fran 's Woke Farmer Fantasy The USDA thought it was a great idea to blow $397,000 "educating queer, trans, and BIPOC urban farmers" about "food justice" in the Bay Area. DOGE shut it down faster than you can say "socialist fever dream." This is peak government overreach: taking your money to fund niche identity projects that have zero to do with feeding America. Libertarians don't care who's farming--just grow the damn food and keep the feds out of it. Musk's team nailed this one. $3 Million for Uzbekistan 's Cotton Club The Department of Labor somehow justified spending $3 million on "transparency" in Uzbekistan's cotton industry. DOGE slashed it, along with $30 million in other foreign handouts, and good riddance. Why are American workers taxed to prop up Central Asian textile barons? This is the globalist nonsense conservatives and libertarians despise--our government should focus on us, not some dictator's cotton fields. DOGE's putting America first, and it's about time. $8 Million Politico Panic --Bureaucratic Hysteria DOGE claimed it saved $8 million by canceling federal subscriptions to Politico and AP, painting it as a blow against the "deep state media." Turns out these were just standard tools for policy wonks, not some grand conspiracy. The savings were overhyped, but the symbolism? Priceless. Conservatives love sticking it to the elitist press, and libertarians cheer any cut to government bloat--even if it's a bit of a stretch. DOGE's flair for drama here is pure red meat for the base. The Bottom Line: Freedom Over Fiasco DOGE's crusade against waste is a libertarian-conservative dream come true. From caves to coffee cups, these examples scream for a smaller, smarter government that respects your wallet. Sure, critics whine that Musk's slash-and-burn risks cutting too deep, but the real scandal is how long this profligacy went unchecked. The feds have no business playing global philanthropist or woke sugar daddy--not with our money. As of March 25, 2025, DOGE's just warming up. Every dollar saved is a dollar back in your pocket--or at least not burned on some bureaucrat's pet project. What's the next outrageous waste you want DOGE to torch? Sound off below--let's keep the pressure on! Check out the website for the latest on government waste and fraud. | Peter, I’ve written to you a lot about the “lemon” candidates that show up on our ballots every general election. These candidates may look like they’re on the side of New Jerseyans. But, in reality, they are on the side of the establishment and will only continue the status quo–overspending, over-taxing, and pushing a “woke” agenda. **But how can you tell if a candidate is a lemon?** Political lemons come in all shapes and sizes, but they share some defining characteristics. And the truth is, there are too many of them in Trenton. How can you tell a “lemon”? **Look for these tell-tale signs.** ❌ Inconsistent – they move from one side of an issue to the other, and back again, depending on the political winds. ❌ In the pocket of the powerful – they don’t answer to we the people. Instead, their allegiance is to the establishment and the status-quo keepers. ❌ Dodgy on issues – they don’t want to tell you where they really stand on critical topics. You have to dig while they bob and weave. ❌ Spineless – when they are confronted with challenges or have to defend their positions, they squirm away. They wimp out. They show their true colors. Now that you know how to spot a lemon, you can help us get these lemons OFF of our general election ballots by supporting the One Less Lemon project. You see, the establishment expects very few New Jerseyans to show up to the June primaries. That way, they can sneak lemons into the general election ballot. And usually, they can count on it. On average _only 22% of us engage in primaries_. That MUST change this year. That’s why OLL is working overtime to make sure more Common Sense voters than ever before show up in June. **Help fund this critical project by donating today.** Every dollar you give will go towards getting out the vote for primaries. And the more voters, the fewer lemons we’ll see in November.

body:
This is a dangerous attempt to restrict voting rights.
|
---

Peter,
The likelihood of the SAVE Act coming to the House floor is increasing, and we need to take this moment to make our voices heard. This dangerous bill could disenfranchise _millions of eligible voters._
The SAVE Act requires that all eligible Americans provide proof of citizenship, chiefly with either a passport or a birth certificate, to register to vote. Over 150 million citizens don’t own a passport, and many don’t have easy access to their birth certificates. This would upend online voter registration and likely make it impossible to register to vote by mail. This would disproportionately impact military voters, tribal communities, rural Americans, disaster survivors, people of color, and working-class Americans — silencing eligible voters and undermining our democracy.
This is just the latest example of a string of schemes to make voting more difficult for citizens. The extremist lawmakers’ goal is abundantly clear: make it more difficult for certain citizens to vote, all while claiming to address very false claims of widespread voter fraud.

clean_body: This is a dangerous attempt to restrict voting rights. | Peter, The likelihood of the SAVE Act coming to the House floor is increasing, and we need to take this moment to make our voices heard. This dangerous bill could disenfranchise millions of eligible voters. The SAVE Act requires that all eligible Americans provide proof of citizenship, chiefly with either a passport or a birth certificate, to register to vote. Over 150 million citizens don’t own a passport, and many don’t have easy access to their birth certificates. This would upend online voter registration and likely make it impossible to register to vote by mail. This would disproportionately impact military voters, tribal communities, rural Americans, disaster survivors, people of color, and working-class Americans — silencing eligible voters and undermining our democracy. This is just the latest example of a string of schemes to make voting more difficult for citizens. The extremist lawmakers’ goal is abundantly clear: make it more difficult for certain citizens to vote, all while claiming to address very false claims of widespread voter fraud. We need your voice in this fight. We know that when we make a splash together, people will listen. Sending letters to the editor is one of the easiest ways to share your thoughts with your neighbors.**** Together, we can protect our democracy. ---
| | "Tax cuts for the rich" is a favorite argument of those who oppose lower tax rates. But does imposing higher tax rates on wealthy Americans actually increase the amount of revenue coming into the federal government? Hoover Institution Senior Fellow **Thomas Sowell takes an empirical approach** in his commentary, [**_"_****_Trickle Down " Theory and "Tax Cuts for the Rich._****_"_**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ziqqcnb3elptbuk2doc7dqge96nnv6c3fg028ucg_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh64p72clh2bs) Sowell separates fact from fiction when it comes to tax rates and uses real life data and examples to prove that lower tax rates for all actually lead to greater revenue for the government. | | **STOP SOROS**
---
Dear Fellow Patriot,Today –- right now -- you and I have our best chance to stop anti-America billionaire and globalist George Soros. **[And it depends on your rapid response to this urgent message – will you sign your STOP SOROS petition right away?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zoljqindg7tc4hr6a8ut5plee8360l62ho3btps8_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh6co74c5h2bs) ** You’re one of America’s most informed seniors, so you know that George Soros has injected his poisonous ideas into every corner of American life: education, media, elections, and our justice system.And the results are disastrous for the nation we love.

Your petition demands that House Speaker Mike Johnson take immediate steps to introduce, advance, and support legislation to neutralize George Soros’ globalist goals. If the Hungarians can get it done, so can we!After the “Stop Soros Law” passed in Hungary, Soros pulled his dark money, equity-seeking, non-governmental organization, the Open Society Foundation, out of Hungary because of the pressure! His open border plans were thwarted.And he turned his attention to us. **Why are we allowing George Soros to sit behind the walls of his sprawling compound in Westchester County, New York, exploiting the wealth he accumulated using our capitalist system...****...to turn our young people, media, elections, and justice system against us??** My fellow patriot, right now the Trump FCC is investigating a Soros-backed radio station that broadcast the live locations of undercover ICE agents who were arriving for deportation operations. **Yes, the George Soros-funded radio station tipped off the criminals!** There are no two ways about it. **_George Soros and his son Alex Soros are enemies of our nation, its people, and our rule of law._** We must make a move against them just like Hungary did.**_And we only have 20 months to do it._** On November 3rd, 2026, Americans head back to the polls for the midterm elections. Chances are good that we’ll lose the House or the Senate –- or both. So to pass legislation, we must move now.Great change comes from embracing great opportunities – and if you want to change this situation where a foreign billionaire is destroying the country we love from within... **[...your signature on your STOP SOROS petition is the greatest opportunity you will have before 20 months is up.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z395fo48mgu0lk5v5jluqpf2kgcaosatrgic6gc8_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh6co74c5h2bs) ****My fellow patriot, my name is Rebecca Weber and I’m the Chairwoman of AMAC Action. ** “AMAC” stands for Association of Mature American Citizens. And our 75 chapters and 300 volunteer delegates makes our advocacy group, AMAC Action, a force to be reckoned with on Capitol Hill.** And unlike the AARP, we’re fighting against George Soros not alongside him.You see, according to public tax filings, over three years, the AARP accepted more than 10 MILLION DOLLARS from the George Soros-funded Tides Foundation.The Tides Foundation says they are on the forefront of “climate justice, racial equity, reproductive freedom” and their mission is “justice and equity.”You know that’s just globalist speak for ‘destroy America and redistribute its power and wealth to radicals.’And listen to this... the AARP once honored George Soros on the cover of their magazine calling him one of “America’s Greatest Innovators” who’s**** “changing the world, $100 million at a time.” It makes my stomach turn to see so many seniors supporting the AARP not knowing it’s under the influence of the radical George Soros-funded Tides Foundation.But today, I’m not writing to those seniors. **[I’m writing to YOU because YOU understand the George Soros threat. And I have faith that you will seize this time-sensitive opportunity to do something about it.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z7s9tro328fsnru4072p6c1v42pksi0eif4f8hdg_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh6co74c5h2bs) **If the AARP wants to betray America’s seniors by supporting dangerous leftists like George Soros, they are free to do so. **But AMAC Action is leading the charge to bombard Congress with STOP SOROS petitions demanding they introduce, advance, and support legislation to shut-down this dangerous America hater once and for all.**** ****And we would be honored to have you by our side.** **[Please sign your STOP SOROS petition right away, and make a one-time contribution of $35 to help AMAC Action collect and send the millions of petitions we’ll need in the next 20 months.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8m7s8be31kbg98689oouij50edmrllai6koqs38_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh6co74c5h2bs) ** AMAC Action doesn’t take a dime of taxpayer funding. And we’re certainly not bought and paid for by George Soros or any of his dark money groups like the Tides Foundation.Our funding comes from grassroots conservatives like you who care deeply about the future of America.We answer to you -- not to George and Alex Soros. With that said, if you’re able to make a larger emergency gift of $50, $75, $100, $150, $250, $500, or even $1,000 -- please do it.**[We have a lot of work to do to STOP SOROS and time is not on our side.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zumovh3k7d998pkgnp0pt1qoo7foocpfbfuhnn7g_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh6co74c5h2bs) **Thank you for joining us in this fight for America.

body:
The best way to not feel hopeless is to get up and do something.

Since the last election, the foundational principles of our democracy have been challenged, and it would be easy to give in to fear and despair. But the change we seek — the change we need — will not come if we wait for some other person or some other time. The best way to make a difference is to get up and do something. | | **STOP SOROS**
---
Dear Fellow Patriot,Today –- right now -- you and I have our best chance to stop anti-America billionaire and globalist George Soros. **[And it depends on your rapid response to this urgent message – will you sign your STOP SOROS petition right away?](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z6m4v7p381rut3temb74g1q0i0s8u8hk1kdkq7h0_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh62pr6c5h2bs) ** You’re one of America’s most informed seniors, so you know that George Soros has injected his poisonous ideas into every corner of American life: education, media, elections, and our justice system.And the results are disastrous for the nation we love.
---
>> We now have a generation of radicalized young people who hate America and American values. >> George Soros has tentacles everywhere influencing the news and information a majority of Americans see and read. Now he even has majority stake in the second largest radio network in America acquired through a shady Biden FCC deal.>> George Soros’ push for the decriminalization of drugs has led to the worst drug crisis in American history. I hope no one you love has gotten tangled up in this! >> George Soros has hijacked our justice system by channeling millions into electing dozens and dozens of hand-picked radical left District Attorneys.
---
This includes New York’s horrible Letitia James who’s now using every trick in the book to try and stop President Trump and his DOGE efforts. But none of that compares to what George Soros and his heir apparent, Alex Soros, are doing to flood sovereign nations like ours with overwhelming waves of illegal migrants.It’s their way of reshaping our population and setting themselves up as the puppet-masters for all future elections. Their ability to alter entire nations is so potent that Soros’ native country of Hungary passed legislation they call the “Stop Soros Law.”The law made it a crime to aid illegal immigration so Soros couldn’t drown Hungary with illegal migrants in defiance of the government and the will of rightful citizens.That’s exactly the kind of common sense we need here. **[It’s why AMAC Action is spearheading this historic STOP SOROS petition drive – and why I need your name on the petition RIGHT AWAY!](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2znar1qqlrffpln2ncbea2778ml91qbj0247n40mo_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh62pr6c5h2bs)**
---
[ **STOP SOROS**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zvptblk4q518olsk1kg3jt17o2mlbgurlmqnrfh8_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh62pr6c5h2bs)
---
Your petition demands that House Speaker Mike Johnson take immediate steps to introduce, advance, and support legislation to neutralize George Soros’ globalist goals. If the Hungarians can get it done, so can we!After the “Stop Soros Law” passed in Hungary, Soros pulled his dark money, equity-seeking, non-governmental organization, the Open Society Foundation, out of Hungary because of the pressure! His open border plans were thwarted.And he turned his attention to us. **Why are we allowing George Soros to sit behind the walls of his sprawling compound in Westchester County, New York, exploiting the wealth he accumulated using our capitalist system...****...to turn our young people, media, elections, and justice system against us??** My fellow patriot, right now the Trump FCC is investigating a Soros-backed radio station that broadcast the live locations of undercover ICE agents who were arriving for deportation operations. **Yes, the George Soros-funded radio station tipped off the criminals!** There are no two ways about it. **_George Soros and his son Alex Soros are enemies of our nation, its people, and our rule of law._** We must make a move against them just like Hungary did.**_And we only have 20 months to do it._** On November 3rd, 2026, Americans head back to the polls for the midterm elections. Chances are good that we’ll lose the House or the Senate –- or both. So to pass legislation, we must move now.Great change comes from embracing great opportunities – and if you want to change this situation where a foreign billionaire is destroying the country we love from within... **[...your signature on your STOP SOROS petition is the greatest opportunity you will have before 20 months is up.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z47qfaki2j2l7o56v0s1pskmddahdntkmggbaqsg_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh62pr6c5h2bs) ****My fellow patriot, my name is Rebecca Weber and I’m the Chairwoman of AMAC Action. ** “AMAC” stands for Association of Mature American Citizens. And when it comes to standing up for the rights of conservative seniors, “action” is what we’re known for.**With its 2 million members, AMAC is the conservative antidote to left-leaning AARP. And our 75 chapters and 300 volunteer delegates makes our advocacy group, AMAC Action, a force to be reckoned with on Capitol Hill.** And unlike the AARP, we’re fighting against George Soros not alongside him.You see, according to public tax filings, over three years, the AARP accepted more than 10 MILLION DOLLARS from the George Soros-funded Tides Foundation.The Tides Foundation says they are on the forefront of “climate justice, racial equity, reproductive freedom” and their mission is “justice and equity.”You know that’s just globalist speak for ‘destroy America and redistribute its power and wealth to radicals.’And listen to this... the AARP once honored George Soros on the cover of their magazine calling him one of “America’s Greatest Innovators” who’s**** “changing the world, $100 million at a time.” It makes my stomach turn to see so many seniors supporting the AARP not knowing it’s under the influence of the radical George Soros-funded Tides Foundation.But today, I’m not writing to those seniors. **[I’m writing to YOU because YOU understand the George Soros threat. And I have faith that you will seize this time-sensitive opportunity to do something about it.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zng83p2t4cavdsrq4n1bg1a8avkbanajbf67omi8_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh62pr6c5h2bs) **If the AARP wants to betray America’s seniors by supporting dangerous leftists like George Soros, they are free to do so. **But AMAC Action is leading the charge to bombard Congress with STOP SOROS petitions demanding they introduce, advance, and support legislation to shut-down this dangerous America hater once and for all.**** ****And we would be honored to have you by our side.** **[Please sign your STOP SOROS petition right away, and make a one-time contribution of $35 to help AMAC Action collect and send the millions of petitions we’ll need in the next 20 months.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z30rr5d71hv8ot5eo18su0l9lr9g7qidjiopvu88_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh62pr6c5h2bs) ** AMAC Action doesn’t take a dime of taxpayer funding. And we’re certainly not bought and paid for by George Soros or any of his dark money groups like the Tides Foundation.Our funding comes from grassroots conservatives like you who care deeply about the future of America.We answer to you -- not to George and Alex Soros. With that said, if you’re able to make a larger emergency gift of $50, $75, $100, $150, $250, $500, or even $1,000 -- please do it.**[We have a lot of work to do to STOP SOROS and time is not on our side.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z7l0inf1hc6c09s9ouc71obq96gjke8lvbahtblg_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh62pr6c5h2bs) **Thank you for joining us in this fight for America.
---
| | For Freedom,
---
**Rebecca Weber,_Chairwoman_****AMAC Action**

During his first term, President Donald Trump made groundbreaking, bipartisan reforms to require hospitals to disclose their prices to the public. Unfortunately, most hospitals continue to withhold vital pricing information from patients. Now Trump is ordering federal agencies to strengthen these reforms. For decades, most hospitals hid the price of their healthcare services from patients looking for care. Without this information, patients had no idea how much their healthcare would cost until they received it. This lack of transparency foisted large and unexpected hospital bills on patients and often saddled them with crippling medical debt. In 2019, however, Trump decided to end this uncertainty and give patients control over their healthcare. That year, his administration implemented a policy that requires hospitals to publicly disclose the prices of 300 common, nonemergency services on their websites. These reforms promised to empower patients to comparison-shop for the best healthcare services at the most affordable price. Transparency revealed that some hospitals charge substantially higher prices than others in the same metropolitan area. Families can review the prices of multiple hospitals and choose the more affordable option. During President Trump's last term, gold skyrocketed from **$1,200 to over $2,000 per ounce**. With similar policies and conditions emerging, we could be on the brink of another gold rush -- but only for those who act fast.

| | **STOP SOROS**
---
Dear Fellow Patriot,Today –- right now -- you and I have our best chance to stop anti-America billionaire and globalist George Soros. **[And it depends on your rapid response to this urgent message – will you sign your STOP SOROS petition right away?](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zc89s26rrt7lt3o8jammtcu6ca7kqrcj22raq4ng_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh6aor4c3h2bs) ** You’re one of America’s most informed seniors, so you know that George Soros has injected his poisonous ideas into every corner of American life: education, media, elections, and our justice system.And the results are disastrous for the nation we love.
---
>> We now have a generation of radicalized young people who hate America and American values. >> George Soros has tentacles everywhere influencing the news and information a majority of Americans see and read. Now he even has majority stake in the second largest radio network in America acquired through a shady Biden FCC deal.>> George Soros’ push for the decriminalization of drugs has led to the worst drug crisis in American history. I hope no one you love has gotten tangled up in this! >> George Soros has hijacked our justice system by channeling millions into electing dozens and dozens of hand-picked radical left District Attorneys.
---
This includes New York’s horrible Letitia James who’s now using every trick in the book to try and stop President Trump and his DOGE efforts. But none of that compares to what George Soros and his heir apparent, Alex Soros, are doing to flood sovereign nations like ours with overwhelming waves of illegal migrants.It’s their way of reshaping our population and setting themselves up as the puppet-masters for all future elections. Their ability to alter entire nations is so potent that Soros’ native country of Hungary passed legislation they call the “Stop Soros Law.”The law made it a crime to aid illegal immigration so Soros couldn’t drown Hungary with illegal migrants in defiance of the government and the will of rightful citizens.That’s exactly the kind of common sense we need here. **[It’s why AMAC Action is spearheading this historic STOP SOROS petition drive – and why I need your name on the petition RIGHT AWAY!](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zm9egmandan5d2vjmfd8c73brviubgqu9c016lf0_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh6aor4c3h2bs)**
---
[ **STOP SOROS**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zbuqpfekmu5veijhsehemae0g4ji124j2s20qgho_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh6aor4c3h2bs)
---
Your petition demands that House Speaker Mike Johnson take immediate steps to introduce, advance, and support legislation to neutralize George Soros’ globalist goals. If the Hungarians can get it done, so can we!After the “Stop Soros Law” passed in Hungary, Soros pulled his dark money, equity-seeking, non-governmental organization, the Open Society Foundation, out of Hungary because of the pressure! His open border plans were thwarted.And he turned his attention to us. **Why are we allowing George Soros to sit behind the walls of his sprawling compound in Westchester County, New York, exploiting the wealth he accumulated using our capitalist system...****...to turn our young people, media, elections, and justice system against us??** My fellow patriot, right now the Trump FCC is investigating a Soros-backed radio station that broadcast the live locations of undercover ICE agents who were arriving for deportation operations. **Yes, the George Soros-funded radio station tipped off the criminals!** There are no two ways about it. **_George Soros and his son Alex Soros are enemies of our nation, its people, and our rule of law._** We must make a move against them just like Hungary did.**_And we only have 20 months to do it._** On November 3rd, 2026, Americans head back to the polls for the midterm elections. Chances are good that we’ll lose the House or the Senate –- or both. So to pass legislation, we must move now.Great change comes from embracing great opportunities – and if you want to change this situation where a foreign billionaire is destroying the country we love from within... **[...your signature on your STOP SOROS petition is the greatest opportunity you will have before 20 months is up.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zoia1jpp5u0g7i59k0aj8nrjcfov281vredfh1t8_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh6aor4c3h2bs) ****My fellow patriot, my name is Rebecca Weber and I’m the Chairwoman of AMAC Action. ** “AMAC” stands for Association of Mature American Citizens. And when it comes to standing up for the rights of conservative seniors, “action” is what we’re known for.**With its 2 million members, AMAC is the conservative antidote to left-leaning AARP. And our 75 chapters and 300 volunteer delegates makes our advocacy group, AMAC Action, a force to be reckoned with on Capitol Hill.** And unlike the AARP, we’re fighting against George Soros not alongside him.You see, according to public tax filings, over three years, the AARP accepted more than 10 MILLION DOLLARS from the George Soros-funded Tides Foundation.The Tides Foundation says they are on the forefront of “climate justice, racial equity, reproductive freedom” and their mission is “justice and equity.”You know that’s just globalist speak for ‘destroy America and redistribute its power and wealth to radicals.’And listen to this... the AARP once honored George Soros on the cover of their magazine calling him one of “America’s Greatest Innovators” who’s**** “changing the world, $100 million at a time.” It makes my stomach turn to see so many seniors supporting the AARP not knowing it’s under the influence of the radical George Soros-funded Tides Foundation.But today, I’m not writing to those seniors. **[I’m writing to YOU because YOU understand the George Soros threat. And I have faith that you will seize this time-sensitive opportunity to do something about it.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ziaa2rf2qh5bfidrhe0b3gmeblebpl38rk4ra5go_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh6aor4c3h2bs) **If the AARP wants to betray America’s seniors by supporting dangerous leftists like George Soros, they are free to do so. **But AMAC Action is leading the charge to bombard Congress with STOP SOROS petitions demanding they introduce, advance, and support legislation to shut-down this dangerous America hater once and for all.**** ****And we would be honored to have you by our side.** **[Please sign your STOP SOROS petition right away, and make a one-time contribution of $35 to help AMAC Action collect and send the millions of petitions we’ll need in the next 20 months.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zgieqlg970t8d40o7n36lk9shmjneq39j75v45og_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh6aor4c3h2bs) ** AMAC Action doesn’t take a dime of taxpayer funding. And we’re certainly not bought and paid for by George Soros or any of his dark money groups like the Tides Foundation.Our funding comes from grassroots conservatives like you who care deeply about the future of America.We answer to you -- not to George and Alex Soros. With that said, if you’re able to make a larger emergency gift of $50, $75, $100, $150, $250, $500, or even $1,000 -- please do it.**[We have a lot of work to do to STOP SOROS and time is not on our side.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zm5rflc7g80s0qrl511h8ust7r249r2pbqlb79r8_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh6aor4c3h2bs) **Thank you for joining us in this fight for America.
---

**Rebecca Weber,_Chairwoman_****AMAC Action**

---

| | Voter Suppression Is Real — But So Are We
---

---
| | We Won't Be Silenced!
---
| | Friend, At a recent town hall, a supporter of Richard Ojeda approached me and — without saying it directly — tried to suggest that I should drop out of the race. He implied that Richard is the only one who can beat Dan Bishop’s protégé, Richard Hudson.
That somehow, I don’t belong in this fight. Let me be clear: I’m not going anywhere. I’m not running for attention or a title. I’m running because the people of NC-09 deserve better — and I’m rooted in this district. My story didn’t start with politics; it started on the land my great-grandfather farmed. I know what our communities need because I’ve lived it. The truth is, that moment reminded me of a much bigger problem — the ways powerful voices try to silence the rest of us. Not just in backroom conversations... but in legislation. In 2023, Republican lawmakers passed voter suppression laws aimed at confusing, discouraging, and blocking everyday North Carolinians from casting their ballots. It’s no coincidence that these laws disproportionately hurt Black voters, young people, and working families. But here’s the good news — they may try to silence us, but we are not backing down. I’m in this race to protect your voice. To make sure every vote counts. And to build a movement where no one is told to "wait their turn" — or worse, disappear. ✅ Make sure you’re registered to vote.
✅ Check your ID now — not later.
✅ Encourage 3 friends to do the same. We’re not waiting for permission. We’re organizing. We’re educating. And we’re voting in record numbers. Let’s show them what the real power of NC-09 looks like.
Yours in service,
Nigel Bristow
Democratic Candidate for Congress, NC-09

name: David Horowitz
subject: the enemy within
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6d4tto9cmd3gvle0qjjtq2qlqt1jv0k34fpfqvg_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh66pb2cdh2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv23otl7bhrkm1o8i8m9a66mtar3rae5ebtodfs0_rp22sh2s8i6eob2cjh66pb2cdh2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---

David Horowitz

* * *
The Republican Party of Florida will promote the principles upon which our nation and our state were founded: freedom, liberty, personal responsibility, and accountability.

Yesterday I wrote about Trump's attempts to deny due process of law to immigrants. Today I write about his attacks on child immigrants.
[On Friday](https://substack.com/redirect/458557f8-8506-44da-a705-370f6062507c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the Trump administration abruptly slashed all legal services for unaccompanied migrant children. In doing so, he cut off 26,000 vulnerable kids from their legal counsel. This will force thousands of children, some too young to read or write, to represent themselves alone in court before an immigration judge and against a trained government lawyer. We cannot sit silent, and we must act now.
**Let 's Address This.**

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5cf7b5c3-2a0e-4365-beb4-31eb76c75801?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## Attacks on Migrant Children
If you're like me, you're disturbed by the images of Venezuelan asylum seekers being deported to El Salvador torture camps in chains, the disappearance of Mahmoud Khalil, and the attempted deportation of Badar Khan Suri at Georgetown. This regime tests its totalitarian tactics on immigrants first.
Now they've turned their sights on children.
The Unaccompanied Children Program (UCP) provides legal services and direct representation to kids who arrive in the U.S. without a parent or legal guardian by their side, often fleeing extreme violence and persecution. In many cases, children make the dangerous journey with an older sibling, grandparent, or unrelated caretaker, who they usually are separated from upon arrival in the U.S.
Unlike criminal court, people in immigration proceedings are not guaranteed a court-appointed attorney, including unaccompanied children. Through the UCP, which began under the Republican administration of George Bush, children's rights attorneys protect children from trafficking, abuse and exploitation. The UCP helps vulnerable kids navigate a confusing and rapidly evolving immigration system by ensuring they also received due process of law. Without this program in place, thousands of kids will be left defenseless, fast-tracked for deportation to places where they face violence, exploitation, physical and sexual abuse, and even death.
## We Need You To Take Action
Now is the time to make our voices heard. Here are two meaningful actions you can take:
* **Raise your voice:** Contact your members of Congress and demand they fight for legal protections for immigrant children.
[Contact Congress Here](https://substack.com/redirect/73c8d949-9acb-4c18-9671-36c26aec280f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* **Give what you can:** Support national organizations like[ Acacia Center for Justice](https://substack.com/redirect/bf77eeb2-eb21-4c32-8aa2-c416a2ed6745?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) leading the fight and[ local organizations](https://substack.com/redirect/7032eebf-6648-4cbd-8a4b-b51334be1763?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the frontlines providing direct legal aid. Fund this work to help ensure migrant children have access to legal counsel.

The Trump Administration is betting that we'll be too distracted, too exhausted, or too hopeless to fight back. Let's prove them wrong.
