| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=c0d8b09a12334c6f8287517a43ac1593&_e=rnSB37j-Sma6557Vgt2thwJXPl3rpoFGGXXEE-Q0dEzirCun90utVbQuugOrWU_ASgwyBwWv_-7armbujy775lx75FtDkXfjUEqfBWz92Q0NQ7ZETT7OGRVcUvnUhWpf5ltFzUj8dA2f7ABBdL8nQ1FEK6gmvBHQiVJ8x6g_ttleBahkmBfyGTSlM9VyU0Ng-_AgYPqdagPSLDpRSQBzJxSbuflvT0rN2rjhKBxh11TiBD1K9clU5Sf2ZfAKnCzsYnxqEESjpXGo2KvtwGMOifQ21sRJpG9eLW5HLPHJ2ymelKVqmaMnJ_DKptQu-khtG6lMnSJgCX0k0Okw7fQ7yH6hhEWRVn-MEnBa9V-HOYofNGb37EsWEIApG5rMDGfkUBDdFZ1X_AA7OYyHA3WqRJprWFN8IHtC4_T8J2QXoe4%3D)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=c0d8b09a12334c6f8287517a43ac1593&_e=rnSB37j-Sma6557Vgt2thwJXPl3rpoFGGXXEE-Q0dEzirCun90utVbQuugOrWU_ASgwyBwWv_-7armbujy775lx75FtDkXfjUEqfBWz92Q0NQ7ZETT7OGRVcUvnUhWpf5ltFzUj8dA2f7ABBdL8nQ1FEK6gmvBHQiVJ8x6g_ttleBahkmBfyGTSlM9VyU0Ng-_AgYPqdagPSLDpRSQBzJxSbuflvT0rN2rjhKBxh11TiBD1K9clU5Sf2ZfAKnCzsYnxqEESjpXGo2KvtwGMOiVUQDnKgsvjU1QNJARrkCaZjiAjCllHrs7kcrvWD20-e7c13j_HTwJTGzCel-q5Ismq8pakZFaKPWwCIPl1OsdQlcu7V7t4tQ2mw6BrdxjcU9CuBK5u7VRNitKYeyvajDKC-WCRXjK2RqdE4HuX3FEk%3D)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.

body:
Criticizing Governor Tim Walz’s liberal policies is easy (and yes, even a little satisfying), but it's not enough. To truly turn Minnesota around ...

| Friend,
Criticizing Governor Walz’s liberal policies is easy (and yes, even a little satisfying), but it's not enough. To truly turn Minnesota around, those of us who want to see change in Minnesota need to offer a clear, bold vision—and I've laid one out.

In my [**latest** _**Duluth News Tribune**_**column**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=2d46cd5e13&e=baf210d431) , I outline specific, practical steps for Minnesota’s renewal:

* **Economic growth:** Simplifying and streamlining regulations to attract investments, boost job creation, and revive our stagnant economy.
* **Public safety:** Supporting our law enforcement and restoring adequate police funding by tying state aid directly to ensuring communities maintain properly staffed police departments.
* **Stopping the Madness:** Ending the crazy things like free college for illegal immigrants, the indifference to massive fraud, and the countless other bizarre policies our government has embraced.

The Book of Proverbs tells us, “Where there is no vision, the people perish.” Indeed. After years of government from the hard left, Minnesota needs a new vision in 2026 and beyond. We need to focus on the policies necessary to deliver renewal, reform, and sanity to a state desperately in need of them.

We want to fill you in on where things stand because you deserve total transparency.
#

We want to fill you in on where things stand because you deserve total transparency.
**Here is the good news:** The overwhelming majority of the American people support commonsense solutions to make our communities safer from gun violence. They like background checks and red flag laws, and they want action on this issue.
**Here is the bad news:** The Trump administration -- as you can see -- doesn't really care about popular opinion. Meanwhile, we're seeing a dramatic slowdown in our fundraising just as we're hearing news about actions Trump may take to loosen our gun laws.
Check out this screenshot of ActBlue:
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar25.KlmT7F&refcode=em250325-1-b&t=1&akid=10213%2E3935704%2EX8SLZF)
The blue bars represent money raised, while the purple line accounts for how many donations we receive in a given day.
You can see the trend. It's not great.
That leaves us with two choices. We either need a lot more individual donations or we need those who've given before to donate a larger amount than their last contribution.
Since Gabby started this work, we've received millions of individual donations. Now we're hoping for even more folks who have never done so before to give to GIFFORDS.
[**Can you please contribute $3 directly to GIFFORDS today? We’ll immediately put it to work stopping the Trump administration from rolling back existing gun safety laws, and making Republicans pay a price if he does.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar25.KlmT7F&refcode=em250325-1-b&t=2&akid=10213%2E3935704%2EX8SLZF)

| | Sometimes, voter suppression looks like a closed polling place. Or an hours-long line at the next-nearest location. Or early-voting sites that aren’t open outside of the work week. And sometimes, it looks like an attempt to overhaul a state constitution when voters are least expecting it. Louisiana lawmakers are asking voters to approve a partial rewrite of the state’s constitution when fewer than 15% of registered voters are expected to show up. **One of those measures, Amendment 3, would give politicians more power to send kids to adult prisons and jails.** Here are a few quick things to know:
* State lawmakers would have a blank check to expand the list of crimes that prosecutors can charge kids as adults for.
* Not even its author can explain which crimes she’d want to add to that list.
* More kids could face unsafe conditions and higher risks of abuse in adult prisons. According to research, they’d also become more likely to reoffend.

Political insiders think they can rewrite Louisiana’s constitution without most voters even realizing they have a say. Not so fast. **In Louisiana, a coalition called No To Them All, Y’all has come together to defeat Amendment 3** and the three other misleading attempts to rewrite parts of the state’s constitution up for a vote March 29. **With Election Day coming up on Saturday, No To Them All, Y’all is racing to get information in the hands of as many voters as possible.** [**Will you split a donation to support the No To Them All, Y’all coalition and Fair Fight Action? | "Cyber charters get a bad rap these days. But switching to a cyber charter was the best decision I made. The 2021–22 school year was the last time I attended a brick-and-mortar school. And I will be forever proud of myself for making that conscious choice to change schools. I live in rural Pennsylvania, in a 180-year-old farmhouse, with my single mother and older brother. The area I live in has more cows than people. Sometimes, the isolation is nice — but not so much when it comes to my education. Aside from my local high school, I don’t have many other educational options..."

# Governor Mike Braun: Trump is returning education to the states and to parents
---
| | **Washington Examiner**
**Gov. Mike Braun**
**March 24, 2025 **[](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/hIRX_KU9vJ7dfTzt4F1XOmGDGdoSWjo0ZPWCXPcUGTs3QB_PfvtLm2V8JsjpY--Zg4_dzOcyNTyLByEftE6X7tkfvlfwoTwVc2ExpkohteGqCiHecqEB_CaQNJJ5AEc7zvRyuZroCW0TLsl28Nhlawvjm0d29kv-plN2_s4GYppgiQiGXwuIklG8gqNGzIhgYs62d-6aOBgIILjFst8IdKAl8cLhKhgcGs5QSLdHTgLCOQw6FDCEd-xEVRzSJpHeP36iNl5Tzj3HH_xV7_lksENNpwl5FskNDbY9fz_L6X_QjHnp7XV1gXVwzmoprXP-4uqpoemq2lurnvC8ORtRycIN0874H2AxzneqECZbuj9oxI5u40th0mlaaiR71Jtls9jxuWdq91aseruDXuvTEw/I-2JcAQdnACPcrJM9_Kxslqy8k0fx1qR/7) [https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/restoring-america/community-family/3354555/trump-returning-education-to-states-parents/](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/6HO6Ej_Lw5N7M8GNcr2aT_bZ0137DahKodw8yHDmmQsZIPwpLCYn3aEe2hs3piaa3LukfjTB0oTaf13rjE0yuhcVR7ZWEYMouUic3GpoxLFK04bjtRv7AOxckstQSCqVRcm0eZ2fmt_XH0Inv6jp8FptFm20zunl6SSwj0oKmqQLoHZ9T1oWaoXOLyshv0yzTinncQCECH4Co14BRejRh_dyyTHmOS0Tmqi6mPVX6qiOMVyp2LrnaWksQFxTaae5HgU4GIXobQr9HQ-9EvBn1FxvcKFZJFW_E7JTslkQxdoe-Bz0zzWJDCqI7drzah8IMzFJsg-NgCEOgKUkiuzvD07eLicuucuIOPfFKvfWKPQvhTHvRBTm24aXzyasQ_P6n3wRRcQ/NY1OtLRLeS3MYF6OTS_FNhhi9T-64wfc/7) Education is one of the most important things we do as a country, but it only works when it’s directed by parents, local communities, and states — not by the federal bureaucracy in Washington, D.C.

President Donald Trump is taking bold action to turn education back to where it belongs: with the people and the representatives closest to them.

The Department of Education isn’t in the Constitution. In fact, it’s a few years younger than the Rubik’s Cube. But over its 45-year existence, education in America has not gotten better. The National Assessment of Educational Progress shows stagnation in reading and math performance by students overall since 1986. We can, and must, do better.

People clearly want their government to run more like a business, where results are everything. I built a business for 37 years, and if a department wasn’t getting results, it was time to try a new approach.

By allowing states to have full freedom over how they spend their education funding from the federal government, we would have 50 laboratories for innovation rather than one top-down government bureaucracy.

Indiana has been leading the way.

Where we had previously been in the middle of the pack on the “Nation’s Report Card,” we are now sixth in the nation in reading, with promising math progress as well.

I assure you that our parents, teachers, and local and state elected officials know what Hoosier students need better than anyone in Washington, D.C.

The closer a government is to the people it serves, the more accountable it is. I learned this when I served on my local school board for 10 years: if you were doing something wrong, you’d hear about it. Someone would be waiting for you after church or find you in the bleachers to tell you about it. That’s the way it should be.

As more and more power over education became concentrated in Washington, the more federal bureaucrats came to believe they were the ones who were really in charge of our children’s education.

When I served in the Senate, I had the opportunity to question Biden Education Secretary Miguel Cardona in the committee overseeing education. I had one question for him: Are parents the primary stakeholder in their own children’s education?

He couldn’t answer it. He told me parents are one important stakeholder in their children’s education, along with the government.

And here I thought that was an easy question.

We should be clear: Parents are in charge of their children’s education. And the closer the decisions that affect education are to the parents, the better off we will be.

By centralizing so much power of education in the federal government, we’ve made our children’s education into yet another political weapon for entrenched special interests to wield against their enemies. In my inaugural address as governor, I said that as Trump shrank the size of the federal government, states should reassert their proper, central role in public life.

Washington has simply become too big and too powerful in our lives, and voters sent a clear message by electing Trump as their president: They want that to end.

By fully empowering the states to decide how their federal education dollars are spent and winding down the unnecessary, ineffective, and politicized Department of Education, Trump is putting parents in the driver’s seat and our children first.

_Mike Braun is the 52nd governor of Indiana. Previously, he owned a business in his hometown and served as a U.S. senator._

| | **Dear Friends,** We hope this message finds you well. The**New Pennsylvania Project** and**Why Courts Matter – PA** are excited to continue our crucial work of providing civic education to our communities. As a voting rights organization, our mission is to offer current, accurate, and accessible information on the importance of voting in every election. Join us for our **Why Courts Matter- 401 Virtual Town Hall** :Date: Thursday, March 27, 2025
Time: 6:30 – 7:30 PM (via Zoom)
Speakers: Kadida Kenner, Founding CEO, New Pennsylvania Project This town hall will focus on the importance of our state and federal courts. | | "Tax cuts for the rich" is a favorite argument of those who oppose lower tax rates. But does imposing higher tax rates on wealthy Americans actually increase the amount of revenue coming into the federal government? Hoover Institution Senior Fellow **Thomas Sowell takes an empirical approach** in his commentary, [**_"_****_Trickle Down " Theory and "Tax Cuts for the Rich._****_"_**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/s/c/GMeG70H_Ps7LZzRWL31ZieEDI9WlKKjfMtUd1KIHA4W5JAxff_BjESMBm53lQ5TPqMRiYUyhySTzvyMDNo5Zo9iCbFwqKYeHG2SSbJ3HEe-n5VXXoK0Q1Iy-Gc7m7OHFzd-QHtiHICKH7xvHzrdtt6UNPT2TKoJt742FIMzwOdnp-vFzN8yNyblavM_VzAVgLBYU32uiLPtY0Zfthmrqg5-65JTHhtnz2yujdkY-ocedswLtohgDagHT0xAtm-sxgQjTcDwcIfxOEUWHxwAdGmhYiY9rwv0gODkYXZoy_ZwzqoItVbNA1perB6xX3qpKCt2u5nKyIE8Xi7headv8PnMMlhTFYZhWbvk_8haMgD1kf56OhPaigZWKRsmCc-5SCxwEbEfkbd9NfXRGAdrlEF7X32vj6NRcBorHP0_9SA/61dXYeTg2zi-kUjmk1KiwubXshyfdfCn/7) Sowell separates fact from fiction when it comes to tax rates and uses real life data and examples to prove that lower tax rates for all actually lead to greater revenue for the government. Former CA GOP Chairwoman Jessica Millan Patterson explains Republican Latino Voter successes
The Latino Vote Podcast Season 2025 Episode 9
| **"Right now, there are more Republicans in California than there were during the Schwarzenegger administration."**

That's just one of many eye-opening observations provided by our esteemed guest, **former chairwoman of the California Republican Party and the first Latina to hold the role, Jessica Millan Patterson.** Patterson reflects on her six-year tenure, during which she spearheaded **voter registration efforts** , expanded **Latino representation** in the GOP, and helped shift the political landscape in the nation's bluest state. Mike Madrid invites her to discuss the challenges of running a state party, the growing influence of Latino voters, and what Democrats may be getting wrong.

name: Mark Kelly
subject: A serious risk to our national security
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
Vice President Vance, Secretary Hegseth, National Security Advisor Waltz, and virtually every single top official in our nation’s defense and intelligence operation shared classified, detailed war plans on unsecured channels — with an unauthorized member of the press included.
#

Two months ago, almost to the day, I emailed you about how Pete Hegseth was uniquely unqualified to serve as Secretary of Defense.
Then yesterday, I learned about one of the most serious breaches of security protocol that I’ve ever heard of.
Vice President Vance, Secretary Hegseth, National Security Advisor Waltz, and virtually every single top official in our nation’s defense and intelligence operation shared and discussed classified, detailed war plans on unsecured channels — with an unauthorized member of the press included.
They accidentally added a reporter for The Atlantic to their group chat.
This kind of stuff would have any member of the military facing serious consequences. It put the lives of the pilots flying those missions at risk. Furthermore, it suggests that everyone involved from the VP down was using their personal devices, which means there are serious risks that our global competitors have accessed critical and classified information. **Bottom line: This was a serious risk to our national security.
**
There are deep, detailed protocols for handling classified national security information like this. Each of the people in this group chat have access to SCIFs, secure rooms where you can safely discuss top-secret information. They each have access to secured systems that are resistant to hacking from our adversaries. There are laws that punish people entrusted with sensitive information like this when it is disclosed to people who are not.
This is what happens when you put deeply unqualified individuals in command. It’s dangerous. It has made each of us less safe, and it is time for a serious reevaluation of the way the Trump White House is doing things.
People should be fired.
But right now, I want answers. If you agree, please:
[**Join me in calling on the Vice President, the National Security Advisor, and the Secretary of Defense to go before the Senate and explain this. We need accountability here.**](https://act.markkelly.com/signup/hegseth_em_signup_march25/?source=em250325-1-f&akid=6015%2E6688874%2ESSGLi_)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.markkelly.com/signup/hegseth_em_signup_march25/?source=em250325-1-f&akid=6015%2E6688874%2ESSGLi_)**
This is important. I hope you’ll sign on.
Mark

Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you, but if you want to, you can [ unsubscribe here](https://act.markkelly.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=1&akid=6015%2E6688874%2ESSGLi_).

Hi Peter, Climate change is here, and our communities are already feeling the impacts. On top of that, utility rate hikes in Oregon have gone too far, which makes us less resilient and safe. That’s why OLCV has joined [Building Resilience](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104484561/535518589/-1480106498?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImYyN2Q4YzY2LTk2MDktZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rjlPhIbn1OL2T5DE8RzzHICIdtbU6UdzgI4z_eHCpBM=&emci=a3d53be2-f808-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=f27d8c66-9609-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=2107230), a statewide coalition of climate justice, public health, business, and labor organizations; and thousands of individual Oregonians advocating for legislative action to promote healthy resilient communities that run on affordable clean energy. The 2025 legislative session is in full swing, and that means the Building Resilience Coalition’s bills could be up for a public hearing any day now! Oregonians like you, as well as clean energy contractors and practitioners, can make a huge difference by sharing your clean energy and climate resilience stories. **We know that when it comes to skyrocketing utility costs, and climate resilience everyone has a story to share. ** We also know that finding your story, crafting it, and sharing it is a skill. That’s why we’re hosting a Storytelling Workshop! At this Building Resilience campaign training, you’ll learn the basics of storytelling, get some tips and tricks, and meet members of our team who are here to support you — [**JOIN US!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104484562/535518590/-790084089?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImYyN2Q4YzY2LTk2MDktZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rjlPhIbn1OL2T5DE8RzzHICIdtbU6UdzgI4z_eHCpBM=&emci=a3d53be2-f808-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=f27d8c66-9609-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=2107230) **Event:** Building Resilience Storytelling Workshop**When:** Tuesday, March 25th from 6:00 - 7:00 PM **Where:** Zoom (link provided to RSVPs)

clean_body: How you can help us fight back against high utility bills...| | | Hi Peter, Today is the Building Resilience Storytelling Workshop, from 6:00 to 7:00 pm over Zoom! In case you missed my last email, I want to make sure you don't miss this opportunity to learn more about crafting your story and get some testimony tips, especially during the Ways & Means Roadshow. Event: Building Resilience Storytelling WorkshopWhen: Tuesday, March 25th from 6:00 - 7:00 PM Where: Zoom (link provided to RSVPs) If you've already signed up, please use this email as your reminder. We are looking forward to seeing you tonight! See you tonight, Sarah Kline (she/they) OLCV Communications & Membership Coordinator | Hi Peter, Climate change is here, and our communities are already feeling the impacts. On top of that, utility rate hikes in Oregon have gone too far, which makes us less resilient and safe. That’s why OLCV has joined , a statewide coalition of climate justice, public health, business, and labor organizations; and thousands of individual Oregonians advocating for legislative action to promote healthy resilient communities that run on affordable clean energy. The 2025 legislative session is in full swing, and that means the Building Resilience Coalition’s bills could be up for a public hearing any day now! Oregonians like you, as well as clean energy contractors and practitioners, can make a huge difference by sharing your clean energy and climate resilience stories. We know that when it comes to skyrocketing utility costs, and climate resilience everyone has a story to share. We also know that finding your story, crafting it, and sharing it is a skill. That’s why we’re hosting a Storytelling Workshop! At this Building Resilience campaign training, you’ll learn the basics of storytelling, get some tips and tricks, and meet members of our team who are here to support you — Event: Building Resilience Storytelling WorkshopWhen: Tuesday, March 25th from 6:00 - 7:00 PM Where: Zoom (link provided to RSVPs) This year, to reduce energy costs and support Oregonians in making the energy efficiency and resilience upgrades they want. One Stop Shop 2.0 (HB 3081) Get the Junk Out of Rates (SB 88) Fully Funding Climate Resilience Oregon’s legislature must take action in 2025 to give more Oregonians access to more resilient and safer homes and buildings. ** | | See you there! No public hearings. **That’s exactly what Elon Musk’s AI company just did in Memphis, Tennessee.** When the city’s grid couldn’t provide enough energy to power xAI’s new data center, Musk’s company took the quickest, dirtiest shortcut by bringing in mobile gas turbines — the kind typically used as a last resort in disaster zones. These environmentally unfriendly turbines are highly inefficient and spew out toxic pollutants like formaldehyde and nitrous oxide. **xAI even set them up without bothering to get a permit or authorization from a public agency. And when they got caught? They didn’t shut them down. Instead, they asked for approval after the fact — _and now they want to add 11 more._** The worst part is that the company is _expanding_ to another Memphis neighborhood already burdened by pollution — from an oil refinery that generates particulate matter, nitrogen oxides, sulfur dioxide, and carbon monoxide, to a sterilization plant linked to elevated cancer risk and a former military waste disposal site. Musk is betting that no one will stop him. Because this is what he does. He infiltrates our government and bends the rules in his favor. He builds his empire on public subsidies, then turns around and bulldozes communities for profit — without accountability or consequences. This is why we have to resist. Imagine waking up to find out a billionaire set up a toxic power plant in your backyard without permission. No warning. No public hearings. That’s exactly what Elon Musk’s AI company just did in Memphis, Tennessee. When the city’s grid couldn’t provide enough energy to power xAI’s new data center, Musk’s company took the quickest, dirtiest shortcut by bringing in mobile gas turbines — the kind typically used as a last resort in disaster zones. These environmentally unfriendly turbines are highly inefficient and spew out toxic pollutants like formaldehyde and nitrous oxide. xAI even set them up without bothering to get a permit or authorization from a public agency. And when they got caught? They didn’t shut them down. Instead, they asked for approval after the fact — and now they want to add 11 more. The worst part is that the company is expanding to another Memphis neighborhood already burdened by pollution — from an oil refinery that generates particulate matter, nitrogen oxides, sulfur dioxide, and carbon monoxide, to a sterilization plant linked to elevated cancer risk and a former military waste disposal site. Musk is betting that no one will stop him. Because this is what he does. He infiltrates our government and bends the rules in his favor. He builds his empire on public subsidies, then turns around and bulldozes communities for profit — without accountability or consequences. This is why we have to resist. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Emily Randall for Congress
body:
So far this month, I’ve heard from roughly 3,000 constituents at five town halls.

| Peter, So far this month, I’ve heard from roughly 3,000 constituents at five town halls. Here are two points I heard over and over: 1\. Trump and Musk’s destruction of our public services, international alliances, and economy is a threat unlike anything we’ve seen before. 2\. **_Democrats in Congress aren’t doing enough. _** I wanted to let you know that **I hear you — loud and clear. ** I take the threats of the Trump administration very seriously. My mom is a paraeducator. My dad was a veteran and a federal employee at Puget Sound Naval Shipyard. My sister relied on Medicaid her whole life. I represent over 27,000 federal workers whose jobs are on Elon Musk’s chopping block. But as angry as I am, I’m also a pragmatist — which means recognizing what I can do IN Congress and what has to happen OUTSIDE Congress. In Congress, my Democratic colleagues and I meet, write letters, and use parliamentary procedure to fight against the worst of the Trump-Musk agenda. It’s slow, deliberative work that doesn’t make flashy headlines. I understand if it feels insufficient in this moment. That’s why this will take ALL of us — not just Congress. We all have a part to play in defending our rights, protecting our communities, and restoring our democracy. So, here are a few things I’m doing OUTSIDE Congress as a candidate, citizen, and organizer: **1\. I’m adopting a swing district!** Starting immediately, we will direct our grassroots energy from Washington’s 6th District to Arizona’s 6th District. The Republican incumbent, Juan Ciscomani, has voted in lockstep with Trump and Musk, even though he won by only 2.5% in 2024 and only 1.5% in 2022. I’m very excited about this new effort — stay tuned for more updates! **2\. I’m hiring a Political Director.** There are limits to what Congressional staff can do politically since they are paid by your tax dollars (yes, we care about ethics!). So, our campaign is hiring a new staffer to work outside the halls of Congress to strengthen our organizing locally and in our adopted swing district. **3\. I’m exploring holding events outside the district.** Democrats are planning [_**People’s Town Halls**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104489074/535523438/1165129692?refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.03.25_Longer_X2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjUwYmIyNS05YTA5LWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AWa2bSXjkkB5Z-r1rehx-x6cr1Wstnn3feqCPrpBavA=&emci=a617c6ca-1b09-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=af50bb25-9a09-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=23483442) in districts where Republican representatives refuse to hold public events. I’m working with DCCC Chair Suzan DelBene and other colleagues to determine my role in this new project. Now, this is the part where I ask you for a donation. These political initiatives cost money, so I’m launching a new _**We Can’t Wait**_ fund to fuel grassroots organizing locally, support our adopted swing district, and put pressure on Republicans in every way we can. During the 2024 campaign, I bet on our powerhouse team of grassroots donors again and again — and you ALWAYS delivered. I know that together, we can meet whatever challenge the Trump administration throws at us. [_**Can you chip in $6 or any amount to support our organizing in the 6th District and beyond?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104489079/535523460/1947289852?amount=6&refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.03.25_Longer_X2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjUwYmIyNS05YTA5LWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AWa2bSXjkkB5Z-r1rehx-x6cr1Wstnn3feqCPrpBavA=) [CONTRIBUTE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104489083/535523478/1947289852?amount=6&refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.03.25_Longer_X2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjUwYmIyNS05YTA5LWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AWa2bSXjkkB5Z-r1rehx-x6cr1Wstnn3feqCPrpBavA=) Thank you for reading this longer-than-usual message. | | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don't say this to shock or scare you - I say it because it's true. _What we see today didn 't happen overnight. It's the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **... and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I'd know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ - radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my "comrades" made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan - then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I've dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn't tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That's why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** - and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I'm asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I'll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=e16640073465450e94abcf3b70103a59&_e=4TEYy9LV36hg6CYHMVRucFYCL_FrouPMOVi4Ou-Go2rggV1Ung8AqGm5jfFDBVb_7m9YDLHMXpd5JSblpdTxiDtq2qpstgc4sg2zkTBiYoSs2P7SaPqbNS0mH3bqjM_77kLMf6zx4-R9c6RaBpr3Yl8sQLw3j-2SXp0MVcyxssvYPWIBpnxFwQoXLaZaB5bs1G2dSadqora-ahoDJPCL9AWwHwGJZYJSEVv8XvYmp2zzmg5yoA7tpaIAMVFXODRFbkK7miFhsSPBVaF47nKTPmCUx9CL_l921oki7N9855Ql6VkUbDuEb6HbE2GmEYufQ6vJq0RyIfCaA9HH1QGn1IrVHDnXAXcxrIgS8wachx1g7Jjhz9rC3eVykiUk7mLU5AEjhruIbtHYrJoT2kXZwA-VsFVLtwUjLI01br6cO5-KiNBNaK150eAMPUIOQnOE)** When you think of "the enemy within" you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn't be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we've seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making - but most of the American people have no clue what we're up against. **That 's why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state - and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as "white supremacists" and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... But Hegseth chose to ignore them. And his laziness and carelessness could have led to catastrophic results. And this is just the one we know about. What other secrets has Hegseth put out there? And are they already in enemy hands Hegseth was wildly unqualified when he first got the job, and now he’s shown himself to be a clear and present danger to our troops. body:
Are you kidding me? The editor-in-chief of _The Atlantic_ revealed he was accidentally included in a highly sensitive Trump administration Signal chat with the Vice President, National Security Advisor, Secretary of Defense, CIA Director, and others where they were planning airstrikes in Yemen.

**This isn’t just incompetence—it’s an outrageous national security breach. Heads should roll.**

Let’s be clear about what happened: politicians were gaming out sensitive (and probably classified) foreign policy and war plans via text—when they accidentally added a reporter to the chat.

It put our troops in danger. It made a mockery of military strategy. It exposed our secrets to foreign adversaries.

And when Donald Trump was asked about this egregious error? He said: “I know nothing about it. You’re saying that they had what?”

Yeah. The Commander-in-Chief can’t even be bothered to acknowledge that his administration is conducting classified _military operations_ in a casual group chat. It’s unbelievable.

There must be a full investigation and hearings in the House Armed Services Committee—immediately. We need accountability for this recklessness. If I had done this as a junior naval officer, you better believe I’d have faced harsh punishment.

And yes, heads should roll. body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025]
Friends, you’ve likely seen the explosive news story about Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, Vice President JD Vance, and more than a dozen other national security officials sharing sensitive, classified intelligence in a group chat on the unclassified messaging app Signal.
The Atlantic headline: ''The Trump Administration Accidentally Texted Me Its War Plans'' [https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/703943787761614D4C7163644735773273666D6775335678492B7346714F3966552B563770323262683661454B4D7336346469534E694E37666145756E446E4C/editor_images/Screenshot%202025-03-25%20at%2012.33.52%E2%80%AFPM.png]
I’m gravely concerned by these reports. These conversations not only appeared to be in violation of basic security protocols, they included a reporter in the group chat — apparently inadvertently.
The entire debacle demonstrates an astonishingly cavalier attitude towards our national security and is an egregious breach of public trust.
This goes beyond incompetence — it shows an appalling carelessness for the lives of servicemembers and intelligence professionals involved in protecting our country and acting on our national interests.
I’ve written a letter to President Trump, alongside 13 of my Senate colleagues, demanding answers.
We want the President to tell us: What disciplinary action will be taken against those involved in this recklessness? Will their security clearances be revoked? What other sensitive military information has been coordinated in group chats like this one? Donald Trump’s tariffs are bad news for _everyone_ , and now, economists are warning they could cause stagflation.
Stagflation is what happens when we have both inflation (higher costs) and a stagnant economy (high unemployment, low growth).
**These two things don’t normally happen at the same time, but with an external shock like tariffs we’re at real risk of experiencing stagflation.** Inflation, like we’ve seen over the past few years, is normally accompanied by low unemployment and often occurs when people have extra money to spend. A stagnant economy on the other hand, usually means prices drop.
**But with stagflation, we have the worse of both worlds. It’s a devastating combo for people and businesses.**

name: Save the Redwoods League
subject: New CEO chosen to lead the League
body:
Join us in welcoming Steve Mietz

| | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104494101/535532311/779512579?utm_campaign=an-ceo-032525&utm_source=ea-pr&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZkNjA3Y2NmLTllMDktZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=_mVVsbP8p7EZctCMd1xC6qTf0OmM-Cp5Sv40PORP2Ag=&emci=d3bdf591-4408-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=fd607ccf-9e09-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=1504551)
---
| | Dear Peter,
---
We have exciting news to share—and wanted you to hear it first.

We are pleased to announce that conservation leader **Steve Mietz** will join Save the Redwoods League as our new president and CEO on April 28. Steve brings extensive experience in redwood forest restoration, expertise in building strong coalitions, and an inspiring leadership style that will drive the League’s bold conservation vision in the years ahead.

“Over the past decade, I have become an unapologetic champion for the redwoods,” says Steve. “I am inspired to focus all my energy on healing the forest and advancing the League’s high-impact goals amid the unique challenges and opportunities of our times.”
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104494102/535532312/-583221787?utm_campaign=an-ceo-032525&utm_source=ea-pr&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZkNjA3Y2NmLTllMDktZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=_mVVsbP8p7EZctCMd1xC6qTf0OmM-Cp5Sv40PORP2Ag=&emci=d3bdf591-4408-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=fd607ccf-9e09-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=1504551)
Steve Mietz, Save the Redwoods League’s next CEO and president.
Photo by Max Whittaker.
A veteran of the National Park Service, Steve Mietz (pronounced “Mets”) has held leadership positions at national parks across the country. He has led particularly innovative and impactful work in the fog-shrouded forests of Redwood National and State Parks, where he served as superintendent for nearly eight years. He guided large-scale landscape projects, oversaw scientific research, and managed hundreds of employees serving thousands of acres and millions of visitors annually. In 2022, he was honored as Superintendent of the Year for Natural Resource Stewardship, in recognition of those who “go above and beyond in their duties toward resource protection.”

Steve has proven himself a trusted, visionary partner on key projects with Save the Redwoods League. He helped spearhead [Redwoods Rising](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104494103/535532313/-463667376?utm_campaign=an-ceo-032525&utm_source=ea-pr&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZkNjA3Y2NmLTllMDktZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=_mVVsbP8p7EZctCMd1xC6qTf0OmM-Cp5Sv40PORP2Ag=&emci=d3bdf591-4408-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=fd607ccf-9e09-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=1504551), an ambitious collaboration with the League and California State Parks that is breathing new life into 70,000 acres of previously logged redwood forest. He also built important tribal relationships, working with the Yurok Tribe, the League, and State Parks to establish a groundbreaking model for Indigenous land management at [‘O Rew Redwoods Gateway](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104494104/535532314/-1245812088?utm_campaign=an-ceo-032525&utm_source=ea-pr&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZkNjA3Y2NmLTllMDktZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=_mVVsbP8p7EZctCMd1xC6qTf0OmM-Cp5Sv40PORP2Ag=&emci=d3bdf591-4408-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=fd607ccf-9e09-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=1504551).

Steve’s ability to cultivate meaningful partnerships and his audacious optimism about what is possible make him an ideal leader to navigate the ever-changing conservation landscape. He joins the League as we are poised to accelerate the pace and scale of redwood conservation, building on our broad public support, a robust ecosystem of partners, a strong financial position, and a clear vision for success. His predecessor, Sam Hodder, will step down March 31 after 11 years of dedicated service.

Steve was the board’s unanimous choice for CEO, and we are thrilled to have someone with his entrepreneurial vision, incredible track record of leadership, and passionate commitment to conservation. The League will benefit enormously from his extensive relationships with government agencies, tribal groups, and redwood landowners, as well as his deep expertise in redwood forest management and restoration. He will be instrumental not only in preserving our ancient forests, but in restoring resilience and beauty across the redwood range.

Please join us in warmly welcoming Steve Mietz to our redwood community.
| Sara Clark
Board Chair
Save the Redwoods League | Rosemary Cameron
Board Vice Chair
Save the Redwoods League

Voter Action Project
CFPM: Florida holds special primary election to fill vacancies in U.S. House
There are two big states holding special elections next week on April 1, Team. The state of Florida is holding a special election to fill vacancies in the U.S. House of Representatives, following cabinet nominations by President Donald Trump.
Why are these special elections important? Opponents of voting rights hold a 3 seat majority -- 218 to 215 -- in the House. One media report after another tells the tale -- Speaker Mike Johnson is having a hard time wrangling them all to vote for his priorities, and any dent made in that majority will make it harder for them to pass bills that harm voting rights this year or next.
It all starts with the American Confidence in Elections (ACE) Act which would nationalize voter suppression and the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act, which would add onerous voter ID requirements, potentially disenfranchising millions of married women who changed their last names. Those bills are just the tip of the suppressive iceberg, with many in Congress looking to follow the election lies to policies that disenfranchise voters and make Trump happy.
We can stop all that with huge voter turnout in these Florida specials. But we need your help to make voters in Florida aware of these special elections, when early voting starts, how to request a new mail-in ballot, and so much more.

Hi Peter!
Team Kelly here and we’ll get right to the point.
These are challenging times. The campaign continues to be present throughout the district, and we are hearing from voters every single day. They are worried about this administration. They are worried about their neighbors and their loved ones, both here and abroad. They are worried about their jobs, about their healthcare, and about the future for their children.
We cannot emphasize enough how important it is to stay engaged, speak out, and contact your elected leaders. Public pressure works, and as Kelly always says, we are not powerless !
We also wanted to share a clip of Kelly’s interview with Ali Velshi on MSNBC last week [https://www.msnbc.com/the-last-word/watch/-we-are-not-powerless-voters-are-fired-up-at-town-halls-across-the-country-235004485888] - almost 2,000 people showed up for her town hall to express their anger, frustration and fear about the actions of this administration, and the theme we heard over and over again that evening was “Trump is failing.”
https://www.msnbc.com/the-last-word/watch/-we-are-not-powerless-voters-are-fired-up-at-town-halls-across-the-country-235004485888 [https://www.msnbc.com/the-last-word/watch/-we-are-not-powerless-voters-are-fired-up-at-town-halls-across-the-country-235004485888]

They are threatening to gut Medicaid, medical research, the VA, and the Department of Education. They are threatening the free press and the independence of the judicial branch. They are undoing alliances that have kept us out of world war for 80 years. They have fired thousands of Veterans and other vital public servants. They are destroying environmental protections and taking us down a path of accelerating climate change. And we aren’t even 100 days in.
Peter, Kelly is in Washington fighting back against this extremism every day, and we are working hard to continue to meet our fundraising goals to ensure this seat does not garner the attention of national Republicans. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

While the Trump administration and Elon Musk’s DOGE keep rolling back
critical services for everyday people like seniors and children, they’re
out here talking about unconstitutional war plans via a texting app called
Signal.

Former Fox News host turned Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, along with
VP JD Vance and other national security officials, casually discussed
dropping bombs on Yemen — without Congressional approval — through an
unsecured group chat, and accidentally invited The Atlantic
editor-in-chief.

Make no mistake, the story here isn’t just their recklessness. The United
States should not be bombing Yemen—period. Trump is murdering civilians
and further escalating the Middle East into another US-backed endless war.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250325?refcode=em20250325-36530&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36530_1203867_MZpLJG&akid=36530%2E1203867%2EMZpLJG ]A screenshot of a post on X from Rep. Greg Casar. He is reposting a
post from The Atlantic reading 'American war planning usually takes place
in highly secure facilities. But the Trump administration planned its
strikes on the Houthis using a group chat—and accidentally included The
Atlantic’s editor in chief, @JeffreyGoldberg.' Rep. Casar said 'Trump says
the phone lines seniors use to get their Social Security checks have to be
shut down for security reasons, but his staff is planning bombing
campaigns over text message.'

And Justice Democrats’ Rep. Greg Casar is right.

With the largest budget of any agency, the Pentagon can't even keep
unconstitutional military plans a secret, yet it’s somehow still not the
focus of Elon Musk's DOGE. Maybe because unlike Social Security, his
corporations can make millions off federal defense contracts.

It's not just incompetence, it's corruption.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250325?refcode=em20250325-36530&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36530_1203867_MZpLJG&akid=36530%2E1203867%2EMZpLJG ]We need Democrats to fight back with everything they’ve got to demand
officials like Hegseth resign, end the US strikes on Yemen, and stop the
Trump/Musk cuts to the services regular people depend on. Help us recruit
and elect more progressive, working-class Democrats who are ready to do
the job: pitch in $5 or more now!

### We just passed a bill that says parents have to opt in, not out, of sexual education
| | [Brian Lenney - Nampa's Senator](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)

---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/brianlenney/p/kids-belong-to-parents-not-schools?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

The Senate just passed [House Bill 239](https://substack.com/redirect/a5218ded-dd92-4079-98d4-27cc7b61ce5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a game-changer for Idaho schools.
It flips the old system on its head--parents now have to **actively opt in** to let their kids sit through sexual education classes, instead of just opting out if they don't like it. This is a big deal because it hands control back to families, not bureaucrats or teachers who might claim they know better. If the folks running these classes have nothing to hide, they shouldn't care about parents having the final say.
_**Transparency should be a non-issue.**_
Think about what happened during COVID...
Parents got a raw look (some for the first time ever) at what their kids were being taught when classrooms went virtual. Parents woke up during the pandemic and realized government schools were pumping woke sexual education into their kids' heads, from gender ideology to explicit content, often under the guise of "social-emotional learning" (whichi s VERY bad) or "health."
House Bill 239 says enough is enough. It's a line in the sand--parents don't have to subject their kids to this stuff anymore unless they explicitly agree to it. No more assuming consent; no more letting schools decide what's "appropriate" behind closed doors.
This ist a win for common sense and a wake-up call to the system.

And at this point, I'm at the end of my wits, Peter.

_**If I don't do a total 180 on the fundraising front, Democrats will see this as a major pickup opportunity and start flooding cash into my race.**_

Unfortunately for our nation, this administration is both incompetent and dangerous
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1558%2E791427%2Ecp5Cvv)

Friend — Every day this administration exposes itself as a clown show.
Yesterday we learned that the Vice President, Secretary of Defense, and other top security personnel were coordinating military airstrikes via group chat.
How did we learn this? **Because they accidentally included an outside reporter in the group chat.**
This is clown stuff. 🤡
But unfortunately for our nation, this administration is both incompetent and dangerous.
In the two months since Trump took office, we have seen a steady erosion of our democracy.
Ignoring court orders. Illegally slashing the budget. Shuttering entire federal departments and agencies without Congress. Disappearing people without due process.
And now this recklessness in handling military intel — intel about their plans to enact more violence and destruction in the Middle East.
Friend, it’s our job to show the American people the dangerous path we are on, and use every tool that we have at our disposal to stand up and fight back.
I know it sounds tough. How are we able to fight back when the GOP has all the power? The answer is through grassroots politics.
It’s going to take a sustained, organized, grassroots movement to defend our democracy and defeat the far-right. It won’t happen overnight, but if we build every day we will put ourselves in a position to take back the levers of power. That’s how the civil rights movement won, that’s how the women’s rights movement won, and it’s how progressives have made advances throughout our nation’s history.

---
Friend, We’re watching the Israeli government commit horrific crimes against humanity with our weapons and our tax dollars, resuming intense bombing and forced displacement throughout Gaza—while continuing to deprive the millions of Palestinians in Gaza from accessing water, food, electricity, medical supplies, and the ability to escape. Meanwhile, the apartheid government has continued to ramp up deadly attacks in the West Bank. **Our government must stop supporting and funding these violations of international law.** In addition to spending more than $18 billion on military aid to Israel since October 2023, our government passed another record-breaking military budget last year—spending nearly a trillion taxpayer dollars on the Pentagon, half of which will line the pockets of for-profit military contractors. Every year Congress passes massively wasteful budgets for war and destruction, accounting for 40% of the world’s military spending. **When my colleagues in Congress vote to support wars and weapons manufacturing, many are profiting financially.** Between 2019 and 2021, 97 members of Congress or their family members financially invested in companies that make military equipment, and 25 of them sat on committees directly responsible for shaping military policy and funding. These are unacceptable conflicts of interest, which is why I introduced the _Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act_ to ban members of Congress from investing in weapons contractors. [**Can you sign on to support the**** _Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act_****, as one step in the push for our government to divest from war and invest in life? Lawmakers should not be profiting financially when they vote to bomb civilians.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-inXg7XQKmpx2SINKyl6WQz_vkJ3ZJKcUzkkSwqwfKGXt3VH5qTBQjGdXvOaiu8j2XRnJuMeXeVCXynWCoOYsum1kU5oByp_ITgVWKFt75_lQTHT3xcVrqtk6GnxA32yrIXH6wSj2k9uCkcm98elARwDvz9gPt5EXLWQiKS9Wu6ABZTox9Smb8BqoBmjIaNfezkDPoLlKjhJI5Yc-T6HcGB4HRmC_cgcRckGcp6Jf7K56ZXPkkfAXMXYLUuby3_32xzAWve-TQcs2mpeTGcGrfScQ15adGKLb97yYZkNsUflJYIHcbTOQdwM9YK1GsCwj41RPAY38NoE_lcl99FZEg-dDmh2XyZLlEcVTOZrOspdvW2udNIes_G9w4dhf53XGNGTVkWKMlmow6XCm_EmvqKf2x9DSZb01sSfuMzwxIKn103pjByyADrmSC9bFjiMo/4f3/szh0mvLeQTuvzQN9tQaVxA/h1/h001.Lc9GsMIr07Neec_A_32jBqhUwjis15or7t9_EfRPnsA) | [SIGN ON](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-inXg7XQKmpx2SINKyl6WQz_vkJ3ZJKcUzkkSwqwfKGXt3VH5qTBQjGdXvOaiu8j2XRnJuMeXeVCXynWCoOYsum1kU5oByp_ITgVWKFt75_lQTHT3xcVrqtk6GnxA32yrIXH6wSj2k9uCkcm98elARwDvz9gPt5EXLWQiKS9Wu6ABZTox9Smb8BqoBmjIaNfezkDPoLlKjhJI5Yc-T6HcGSwc23qt_Flk4HbD2NuQt6QyjOAmWK4titSgMp0pUxxhkfQbLHfuUAkUO6ZF_P7kYWz5Z_zzokwiNXr_hIMyeuAoysmjho4y-_cmrwZiX3Nz6GdoaBSP2K5c33pLVEtTXZh2uw_VR4YNv81pOZQT36V5iVD8aZpWNq_4MZw_fpSJd-QIvlBUhHIp_pwGZFOiS8fTRSSdPk0oALSAgJfAgDfDaPpTLmm-8DdKlxSzvZOI/4f3/szh0mvLeQTuvzQN9tQaVxA/h2/h001.hq19wwulOViJ0zgJUPO7rPcTgZSQ7_sGjb_w8ao_uHM)
---
Our country always seems to have enough money to bomb people, but year after year elected officials tell us that there is no money to invest in lifesaving programs for the communities they claim to represent—where people are sleeping on the streets, struggling to access healthcare and feed their families, and are in need of disaster relief.
**In 2022’s election cycle, the weapons industry donated more than $10 million to members of Congressional committees that determine our always-expanding military budget.** In the same year, _“The top five U.S. weapons contractors—Lockheed Martin, RTX (formerly Raytheon), Northrop Grumman, Boeing, and General Dynamics—split over $194 billion in arms-related contracts.”_ 1
We can’t let our elected officials continue to prioritize the profits of military corporations—and their own personal profits—over people’s needs. We must rein in the weapons industry’s influence over politics and hold policymakers accountable to their constituents.
[**Add your name to stop members of Congress from profiting when they invest in death and endless war.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-inXg7XQKmpx2SINKyl6WQz_vkJ3ZJKcUzkkSwqwfKGXt3VH5qTBQjGdXvOaiu8j2XRnJuMeXeVCXynWCoOYsum1kU5oByp_ITgVWKFt75_lQTHT3xcVrqtk6GnxA32yrIXH6wSj2k9uCkcm98elARwDvz9gPt5EXLWQiKS9Wu6ABZTox9Smb8BqoBmjIaNfezkDPoLlKjhJI5Yc-T6HcGK-HqHxLvomwxbEoP6SJNcFqHlYiPlrMxlB3GfZHOPFsy9GrYqXC4SKAIBx8w4HxthKK-OvRGk6cZI1E9-TkA9z6SvZmV8NlT-dQq59rm9RSgMLs5DcP4anOteA_BNazIgJs0DJ3GwLkNsbpnh_QgJxfu1g1LHRyMglt3_dtP-wAoUGSlR_xS6dbTX2a0H0Lmhp4V20qnQR9rj6ir5teExtheIVTaY8Q98PagEkYWcZo/4f3/szh0mvLeQTuvzQN9tQaVxA/h3/h001.ROtWRQlQ8u7Jw8tZ7FwN9JNdAL0I4Q3cyAjwQBcWhxE)
Thank you. I promise I will continue to fight like hell to prioritize funding for the Child Tax Credit, affordable housing and healthcare, clean air and water, and bold climate action with the future of our planet at stake.
Together, we’ll keep fighting for a government by and for the people, where everyone can thrive.

Even though the Pentagon has failed to pass an audit for 7 years in a row, last year the Pentagon budget was $895 billion, nearly $1 trillion taxpayer dollars. And now, congressional Republicans are attempting to add another $150 billion to the Pentagon budget and $175 billion to the Department of Homeland Security to help carry out Donald Trump’s cruel and illegal mass deportations. Republicans are trying to cut hundreds of billions of dollars from essential programs that millions of Americans rely on, including Medicaid and food stamps... while adding hundreds of billions of our taxpayer dollars to the military budget. This is impossible to justify when our neighbors are struggling to put food on the table, fighting to keep a roof over their heads, and rationing their medication. Why do we always have money for war, but not enough to feed the poor, as Tupac Shakur wrote decades ago? Part of the problem is the deep ties between lawmakers and the weapons industry. Half of the annual military budget lines the pockets of military contractors that profit off of mass death. Now, many of these contracting corporations have proposed taking over mass detentions and deportations, as well.2 Weapons corporations like Raytheon, Boeing, and Lockheed Martin spend millions to re-elect Congresspeople who serve on committees that determine military funding. Additionally, many members of Congress and their spouses invest directly in weapons contractor stocks, so when they vote to send more bombs or send our loved ones to war, they profit personally. Across political party lines, too many of my fellow Congresspeople are incentivized to push for military aggression rather than diplomacy. To stop this, I introduced the Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act. As of last year, more than 50 members of Congress owned stock in military contractors.3 It’s shameful that my colleagues continue to funnel billions of U.S. tax dollars to get rich from military contractor profits while voting to pass more funding to bomb people. This is corruption and cruelty; our elected officials should not be able to profit off of death. If passed, the Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act will prohibit members of Congress, their spouses, and their dependent children from having any financial interests in corporations that do business with the U.S. Department of Defense—including banning members from trading defense stocks. The Executive Director of Win Without War said: “Representative Tlaib’s bill is a vital step to breaking this cycle of war profiteering. If our leaders truly serve the public, they must put people over profits—not cash in on the wars they help wage.” Most Secretaries of Defense come directly from the weapons industry, which has spent over $260 million on lobbying and $56 million in direct campaign donations between 2022 and 2024. The organization Corporate Accountability explains: “The [weapons] industry employed 858 lobbyists in 2022—more than one for every member of Congress.” 4 Unfortunately, the weapons industry exerts incredible influence not just in our political system, but also in our education system. Many U.S. universities have boards of trustees that include military corporations’ executives, who have been pressuring schools to crack down on campus speech and suppress anti-war student efforts while the Trump administration is simultaneously deporting student protesters without cause or due process. We can’t let our institutions prioritize the profits of military corporations over people’s needs. I’ve instead pushed for giving direct cash assistance to people and ending childhood poverty in the United States. State Senator Nina Turner and I wrote: “ In a country that wastes trillions of dollars on war while continuing to defund our social safety net, we know that poverty is a policy choice.” Instead of spending more on war than any other country in the world, we need to fund universal healthcare, housing for all, clean drinking water, school meals, childcare, and more. Thank you for continuing to demand better from our government. I will continue to fight like hell to rein in military spending and corporate greed, invest in working families, and work toward a future that values diplomacy and peace over the military-industrial complex. Together, we will take steps toward the long-overdue dismantling of our country’s military-industrial complex, so that we can finally put a stop to forever wars and reinvest our tax dollars into providing our communities with the resources they need and deserve. In solidarity, Rashida 1 , 2 3 4 * Rashida Tlaib for Congress PO Box 32777 Detroit, MI 48232 | Paid for by Rashida Tlaib for Congress | | Sent via . clean_body: Elon is trying to straight up buy votes — again. | | | Peter — Since the sending of this email, billionaire Elon Musk has dropped an additional $7.9 million in this race — bringing the total up to $22.5 million! That's nearly 1/10th of what Elon spent to elect Trump! \- Team WFP \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Team WFP Date: Sat, Mar 22, 2025 at 11:30 AM Subject: Don’t let Elon buy this election Peter, $14.6 million. That’s how much billionaire Elon Musk has already spent to buy an open Wisconsin Supreme Court seat to install MAGA extremist Brad Schimel.1 But that’s not all. Because if filling the airwaves with lies against Democratic candidate Susan Crawford wasn’t enough, now Elon is trying to straight up buy votes — again. Musk’s PAC is offering Wisconsin voters $100 if they sign a petition against “activist judges.” And if voters recruit more people to sign on? They get $100 more.2 Musk’s DOGE cuts to essential services and illegal firings of federal employees have already hurt working people in Wisconsin and across the country, and if he is able to buy this election, it will get even worse.3 That’s why we’ve launched a massive grassroots operation — knocking on doors and phone banking voters. Already we’ve made 250K voter contact attempts in Wisconsin. But with the election in 7 days, and early voting already underway, we need to reach even more. Whoever wins this open seat will determine the balance of power of the Wisconsin Supreme Court, and will become the deciding vote on abortion rights, labor rights, and voting rights. But this election is about so much more. It’s about the future of our democracy. No single person should have the ability to buy an election. We believe Wisconsin voters should get to decide this election, not the richest billionaire in the world. Election Day is April 1st and early voting is already underway. The clock is ticking to make an impact. In solidarity, Team WFP P.S. Want to go to Wisconsin? Our friends at Seed the Vote are offering up to $115 to help cover airfare, mileage, or a hotel for anyone willing to travel to Milwaukee and canvass voters before Election Day. # **The Message Seen Around the World**
---
| [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wwsf8-vvoc52-kyd76rh5/)
---
| | | | Hello friend, We **cannot** allow ourselves to normalize or make excuses for the level of incompetence we witnessed yesterday from the Trump Administration. When I first read about what happened, I laughed—I thought it was a clever joke. As the story started to spread, I assumed it was just a slow news day. But about **30 minutes** later, it was everywhere. I started diving into the details, and what I found left me in **complete and utter disbelief.** How could something like this happen? This level of incompetence is **unimaginable.** **National Security Advisor Mike Waltz** added the **editor-in-chief of The Atlantic** to a message chain outlining **United States military actions—before they were even launched.** This is something straight out of _The Simpsons_ , with Homer in charge of the nukes. As I write this, I still can't believe it happened. Too many people are **not** being held accountable—including Trump, who handpicked this bigoted moron to lead the Department of Defense. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who is often labeled as "the experienced adult in the room," was also involved. So were the Vice President, the National Security Advisor, and others. Not only did they discuss sensitive military operations **on an unsecured channel** , but **no one** even bothered to check who else was in the chat? Rumors are already circulating that **Waltz was leaking classified information to The Atlantic** before this incident. That’s why the editor-in-chief’s name appeared in the first place. If true, this is a **massive** national security breach. I would be **shocked** if Waltz survives this scandal and isn’t forced to resign by the end of the week. But we **can’t** let them simply pin this on Waltz and move on. **This story needs to be front and center at every Republican press conference from now until the end of time.** Let’s be clear: **felonies were committed.** Whistleblowers have been **imprisoned** for leaking far **less** sensitive information than this. The hypocrisy is staggering. This breach also gives us an **unfiltered** look at how these people think, what motivates them—and worse, **now our adversaries know it too.** Iran, North Korea, Russia, China—they’re all watching, and they **will** use this information to **leverage their demands** over the next four years. Our allies are watching too, asking themselves: **Can we really trust the United States anymore?** How could they, when **these morons** are in charge? This story is far from over. We will be sharing it with **veterans' groups, both Republican and Democrat alike** , to hear their perspective. **This should outrage everyone who has ever served—and everyone who has voted Republican for far too long.** Now is the time to win them back. We must show them that our party is the one they can **trust** to stand up for their rights, their benefits, and the national security of the United States. **Moments like this define elections.** We didn’t ask for this, but here we are—and now we **must** act. **Campaigns aren’t won in the final weeks before an election—they are won in moments like today.** That is why we need support **right now.** [**_The stakes are too high to waste this moment. Pitch in whatever you can so we can amplify our work and take this fight into ‘26 and beyond._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wwsf8-vvoc53-kyd76rh6/) In Solidarity, Hassan Martini

clean_body: | | | | | | The Message Seen Around the World | | | | | Hello friend, We cannot allow ourselves to normalize or make excuses for the level of incompetence we witnessed yesterday from the Trump Administration. When I first read about what happened, I laughed—I thought it was a clever joke. As the story started to spread, I assumed it was just a slow news day. But about 30 minutes later, it was everywhere. I started diving into the details, and what I found left me in complete and utter disbelief. How could something like this happen? This level of incompetence is unimaginable. National Security Advisor Mike Waltz added the editor-in-chief of The Atlantic to a message chain outlining United States military actions—before they were even launched. This is something straight out of The Simpsons , with Homer in charge of the nukes. As I write this, I still can't believe it happened. Too many people are not being held accountable—including Trump, who handpicked this bigoted moron to lead the Department of Defense. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who is often labeled as "the experienced adult in the room," was also involved. So were the Vice President, the National Security Advisor, and others. Not only did they discuss sensitive military operations on an unsecured channel , but no one even bothered to check who else was in the chat? Rumors are already circulating that Waltz was leaking classified information to The Atlantic before this incident. That’s why the editor-in-chief’s name appeared in the first place. If true, this is a massive national security breach. I would be shocked if Waltz survives this scandal and isn’t forced to resign by the end of the week. But we can’t let them simply pin this on Waltz and move on. This story needs to be front and center at every Republican press conference from now until the end of time. Let’s be clear: felonies were committed. Whistleblowers have been imprisoned for leaking far less sensitive information than this. The hypocrisy is staggering. This breach also gives us an unfiltered look at how these people think, what motivates them—and worse, now our adversaries know it too. Iran, North Korea, Russia, China—they’re all watching, and they will use this information to leverage their demands over the next four years. Our allies are watching too, asking themselves: Can we really trust the United States anymore? How could they, when these morons are in charge? This story is far from over. We will be sharing it with veterans' groups, both Republican and Democrat alike , to hear their perspective. This should outrage everyone who has ever served—and everyone who has voted Republican for far too long. Now is the time to win them back. We must show them that our party is the one they can trust to stand up for their rights, their benefits, and the national security of the United States. Moments like this define elections. We didn’t ask for this, but here we are—and now we must act. Campaigns aren’t won in the final weeks before an election—they are won in moments like today. That is why we need support right now. name: Weil, J.
subject: the dog who caught the bus
body:
We have spent everything on making this breakthrough and utilizing it to remain competitive in this red district. Now we are at risk of having nothing left to capitalize on this push.
| | | | | [](https://wb7c9thbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ejpBL9wcArIPzDPbBi9lITN13ARM2Qws87YPy-bTRR4a4HdYq3EFh_4oNEWiCJlMP6XGnDAlNlP_48JpahZy-sF0Awt3pZjPY3wHlVEZ6t_n1-m9K2NF5QUgnDym3DYOeU4VbaxO0A7vqg1lB3vyN0_hG5csIj5_HHTi-JL0C2b_4GTVa4seVDLi7wBIAlfVYAjKr9V3r0mKl2zRBEN4CCblf_Cc1Yko&c=ai4vS852Y7O3tS6OFW6IA3Jur4IZrhDAUYTGjufBpHu6isAM26BPBQ==&ch=0ERWebSStIjacs1w4KLr18PRueSrSu5d-ip1ZMkoBJv78t_79mICVQ==)
---
Team,
When we launched this campaign in December 2024 in the wake of Vice President Harris' heartwrenching loss to Donald Trump, we only had one goal in mind: fight back.
I wasn't sure what that would look like, but I knew first that we had to assemble a top-notch team of creative political operators and happy Democratic warriors (a rare commodity in these times), people who would set a target and execute the strategy to achieve it with the stubbornness of a bull dog.
So we set an ambitious target: raise so much money in the shortened timeframe that was set by Gov. Ron DeSantis deliberately to sabotage us that MAGA would be caught off guard assuming that they would cruise to an easy non-contested victory.
We did just that: MAGA thought they were safe here, that they had it in the bag, and that weak-willed Democrats were going to give up before even trying--and we shocked them and the entire political world when news broke that we took the lead in early voting on Saturday and surpassed our opponent 10-1 in fundraising.
---
| | | | | [](https://wb7c9thbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ejpBL9wcArIPzDPbBi9lITN13ARM2Qws87YPy-bTRR4a4HdYq3EFh_4oNEWiCJlMSR7YYEoiLjUjST1j-oPzQvcTh7KjWk-W0C3QtFL-3xKaxMmfhSy88FsZesqh3EVdkJniti6XXvJbNqNCvSZymxZIircQweBuK363CfKJWYwqinIJ126zCYAAzUgJkH8Ie3L98x5U8ZEo3EAKE28x5Huujg6s2eai6_QPkgrjkBs=&c=ai4vS852Y7O3tS6OFW6IA3Jur4IZrhDAUYTGjufBpHu6isAM26BPBQ==&ch=0ERWebSStIjacs1w4KLr18PRueSrSu5d-ip1ZMkoBJv78t_79mICVQ==)
---

| I have important news to share with you. Despite the speculation, I will not be running for Senate here in Michigan in 2026. I’m so proud of what we’re building here in West Michigan. This was a tough decision because I know what we’re building is not just what our community needs but what America needs–thoughtful, principled leadership that puts theatrics and partisanship aside and gets stuff done. But this is the right choice, and here’s why. I hope you’ll read through to the end.

Over the past few weeks, we’ve all experienced truly unprecedented attacks on our democratic institutions, critical social infrastructure, and one constitutional crisis after another. Many of you have expressed your concerns to your elected representatives and pushed those of us in these positions to step up. I couldn’t be more inspired by the thousands of you who are holding your representatives to account. **We need leaders who have been put in a position to lead,_to lead_. And that’s what I’m doing every day**–helping constituents resolve crises with a federal agency, introducing critical legislation to hold the administration accountable, and strategizing with my colleagues to continue to stand up for our country.

Far too often, politics can become about always looking for the next best thing in your career. But for me, it’s about looking for the next best thing for our community and our country. Service is at the heart of why I do this work, and it’s what’s driving this decision, too.

The state of Michigan is also experiencing a turning point. Trump won this swing state by a mere 80,000 votes, and we held last year’s Senate seat by only 18,000 votes. Now, in 2026, with FOUR open statewide seats, Michigan will once again be a critical and highly contested battleground.

**I choose to join Democrats in that battle by staying to defend this district. West Michigan was once a Republican stronghold, but we beat over 50 years of precedent to hold this seat and send a pro-choice woman back to Congress.**

My work here is not over. Together, we’ve fought to protect reproductive access, defend Social Security and Medicare, protect our Great Lakes, and fight for an economy we can all thrive in. Michigan’s 3rd District has been and will continue to be key in that progress. We can’t take it for granted.

**The next few years will require leaders in Congress who refuse to bow down to the Trump administration’s reckless agenda and be bought out by billionaires.[_With House Republicans holding a narrow majority in Congress, we have to hold steady, defend this seat, and fight for a majority that will stand up for all of us. I’m staying here, and I hope you’ll stand with me:_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104502029/535556347/591366052?refcode=BLU_EM_HSC_2025-03-25_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDI2OTRkNS1hZTA5LWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UndhuO9fGBBvcRgrTAyWO4_uZ8F5LmP5j90dG5kezFY=)**
