clean_body: We need leaders who have been put in a position to lead, to lead. | = | I have important news to share with you. Despite the speculation, I will not be running for Senate here in Michigan in 2026. I’m so proud of what we’re building here in West Michigan. This was a tough decision because I know what we’re building is not just what our community needs but what America needs–thoughtful, principled leadership that puts theatrics and partisanship aside and gets stuff done. But this is the right choice, and here’s why. I hope you’ll read through to the end. Over the past few weeks, we’ve all experienced truly unprecedented attacks on our democratic institutions, critical social infrastructure, and one constitutional crisis after another. Many of you have expressed your concerns to your elected representatives and pushed those of us in these positions to step up. I couldn’t be more inspired by the thousands of you who are holding your representatives to account. We need leaders who have been put in a position to lead,to lead. And that’s what I’m doing every day–helping constituents resolve crises with a federal agency, introducing critical legislation to hold the administration accountable, and strategizing with my colleagues to continue to stand up for our country. Far too often, politics can become about always looking for the next best thing in your career. But for me, it’s about looking for the next best thing for our community and our country. Service is at the heart of why I do this work, and it’s what’s driving this decision, too. The state of Michigan is also experiencing a turning point. Trump won this swing state by a mere 80,000 votes, and we held last year’s Senate seat by only 18,000 votes. Now, in 2026, with FOUR open statewide seats, Michigan will once again be a critical and highly contested battleground. I choose to join Democrats in that battle by staying to defend this district. West Michigan was once a Republican stronghold, but we beat over 50 years of precedent to hold this seat and send a pro-choice woman back to Congress. My work here is not over. Together, we’ve fought to protect reproductive access, defend Social Security and Medicare, protect our Great Lakes, and fight for an economy we can all thrive in. Michigan’s 3rd District has been and will continue to be key in that progress. We can’t take it for granted. The next few years will require leaders in Congress who refuse to bow down to the Trump administration’s reckless agenda and be bought out by billionaires.= | = | = | = | = | = Onward, Hillary * | | = Paid for by Scholten for Congress Scholten for Congress PO Box 6233 Grand Rapids, MI 49510 United States | = If you would like to receive fewer emails, . Peter Willis,

This weekend, tens of thousands of people packed into rallies with Bernie
& AOC – and he had a clear message for all of us: Rallies must only be the
start. We need progressives to run for office at all levels.

It’s easy to get fired up by 10,000 people cheering in a rally, but what
changes history is a slate of candidates who inspire 10,000 people to show
up to vote, candidates who inspire 10,000 to sign up to organize.

Since Bernie founded Our Revolution, we’ve helped elect more than 1,100
progressive candidates — from school board members and city councilors to
mayors, state legislators, and members of Congress.

With the democratic party facing a fundamental test of whether it can meet
this moment and pull us back from the brink of Trump’s Oligarchic takeover
- we are making it our number one priority to take this momentum from the
streets to the ballot box, we need your help.

candidates across the country. Can you chip in today to help us build the
political power we desperately need?

This isn’t about riding a wave of excitement — it’s about channeling it
into real political power to bring everything we’ve got to the ballot box
to stop Trump and Musk. We’re building local volunteer teams. We’re
training candidates. We’re organizing alongside labor unions. And we’re
taking Bernie’s call to run everywhere and turning it into a movement that

Fellow Conservative,

Things have been slow on the fundraising front, and I completely understand why. The election took its toll on all of us, me included. But it’s been five months, and things have become interesting in politics. Democrats are beginning to coalesce around candidates they plan to support in next year’s elections and are starting to funnel money to their campaigns.
**
[We cannot fall behind.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=7d73a1fa2f964c6b99c343ffdc3a9409&_e=HyEMbgiO5jeR8Llg-q710kDdvO8TeVxlDTvlr_zi0sPvcI02XTfj-OwmnC80Cqld0xnlQa62dRDv256WbKZNOHux6M3b17WEz_9D4d6j6kfl3rB0SKwpqKe318V_-QBLf1RQLs8mmoj67-EmvgfbdF76paa7eBV5rQ7K9UKVRbTAsbN9ehJ_K2SaXcyVlSta6Ywi6ZvIh7Hx6o6U06Z3ywnlZSk8XT8VR3JxmJ9M0wDnxk8v5UcTYfE0jYDWb6r8W8aQMReqxft_tqUsOweXaBgs4KWlr104-BT3s-MAdevWcjedKnTjGrbtEURbxAtz-l83OhKVvIUxX6cqXz-2Ws_VnzJYcLCsW3hTHAndSWopCzr5KVsCBDoy1sL9yXXB_cdWxudv6DwvYtOSZGSBUw%3D%3D) **

There are just six days until the end of the first fundraising quarter of 2025, and so far this month, we’ve raised just $10,000 toward our efforts to hold onto the Senate in next year’s midterms and support President Trump’s America First Agenda.

[**CONTRIBUTE ANY AMOUNT NOW**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=7d73a1fa2f964c6b99c343ffdc3a9409&_e=HyEMbgiO5jeR8Llg-q710kDdvO8TeVxlDTvlr_zi0sPvcI02XTfj-OwmnC80Cqld0xnlQa62dRDv256WbKZNOHux6M3b17WEz_9D4d6j6kfl3rB0SKwpqKe318V_-QBLf1RQLs8mmoj67-EmvgfbdF76paa7eBV5rQ7K9UKVRbTAsbN9ehJ_K2SaXcyVlSta6Ywi6ZvIh7Hx6o6U06Z3ywnlZSk8XT8VR3JxmJ9M0wDnxk8v5UcTYfE0jYDWb6r8kANSVZZMHV2s74_o8L4vvlyBEOXvL-PG_fOY9Vmr7VfXvb4en-p2tmAXuU0gqnY_6MkfJ4xKb7TZ3SKGw3UnMPzch6Amgcwzs-T0FOJZwjZKkWX378M6Is4nQxqxnA-P0Q984-EVUNA-MKhzN8h9tA%3D%3D)
_**I have a very important question: Are you still interested in helping us move the ball forward?

Democrats, even Kamala Harris, continue to email their supporters for help, leaving us with no choice but to do the same. **_

**[I’m sending you this email to double our daily fundraising total of $199 before midnight tonight.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=7d73a1fa2f964c6b99c343ffdc3a9409&_e=HyEMbgiO5jeR8Llg-q710kDdvO8TeVxlDTvlr_zi0sPvcI02XTfj-OwmnC80Cqld0xnlQa62dRDv256WbKZNOHux6M3b17WEz_9D4d6j6kfl3rB0SKwpqKe318V_-QBLf1RQLs8mmoj67-EmvgfbdF76paa7eBV5rQ7K9UKVRbTAsbN9ehJ_K2SaXcyVlSta6Ywi6ZvIh7Hx6o6U06Z3ywnlZSk8XT8VR3JxmJ9M0wDnxk8v5UcTYfE0jYDWb6r8oVoZj4iSBXnPCUmVF7wgk2Ddi9Y4_FG570Qh2M6axCOorX6YEChpY7ovBH8_OHRzwMY0fzNAg2KgguU5Wo4njcdsPAMkgDZ__OduwuOo0fg3WnHW4R-u9WR-lXnw5c1-Zru8Sf-cYkik72a3G43hKg%3D%3D)
**
We have six days left and need your immediate attention on this critical matter.

name: Sarah McBride
subject: This is a long email, but I hope you’ll read it
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
Not everyone is as lucky as we were.
#
This is a long email, but it’s a deeply personal one. I hope you’ll take a moment to read it because what’s at stake right now couldn’t be more important.
**House Republicans have made it clear that they want to put Medicaid on the chopping block — ripping away care from families who need it most.**
I think about what that could mean for so many people. And I can’t help but think of Andy.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250325-1?refcode=em20250325-1846&amount=5&refcode2=1846_21716_G1PMue&akid=1846%2E21716%2EG1PMue)
Andy was my husband. Just one year into our relationship, he was diagnosed with cancer. Overnight, we went from planning our future together to fighting for his life. I became his primary caregiver. During his battle with terminal cancer, I held his hand through appointments, treatments, and, ultimately, when he passed away.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250325-1?refcode=em20250325-1846&amount=5&refcode2=1846_21716_G1PMue&akid=1846%2E21716%2EG1PMue)
But we were lucky. Andy had access to health care. It gave us precious time together. But I also saw firsthand how fragile access can be — and how devastating it is when people don’t have it.
**Not everyone is as lucky as we were.** Too many families are forced to make impossible choices — between seeing a doctor or keeping the lights on, between paying for a life-saving prescription, or putting food on the table for their children.
Health care is a human right. In the wealthiest country on earth, no one should have to make choices like these.
But right now, Republicans are threatening to make things even harder by slashing Medicaid and cutting off care for millions of Americans — including 1 in 4 Delawareans — to give tax breaks to billionaires.
**That’s why I denounce Republicans’ heartless cuts. And it’s why I’m working to rally support to save Medicaid and continue to push for health care for all.**[**Will you pitch in $5 to power our fight?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250325-1?refcode=em20250325-1846&amount=5&refcode2=1846_21716_G1PMue&akid=1846%2E21716%2EG1PMue)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250325-1?amount=5&refcode=em20250325-1846&refcode2=1846_21716_G1PMue&akid=1846%2E21716%2EG1PMue)**
Thank you for reading,
Sarah McBride
* * *

| Last night, Virginia Governor Glenn Youngkin gutted legislation that would guarantee Virginians’ right to access contraception and birth control.

After the Dobbs decision, we’ve seen politicians throughout the South attempt to not only outlaw abortion but go _even further_ to also restrict birth control and outlaw emergency contraception. Here in Virginia, we remain the only state in the South that hasn’t further restricted women’s reproductive freedom in any way—and that is only thanks to our Democratic-held General Assembly.

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: Three things we can do this week
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

I’m feeling hopeful.

We are seeing people and institutions hold strong and fight back in
meaningful ways.

For starters, Federal Judge James Boasberg has refused to buckle under the
pressure of Donald Trump and the MAGA machine — instead, he continues to
try to hold the Administration to account for its illegal and
unconstitutional deportation flights to El Salvador. Trump has threatened
the judge with impeachment, trolls seek to intimidate him by posting
private information about his family online and some would-be domestic
terrorists even try to incite violence.

But the guy is not backing down. Trump’s wildly undemocratic threats have
even prompted Chief Justice John Roberts to rebuke the president publicly.
Boasberg is showing the way to act when confronted by Trump’s thuggish
behavior — strong, principled, using the constitution and the law as his
guide. Here’s a question for the rest of us: are we prepared to do the
same if Trump ignores this and other judges’ court orders?

Here’s why I’m optimistic we will.

Across the country, people are gathering to rally in support of democracy,
the constitution and the rule of law. And it’s growing by the day.

Examples include these town hall meetings that constituents are pressuring
their representatives to hold — and in their representative’s absence,
holding them themselves — to ensure those in public office are accountable
for their actions at this moment of crisis. I was lucky to join one in
Mansfield, Texas last week, where their U.S. congressman has yet to meet
with those he purports to represent.

And it’s not just town halls. In Denver, Bernie Sanders and Alexandria
Ocasio-Cortez just held a rally with more than 34,000 people — the largest
turn out of any rally either of them has ever held. Meanwhile, Tim Walz
continues to show up in deep red parts of America to engage directly with
the unrepresented constituents of AWOL members of Congress. And now he’s
coming to Texas. I’ll be holding a town hall with him this Thursday in
Fort Bend County outside of Houston (link below).

Finally, there is a national day of action planned for April 5th, with
hundreds of events taking shape across the country. People are stepping up
to save this democracy, our constitution and the rule of law.

Three things we can do to build on this momentum.

1. Join us in Fort Bend for a Congressional town hall with Tim Walz. If
members of Congress are too chicken to show up for their constituents,
we’ll do it for them. Look forward to seeing you this Thursday
(3-27-25). Details and sign up here: [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/64448?t=1001&akid=240043%2E444211%2EfiTB1i ]EVENT SIGN UP.
2. Volunteer on the ground or over the wires with Powered by People. We
are training Volunteer Deputy Registrars to meet and register
first-time voters in Texas. And we have some big voter registration
canvasses coming up throughout the state. You can also help us at a
distance, even if you’re not in Texas. Sign up to find out more:
[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1002&akid=240043%2E444211%2EfiTB1i ]VOLUNTEER SIGN UP.
3. A coalition of labor unions, progressive orgs and pro-democracy groups
are planning a massive day of rallies on April 5th called “Hands Off!”
There are already more than 500 events planned, with more coming
online soon. Sign up to find out more and join here: [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/64449?t=1003&akid=240043%2E444211%2EfiTB1i ]HANDS OFF SIGN
UP.

See you out there! Remember, action is the key to victory and the antidote
to despair.

—Beto

name: Ernest Lineberger
subject: Ernest Lineberger for Congress - This Is My March Newsletter for the 26th District
body:
Hi Friends and Voters. I want to be your next Congressman. Many have been asking me if I’m running again in 2026. To certify my affirmative answer, I have filed my “Statement of Candidacy” with the FEC and am listed on their website as an official 2026 candidate for Texas CD26!
I live in Carrollton and I care deeply about every person in the 26th District. I served in the United States Navy as an officer until retirement and now work for Texas Instruments (for over 29 years). I hurt deeply at what I see as total mismanagement of our federal government by the winners of the 2024 election. I’m getting started early to take it back in 2026 for the people of this district. To find out more about me, you can click on this link: [About | Lineberger for TX-26](https://www.linebergerforuscongress.com/about). This newsletter brings you my thoughts on events in Washington D.C. and here at home in the 26th District.
**
Washington D.C. Events Impacting the 26th –** Years back, during prior Republican administrations, I didn’t like the way they put big business and big money ahead of our people’s needs, but I always felt that they would defend our country well. Now, I fear we are less safe with fewer international partners, much less social safety net, worsening economics and poverty. These fears and realities kill business opportunities for many of our local small businesses and entrepreneurs. It’s shameful, but expected from those in office.

**Doing Business in the 26th –** As budgets tighten, more of our neighbors are cutting back. The ‘have to pay’ bills are taking the lion’s share of the funds, and that hurts our businesses that are seeing less. Our district has a wide mix of people at the economic levels and we all feel the pain when our neighbors are hurting. We are hurting the middle class and big business by not supporting those with less.

**Community Care in the 26th –** Sadly, it looks like we are losing LovePacs, one of our community heroes helping provide food to families in need. With our crumbling safety net, we need to stretch harder to reinforce the support we cannot do without. [Span and Meals on Wheels](https://span-transit.org/) needs your help to continue providing for seniors, veterans and their pets in Denton County. Their annual fundraiser is coming up May 17th. Attend and donate to help. Fun with a purpose. [Events \- Span and Meals on Wheels](https://span-transit.org/events/).

**Tell me about living in the 26th –** __I want to hear from you__! Seriously, my ears are open. My team has created a simple questionnaire where you can tell me what’s on your mind. Too many politicians (including me) tell you what’s going on and what to think. I want to know how you see it and what are your true needs that we need to pursue. <https://forms.gle/dNSPgPhSVUTdy14C7>
Keep it real, based on what you are really seeing. I’m looking forward to reading what the good people of our district have to say.
**Local Elections in the 26th –** This last week, I attended several events to support municipal candidates running for the May 3rd election, early voting April 22-29. I went to [votedenton.gov](http://votedenton.gov), got my sample ballot, and I know for sure who I’m voting for. My ballot only has one race with opposition, and Sheila Tayor will get my vote based on her demonstrated devotion and service in her role on the LISD Board. Nothing partisan about it. She has our community at heart. Dentontogether.net has identified candidates for city/town council races that they recommend as the best for our communities.
**Meet Me in the 26th –** I’ll be at the “Hands Off” protest rally in Flower Mound Parker Square on April 5th at noon with already over 250 people signed up to attend. We’ll be telling our DC representatives to take their “Hands Off” of our Social Security, Medicaid, Veterans Benefits, Government Workers, Reputation in the world, and more. Use this link to sign up: [https://www.mobilize.us/handsoff/event/764921/?referring_vol=6291361&rname=Ernest&share_context=event-detail-page-modal-chained-invite&share_medium=copy_link](https://www.mobilize.us/handsoff/event/764921/?referring_vol=6291361&rname=Ernest&share_context=event-detail-page-modal-chained-invite&share_medium=copy_link)
I’ve been encouraged to hold a town hall in lieu of our current representative and we have a couple in the works. One in the first half of April and another mid-May. Details on these as they become available.
There are Block walks for some great candidates coming this weekend:
Idalia Amaya is running for Little Elm Town Council District 4, and she invites you to join her every Saturday at 9:00 AM until the Municipal Elections on May 3rd. We will meet at Starbucks (2831 Eldorado Parkway, #101, Little Elm, TX 75068) Use this link to sign up: [https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/768651/?referring_vol=6291361&rname=Ernest&share_context=event_details&share_medium=copy_link](https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/768651/?referring_vol=6291361&rname=Ernest&share_context=event_details&share_medium=copy_link)
Block walk with David Vartian who is running for Providence Village Town Council Place 5 every Saturday morning until the Municipal elections. At 9 am we meet at Lake Providence Park, 10429 Cedar Lake Dr, Providence Village, TX and leave shortly after a briefing.
[https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/765664/?referring_vol=6291361&rname=Ernest&share_context=event_details&share_medium=copy_link](https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/765664/?referring_vol=6291361&rname=Ernest&share_context=event_details&share_medium=copy_link)
**Doing your part in the 26 th – **Thank you to so many of you who have contacted me be email or through the website [Lineberger for US Congress | Congressional District 26](https://www.linebergerforuscongress.com/) to volunteer your time and ask what you can do. Right now, I’m looking for organizers. People with the time to help maintain lists of volunteers, and fundraising efforts. Let me know if this is you. Before too long, we will have more need for ‘participation’ help.
Calling and writing is also going on for some of these campaigns, plus to Texas reps about school vouchers, US Reps and Senators about Medicaid, Social Security, Keeping the government intact, etc.
Here are some groups to look up on Facebook or elsewhere to find ways to take action. (Yes, there are even more groups than this. Yay!)
Flower Mound Area Democrats
Lantana Area Democrats
Young Democrats of Denton County
Carrollton Democrats Club
Denton Together
Cooke County Democrats
Wise County Democrats
Dems of 380
Rural Area Denton Democrats (Sanger)
Frisco Democrats
Little Elm Democrats
Lewisville Democrats
And coming soon: North Texas College Democrats
Thanks to all who read this newsletter for taking the time to consider my thoughts. If you'd like to support my campaign to be your next Congressman, you can contribute by clicking on this link: [Ernest Lineberger — Donate via ActBlue](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lineberger-c2g-postelec?refcode=20250314_no_on_cr_button1&source=email-no-on-cr&link_id=1&can_id=40af7756836295aedd1a450e9b6ca48a&email_referrer=email_2656688&email_subject=veterans-and-children-will-suffer-under-this-cr-lets-do-something&refcodeEmailReferrer=email_2656688).
Your Friend and Neighbor,
Putting People’s Needs before Wealthy Greed and Party Politics!
Ernest Lineberger
Candidate for U.S. Congress, 26th Congressional District of Texas

"'**Avoid travel:' Bridge linking Texas and Mexico targeted with bomb threat** ," Houston Chronicle's **Elizabeth L.T. Moore** -- "A bomb threat was made against a busy international bridge linking South Texas and Mexico a day after [officials announced heightened security ](https://substack.com/redirect/beba310d-d99c-4922-a6f9-5feb413e1489?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)in the area.

The threat was made on Monday against the Gateway International Bridge connecting the business districts of Brownsville and Matamoros, Mexico, U.S. Customs and Border officials told [ValleyCentral.com](https://substack.com/redirect/beba310d-d99c-4922-a6f9-5feb413e1489?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

On Sunday, the U.S. Embassy and U.S. consulates in Mexico issued a security alert advising that bridges between Matamoros and Brownsville would see increased security presence and possible delays.

"As a precaution, the U.S. Consulate has advised employees to avoid travel on Gateway International Bridge and allow extra time for all border crossings," the [notice](https://substack.com/redirect/c64dccb3-8a97-4fa4-87d9-78d49cc42b5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) said.
[Give a gift subscription](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9tdXN0cmVhZHRleGFzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.7krS9GDqgH5jvPXCHBXxecgQs74V0WAuJwoSHIWRsy0?&gift=true)
The notice advised people to postpone non-essential travel, plan for longer border crossing times, monitor local media for updates, be aware of their surroundings, and notify friends and family of their safety.

The notice warned of delays on the Gateway International Bridge specifically, but activity on the bridge Monday looked like any other day, according to ValleyCentral.

The Brownsville Police Department had been asked to increase security at the port of entry but did not increase its patrols or presence.

The [Gateway International Bridge](https://substack.com/redirect/33a7a21a-6a12-423f-acb6-15d54077c1fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) links the downtown business districts of Brownsville and Matamoros. It is used mainly by pedestrians, tourists, vehicles making local trips and employees of maquiladoras, factories on the Mexican side of the border that assemble products for export to the U.S.

Matamoros is in the Mexican state of Tamaulipas. The U.S. Department of State Travel Advisory lists Tamaulipas as "Level 4 - Do Not Travel Due to Crime and Kidnapping."

"Criminal groups target public and private passenger buses, as well as private automobiles traveling through Tamaulipas, often taking passengers and demanding ransom payments," the [advisory](https://substack.com/redirect/f09531e1-13ba-4550-8e58-9528f5cce7c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) says.

Federal employees may travel only in limited areas in the state, with certain restrictions, according to the advisory.

"Organized crime activity - including gun battles, murder, armed robbery, carjacking, kidnapping, forced disappearances, extortion, and sexual assault - is common along the northern border and in Ciudad Victoria," the advisory says." [Houston Chronicle](https://substack.com/redirect/4d60ffff-dd19-488e-a21f-10da2abd4dcf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

"Criminal groups target public and private passenger buses, as well as private automobiles traveling through Tamaulipas, often taking passengers and demanding ransom payments," the says. Federal employees may travel only in limited areas in the state, with certain restrictions, according to the advisory. "Organized crime activity - including gun battles, murder, armed robbery, carjacking, kidnapping, forced disappearances, extortion, and sexual assault - is common along the northern border and in Ciudad Victoria," the advisory says." **TOP NEWS**
"'**Avoid travel:' Bridge linking Texas and Mexico targeted with bomb threat** ," Houston Chronicle's **Elizabeth L.T. Moore** -- "A bomb threat was made against a busy international bridge linking South Texas and Mexico a day after [officials announced heightened security ](https://substack.com/redirect/962ad929-7adf-4aaf-b3e7-2c09f011abec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)in the area.

The threat was made on Monday against the Gateway International Bridge connecting the business districts of Brownsville and Matamoros, Mexico, U.S. Customs and Border officials told [ValleyCentral.com](https://substack.com/redirect/962ad929-7adf-4aaf-b3e7-2c09f011abec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

On Sunday, the U.S. Embassy and U.S. consulates in Mexico issued a security alert advising that bridges between Matamoros and Brownsville would see increased security presence and possible delays.

"As a precaution, the U.S. Consulate has advised employees to avoid travel on Gateway International Bridge and allow extra time for all border crossings," the [notice](https://substack.com/redirect/91b0033c-f095-4490-bfff-75b2eeec649d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) said.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/ef8cf4ca-31ef-4a12-94b5-ea5c74ddcc9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The notice advised people to postpone non-essential travel, plan for longer border crossing times, monitor local media for updates, be aware of their surroundings, and notify friends and family of their safety.

The notice warned of delays on the Gateway International Bridge specifically, but activity on the bridge Monday looked like any other day, according to ValleyCentral.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/ef8cf4ca-31ef-4a12-94b5-ea5c74ddcc9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The Brownsville Police Department had been asked to increase security at the port of entry but did not increase its patrols or presence.

The [Gateway International Bridge](https://substack.com/redirect/bc845d59-53b9-454a-8309-8a44c05f4e2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) links the downtown business districts of Brownsville and Matamoros. It is used mainly by pedestrians, tourists, vehicles making local trips and employees of maquiladoras, factories on the Mexican side of the border that assemble products for export to the U.S.

Matamoros is in the Mexican state of Tamaulipas. The U.S. Department of State Travel Advisory lists Tamaulipas as "Level 4 - Do Not Travel Due to Crime and Kidnapping."

"Criminal groups target public and private passenger buses, as well as private automobiles traveling through Tamaulipas, often taking passengers and demanding ransom payments," the [advisory](https://substack.com/redirect/a9cbf756-72cf-45b0-9f55-107d3905e084?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) says.

Federal employees may travel only in limited areas in the state, with certain restrictions, according to the advisory.

"Organized crime activity - including gun battles, murder, armed robbery, carjacking, kidnapping, forced disappearances, extortion, and sexual assault - is common along the northern border and in Ciudad Victoria," the advisory says." TOP NEWS "'Avoid travel:' Bridge linking Texas and Mexico targeted with bomb threat ," Houston Chronicle's Elizabeth L.T. Moore -- "A bomb threat was made against a busy international bridge linking South Texas and Mexico a day after the area. The threat was made on Monday against the Gateway International Bridge connecting the business districts of Brownsville and Matamoros, Mexico, U.S. Customs and Border officials told . On Sunday, the U.S. Embassy and U.S. consulates in Mexico issued a security alert advising that bridges between Matamoros and Brownsville would see increased security presence and possible delays. "As a precaution, the U.S. Consulate has advised employees to avoid travel on Gateway International Bridge and allow extra time for all border crossings," the said. The notice advised people to postpone non-essential travel, plan for longer border crossing times, monitor local media for updates, be aware of their surroundings, and notify friends and family of their safety. The notice warned of delays on the Gateway International Bridge specifically, but activity on the bridge Monday looked like any other day, according to ValleyCentral. The Brownsville Police Department had been asked to increase security at the port of entry but did not increase its patrols or presence. The links the downtown business districts of Brownsville and Matamoros. It is used mainly by pedestrians, tourists, vehicles making local trips and employees of maquiladoras, factories on the Mexican side of the border that assemble products for export to the U.S. Matamoros is in the Mexican state of Tamaulipas. The U.S. Department of State Travel Advisory lists Tamaulipas as "Level 4 - Do Not Travel Due to Crime and Kidnapping." "Criminal groups target public and private passenger buses, as well as private automobiles traveling through Tamaulipas, often taking passengers and demanding ransom payments," the says. Federal employees may travel only in limited areas in the state, with certain restrictions, according to the advisory. "Organized crime activity - including gun battles, murder, armed robbery, carjacking, kidnapping, forced disappearances, extortion, and sexual assault - is common along the northern border and in Ciudad Victoria," the advisory says." name: Taking the Hill
subject: What did you do at 26?
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/TTH_LogoFINAL.png]
What did you do at 26?
Serving in 138 degree Heat in Baghdad, Iraq with All-Americans 21 years ago, I felt their greatness daily - but today, I had to pinch myself attending the official opening of the National Medal of Honor Museum in Dallas, as today is National Medal of Honor Day.
There have been 3,547 recipients of the Medal of Honor, 618 of those were awarded posthumously for giving the ultimate sacrifice.
Every single one of them are genuine heroes who put their lives on the line for their brothers & sisters. There are 61 living MOH recipients - 35 of them were here in Dallas. Four MOH recipients are still on active duty.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/IMG_0223-min.jpg]
The youngest living recipient is Marine Corps veteran Kyle Carpenter (follow him on @chicksdigscars) whose remarkable actions under fire and wounded in November 2010, when he was just 21 years old, are humbling. In fact, the average age of Medal of Honor recipients at the time of their heroic action is around 26 years old.
If you ever get down on our country, look at the the helpers in our communities across America, look to the heroes like these Medal of Honor recipients. I remind my kids, when something bad happens, look to the helpers - and hopefully we can all be ready if called upon to make a difference.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/IMG_0431-min.jpg]
The museum website: www.mohmuseum.org [http://www.mohmuseum.org/]
Honorable Patrick J. Murphy
Former Congressman
32nd Undersecretary of the Army

## The Immigration Double Standard...
If you're old enough - say if your birthday year starts with 19 - you remember when enforcing the law was a pretty uncontroversial part of what presidents did.
Not anymore.
Last Saturday, the White House released an executive order invoking the Alien Enemies Act of 1798. The order designates Tren de Aragua (TdA) as a Foreign Terrorist Organization. As the statement makes clear, TdA, _with the support of Nicholas Maduro and the corrupted Venezuelan government_ , has "unlawfully infiltrated the United States. . . conducting irregular warfare and undertaking hostile actions against the United States."
You read that right. Not only is this gang breaking into the country, it's doing so with the support of a foreign government: Venezuela.
More on that later.
These gang members aren't misunderstood dreamers we're talking about.
Putting it lightly, TdA are bad apples - a quick Google search can show you that their crimes include violent street robberies, human trafficking, and drug dealing at an unbelievably destructive scale.
I'd venture to say those aren't the kind of people we want in America.
Evidently President Trump agrees, because he's using the Alien Enemies Act to give TdA members a one-way ticket out of the U.S - pretty good call if you ask me.
But how does it play out practically?...

| Welcome to Keeping Up with Kathryn Harvey. A weekly digest covering South Carolina politics and opportunities for engagement and action in the Upstate.
---
| One year ago today I filed to run for Congress in District Four to represent over 750,000 people living in Greenville and Spartanburg Counties, and I haven’t stopped fighting and advocating for our community since.
The great Angela Davis once said**'I am no longer accepting the things I cannot change. I am changing the things I cannot accept.'** Now is the time to pushback, to lift voices, and to ensure that we are leaving our children with this world better than we found it.
I’m staying in this fight, and I hope you will too.
---

# Thank You for Two More Years.
---
| This past weekend I was elected to a third term as the Chair of the Spartanburg County Democratic Party. In reflecting on the work we've done in our community over this tenure, I'm most proud that we have a foundation for which to receive the people who are ready to fight and mobilize with urgency in this time of uncertainty. Over 150 delegates joined us at our convention and nearly half of them were new faces.
Building a more just, compassionate, and inclusive future in the Upstate requires year-round organizing, outreach, and advocacy. So I invite you to be a part of this work by joining the [**Liberty Fund** ](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=5f39dd42df&e=edbde6c9b1)— a sustaining donor program named in honor of one of our core principles: _LIBERTY_.
Your recurring monthly gift of **$25 or $50** fuels our mission to:
1. Recruit and train Democratic candidates at every level
2. Mobilize voters in every zip code and precinct
3. Host community events that inform and empower
4. Ramp up our communications to engage new communities.

---
| | | | | | | | | | | [Donate Here](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=f6e9f7d131&e=edbde6c9b1)
---
| | | | | | | | | | | For those unable to attend the convention, I want you to meet Greenville County Democratic Party’s newest chair: Stacey Mars. Stacey and her leadership team joined us this past Saturday at our Spartanburg Convention to support our leadership election, and I couldn’t be more grateful and excited to build in the Upstate with her. Congratulations Stacey!

A weekly digest covering South Carolina politics and opportunities for engagement and action in the Upstate. | One year ago today I filed to run for Congress in District Four to represent over 750,000 people living in Greenville and Spartanburg Counties, and I haven’t stopped fighting and advocating for our community since. The great Angela Davis once said'I am no longer accepting the things I cannot change. I am changing the things I cannot accept.' Now is the time to pushback, to lift voices, and to ensure that we are leaving our children with this world better than we found it. I’m staying in this fight, and I hope you will too. | | Thank You for Two More Years. | This past weekend I was elected to a third term as the Chair of the Spartanburg County Democratic Party. In reflecting on the work we've done in our community over this tenure, I'm most proud that we have a foundation for which to receive the people who are ready to fight and mobilize with urgency in this time of uncertainty. Over 150 delegates joined us at our convention and nearly half of them were new faces. Building a more just, compassionate, and inclusive future in the Upstate requires year-round organizing, outreach, and advocacy. So I invite you to be a part of this work by joining the — a sustaining donor program named in honor of one of our core principles: LIBERTY. Ramp up our communications to engage new communities. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | For those unable to attend the convention, I want you to meet Greenville County Democratic Party’s newest chair: Stacey Mars. name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: The Path Forward
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-logo-1.png]
Dear friends,
It has been a while since I have written to you from here. So much has happened.
Over the last two months, we have witnessed rapid and relentless efforts to undermine our constitutional system of government and our Constitution itself. From the Congress to the courts, the Trump administration has undermined the fundamental checks and balances of our system of government in an effort to expand the power of the president beyond recognition and to implement dangerous, divisive policies. From executive orders and actions encouraging lawlessness, eviscerating progress for all Americans, and abandoning our allies and our leadership in the world, we see the harms unfolding every day. We also see that we must meet this moment—in Congress, in the courts, and in our communities.
With so much happening, I am sure you are getting news from many reliable sources, and I hope you are subscribed to my official email report about what is happening each week that I am in Washington.
As important partners in the work of informing and mobilizing people in our community and beyond, I want to share a few thoughts with you here about what we can and must do to meet the moment and how I am working through this campaign to do so.
We must fight these efforts in Congress . With Republicans in charge of the House and the Senate, Congress has not fought the Trump administration’s efforts to undermine Congress’ constitutional authority or implement dangerous policies. From where I sit, it appears that House Republicans are not merely failing to object, they are actively and enthusiastically supporting these efforts: handing over Congress’ power of the purse, ditching legislation that does not please Elon Musk, and refusing to do oversight of the administration. So, how do we fight in Congress? Democrats in the House are working together to expose and defeat dangerous legislation, sound the alarm, hold the administration accountable through the tools we have, and to win back the House.
We must fight these efforts in the courts. Courageous citizens and lawyers are fighting the administration in the courts, filing more than 110 cases to date against the Trump administration’s harmful actions. And they are winning. In many of these cases courts have issued orders stopping these harmful actions—some temporary and some final. These cases are important to protecting the constitution and the people of this country. As a former courtroom lawyer, I am glad to put my experience to work as a member of the House Democrats’ Litigation Task Force, where we are monitoring and assisting in these efforts as we can.
We must fight these efforts in our communities. People across our communities are deeply concerned about what is unfolding—from the lawlessness of pardoning felons and making our communities less safe, to the recklessness of freezing government funding for programs of all kinds our communities rely on (from HeadStart to health research), to the mindlessness of mass firing of government employees who protect our nuclear weapons, keep us safe when flying, monitor our air and water, care for our veterans, and ensure people receive the benefits they have earned. As a community, we need to inform our neighbors about what these drastic cuts mean for our community and mobilize people to respond. Team Lizzie is here to support that effort.
I cannot overstate how important it is that we win the 2026 midterm elections and take back the House of Representatives. It won’t change everything, but it will change some things. And it is critical to bringing back the checks on the administration that have vanished in the last two months and putting us back on a path to progress.
In the months ahead, you will hear from me in these emails about the political side of my work, as you have in years past, as well as how you can help. I am committed to working with TX07 volunteers year‐round to inform and mobilize people in our district and across our community. We are keeping our campaign office open year‐round for organizing and engagement activities.
There are many things you can do to help, and many ways to get involved:
* Volunteer! You have heard and will continue to hear that you can volunteer with the campaign. In the past we’ve included a “volunteer” button in emails a little closer to each election day, but our campaign team is working now to turn community concerns into action and help you connect with meaningful opportunities to volunteer.
* Inform! Use your voice to educate and inform people across the community. Write letters to the editor or op-eds. In TX07, we have many papers published daily, weekly, and monthly. Share your thoughts about why what’s happening in Washington (and elsewhere) matters and encourage people to engage on the issues.
* Engage! Make sure elected officials, including me, hear from you about the issues that matter to you by emailing, calling, or sending in letters.
* Contribute! You have heard from me for years—and as you might expect, you will continue to hear—that you can support this political effort with a financial contribution. That is still true, and will remain true. This campaign will be important to the effort to win back the House and to mobilize voters in TX07 that will be critical in the 2026 midterm election.
These are difficult days. There is no doubt about that. When I think about the challenges ahead, I find it helpful to think about how we met those challenges before.
Eight years ago, at the beginning of the first Trump administration, I was so deeply concerned about what was happening that I decided to put my name on the ballot and run against my member of Congress who was enabling and encouraging President Trump’s dangerous agenda. Together, we put together an incredible coalition that flipped TX07 from red to blue in 2018, that held on to it against the headwinds of 2020, and that has worked in every election to help elect not just me but other leaders we need and deserve.
We know how much is at stake. We also know how much we can do when we work together.
Together, we can do anything,

Well if there is one thing we learned from Jeffrey Goldberg's sensationalized story in The Atlantic is that this Trump team is unified and working as a team. How Goldberg got into the chat is still tbd, but let's be honest fist emojis and calling out Europe for not pulling its weight is not top secret as Goldberg implied. As most liberal hacks, it's just another attempt to show a chink in the armor of Trump or his cabinet members. There are no better guests to give us a deep dive on liberal media hacks than Michael Duncan and John Ashbrook from the [@RuthlessPodcast ](https://substack.com/redirect/e2901be4-164c-4ffb-a769-b209925fdd05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)It was John Ashbrook that represented Ruthless in the White House's new media seat as the eye rolls from state run media outlets dashed across the room. Ashbrook poignantly asked about how the media was missing the mark when it came to the border. President Trump is the most colorful president of our generation and deserves color commentary from the [@RuthlessPodcast ](https://substack.com/redirect/e2901be4-164c-4ffb-a769-b209925fdd05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)or other innovative media outlets than the likes of SV Date or the press pool team that has been traveling with the president. Duncan and Ashbrook unpack the brackets for this year's Hack Madness. It's much like the NCAA March Madness but gives Liberal Media Hacks a chance to really shine and make a run for biggest hack of the year. The season is not over yet and with categories like fake news, the establishment, liberal activist and way-too-online, the Liberal Hack Champion has yet to be crowned. The guys walk us through some of the lesser known contenders as they go up against top seeds like Margaret Brennan and Eugene Daniels.

Currently, Democrats have a majority in the Pennsylvania House by just one seat — losing this race would hand power back to Republicans. This district has been Democratic for years, but Republicans see an opportunity in a low-turnout race to slip the state House toward MAGA extremism. We’ve endorsed the pro-democracy candidate, Dan Goughnour, who has spent his life putting his community first. It’s going to take the full strength of this grassroots team to elect him.
We’ve also got our work cut out right now in Wisconsin. The April 1 supreme court election is shaping up to be one of the most expensive state judicial races in history — and groups connected to Elon Musk are pouring millions of dollars into deceptive ads.
The outcome of this race will have serious implications on crucial issues since the court could rule on cases involving fair maps, free elections, labor rights, reproductive freedom, and so much more. There are also critical elections coming up later this year in states like Michigan and Virginia. Our FEC fundraising deadline is less than a week away, and what we can raise will determine a lot about how hard we can fight in these key elections across the country.

This is a different email than I usually send, Peter.

I wanted to take a moment to share why I first ran for Congress. I hope you’ll read this message in its entirety, then **[consider making a $3 donation](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104509683/535579986/-2002425095?refcode=em-3.25.25-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMmJkMDg2Yi1jNjA5LWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uN0AY0MnNLAfcKImj5yAqVW-PmpQ2OAJNfZy4Mv44mo=)** to keep me in Washington fighting for you.

When I take a step back and remember why I decided to run to flip CA-27 blue, and why I’m already gearing up for re-election, I think of my family – specifically, my daughter Maya.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104509684/535579987/-2002425095?refcode=em-3.25.25-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMmJkMDg2Yi1jNjA5LWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uN0AY0MnNLAfcKImj5yAqVW-PmpQ2OAJNfZy4Mv44mo=)
I’ll never forget the day, eight years ago now, that Maya came home from kindergarten telling me about her day. Instead of telling me about a fun activity she did, she recalled the “exercises” she’d done with her classmates.

**She didn’t quite grasp the concept at the time, but she was describing an active shooter drill.**

That moment continues to have a profound impact on me – both as a father and now as a Congressman. We live in a country where for some families, a hug goodbye before school or work, a concert, a movie, a church service could be the last.

**Despite this reality, some of my extreme colleagues are still unwilling to make the common sense changes Americans desperately need to save lives.**

And it’s not just gun violence, Peter. We’ve seen women’s rights stripped away with the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_. Maya now has less control over her body than my wife and even my mom did at her age.

We have a lot of work ahead of us, and I’m so proud that we put together a grassroots coalition that flipped this seat. **With Republican control of Congress and the presidency, now is not the time to check out – it’s the time to dig in our heels and fight for what’s right.**

clean_body: | = This is a different email than I usually send, Peter. I wanted to take a moment to share why I first ran for Congress. I hope you’ll read this message in its entirety, then = to keep me in Washington fighting for you. When I take a step back and remember why I decided to run to flip CA-27 blue, and why I’m already gearing up for re-election, I think of my family – specifically, my daughter Maya. = I’ll never forget the day, eight years ago now, that Maya came home from kindergarten telling me about her day. Instead of telling me about a fun activity she did, she recalled the “exercises” she’d done with her classmates. She didn’t quite grasp the concept at the time, but she was describing an active shooter drill. That moment continues to have a profound impact on me – both as a father and now as a Congressman. We live in a country where for some families, a hug goodbye before school or work, a concert, a movie, a church service could be the last. Despite this reality, some of my extreme colleagues are still unwilling to make the common sense changes Americans desperately need to save lives. And it’s not just gun violence, Peter. We’ve seen women’s rights stripped away with the overturning of Roe v. Wade. Maya now has less control over her body than my wife and even my mom did at her age. We have a lot of work ahead of us, and I’m so proud that we put together a grassroots coalition that flipped this seat. subject: We must confront this destructive ideology
body:

Unsubscribe

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stpb7y&__onlt=t

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6djpyhdtckjb4ual57vexzu68qfz5g4ltofy8mwayqywpa70699gpdxuvyq8stzrdvkqmscyaimkbjyyj8mzuiownaxby80mpf4ne0r59l5382sfdrjpwt3vsvfkr8yu7g7kkgh9hp9x85wkzdltx&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stpb7y&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stpb7y&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stpb7y&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stpb7y&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6djpyhdtckjb4ual57vexzu6webvtfe89c8r5q0bznnz93sfd6xp2a3siurcj260jf6z85bdp2rze8qxd63hibswh6cjt22j0yysib2rlsd0ly9s2zbmquoiqfwka3wi3xaezr8fs07h852ssvz1f&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stpb7y&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stpb7y&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Derek, We're reaching out to ask if you can make a donation to the Democratic National Committee today. But before we do, we want to tell you a little bit about how we'll put that donation to work this year. It might seem like the next election cycle is far away, but the truth is in just a week, crucial special elections will take place in Wisconsin and Florida. These elections will determine control of the highest court in Wisconsin, and in Florida, we’ve got an opportunity to send more Democrats to Congress. Winning these races won’t be easy. Especially when Elon Musk is investing millions of dollars in states like Wisconsin to turn the tide in Republicans’ favor. That’s why we announced investments in Wisconsin that will be used to call 2 million Wisconsin voters, host text and phone banks, and mobilize thousands of volunteers. **That is the kind of work grassroots donations fund. Hi friend, it’s Deb Haaland.
The campaign to become the next governor of my beautiful home state of New Mexico means so much to me — and I’m so proud to have NV Dems on our team.
Right now, we’re building a fierce, people-powered, community-centered movement to change the game for New Mexico. But, we’re also facing a big challenge:
**April 7 marks our _first_ public reporting deadline. And it’s a really important one.**
You see, we’re facing a competitive and expensive race, with MAGA forces trying to flip control of this state and our state government.****
**If our first fundraising report is weak, it’ll invite far-right smear campaigns, outside spending, and potential right-wing opponents. And with Donald Trump in the White House, we need a fighter who’s fierce enough to stand up for New Mexicans.**
That’s why my team and I set a **_very_ ambitious goal of raising $150,000 online by April 7** to show that momentum and grassroots support are on _our_ side — and it’s why I’m humbly asking:
[**_Can you split a donation of $10 or any amount between my campaign and NV Dems? name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Hegseth. Resign. Immediately.
body:
This is amateur hour. We’re damn lucky the pilots on that mission and the sailors and marines on ships off shore didn’t make the ultimate sacrifice that day.
#

Peter, this Signal stuff you’ve been seeing isn’t just about the National Security Advisor accidentally adding a journalist to a group chat — though that’s bad enough.
It’s not just that they were texting war plans on hackable devices — though that’s much worse.
Honestly, it’s not just that they violated operational security measures and standards for sensitive and classified information — and that’s a huge problem.
It’s that they endangered the security of the men and women in harm’s way. It’s that they could have compromised the mission objective. Most importantly here, if we know they’ve done it this time... it’s likely they’ve been doing it for the last two months.
There’s no telling who’s been listening in, reading every text.
This is amateur hour. We’re damn lucky the pilots on that mission and the sailors and marines on ships offshore didn’t make the ultimate sacrifice that day. The Trump Administration’s carelessness and incompetence put their lives at risk.
These people are not serious, and we need to clear house.
We’ve got to start with the Secretary of Defense. He was unqualified and unprepared for this job to start, and it was him who sent detailed war plans over unsecured channels to begin with.
[**I’m calling on Pete Hegseth to resign. He can’t command the respect of the men and women he’s in charge of, and he’s failed the most basic security test I can think of. If you agree, add your name.** [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/signup/pet_em_250325//?source=em250325-1-160&akid=3776%2E734936%2EuEkOYz) Semper Fi, Ruben

name: AOC
subject: We did not vote for Starlink
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
"I voted for Trump, not Elon Musk"
#
If you ask the American people what they think about Elon Musk and DOGE, they are vehemently opposed.
The reactions right now are not just in Democratic districts, they’re in Republican districts saying, "**I voted for Trump, not for Elon Musk**."
We did not vote for mass buyouts of the federal workforce.
We did not vote for gutting NASA, and then having the contracts go to SpaceX. We did not vote for Starlink to start replacing critical FAA operations.
There is a very, very deep corruption at the core of this.
If Elon Musk wanted to divest himself of his businesses and enter public service with his so-called ‘business expertise,’ that is his prerogative.
But so long as he maintains a vested financial interest in gutting the federal government, **he is acting in his own self-interest and not those of the American people**.
We're not witnessing the start of an oligarchy — we are fully here.
But we do not have to comply with illegal activity, **even if that illegal activity is coming from the President and his billionaire donors**.
[Help us continue the fight with a grassroots contribution today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250325-2.xF0Rug&refcode=em20250325-8435-P_FND_CTR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8435%2E2526796%2EZWTX44)

Alexandria
